projects.title: Continuous-Domain Phase Retrieval in Dimension One
projects.summary: Studies the phase retrieval problem in a continuous-domain framework in one dimension. The page lists it under available projects.

projects.title: Training Complex-Valued Denoisers for Phase Retrieval
projects.summary: Training complex-valued denoisers for use in phase retrieval. The project belongs to the lab's phase retrieval work.

projects.title: Exploring Global Youth Art Through AI: A Semantic Analysis of the IMAJ Collection
projects.summary: Semantic analysis of the IMAJ youth art drawing collection using AI methods to explore global youth art.

projects.title: High-Dimensional Gaussian Sampling: Cholesky versus Markov
projects.summary: Compares Cholesky-based and Markov-based approaches for sampling from high-dimensional Gaussian distributions.

projects.title: Sampling from Learned Regularizers
projects.summary: Sampling methods based on learned regularizers for inverse problems.

projects.title: Analysis of dendritic spine changes using deep-learning encoding in a latent space
projects.summary: Analyses changes in dendritic spines using deep-learning encoding in a latent space.

projects.title: Automated image analysis of tau fibrils in the human Alzheimer's disease brain
projects.summary: Automated image analysis of tau fibrils in human Alzheimer's disease brain tissue.

projects.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence for Therapy Planning and Design
projects.summary: Topic is the use of generative AI to support planning and design of therapies.

projects.title: Large-Scale Frontier Model for High-Dimensional Biological Imaging Data
projects.summary: Topic is building a large-scale frontier model for analysing high-dimensional biological imaging data.

projects.title: Vision-Language Models for Biomedicine
projects.summary: Topic is the development of vision-language models applied to biomedical data.

projects.title: Reasoning in Biological Foundation Models
projects.summary: Topic is studying how reasoning can be performed in foundation models for biology.

projects.title: Automated image analysis of tau fibrils in the human Alzheimer's disease brain
projects.summary: Develop a Python image analysis workflow to detect and segment tau fibrils in human Alzheimer's disease brain tissue imaged with correlative light and electron microscopy. The goal is to measure fibril twist and relate it to the stage and clustering of tau tangles.

projects.title: Analysis of dendritic spine changes using deep-learning encoding in a latent space
projects.summary: The project aims to build a deep learning system that reconstructs the temporal evolution of dendritic spine shapes from 3D time-lapse microscopy data. Spine shapes will be encoded into a low-dimensional latent space to identify trajectories that classify single-spine behaviour.

projects.title: From PDE to Cell Imaging: A Multiresolution Framework for Fourier Ptychography
projects.summary: Build a PDE/wavelets-inspired multiresolution reconstruction algorithm for Fourier ptychographic microscopy, representing the high-resolution complex image with box-spline basis functions and refining from low to high frequencies to avoid poor local minima in the non-convex loss. The project combines an existing Python Fourier ptychography library with a box-spline library.

projects.title: Multigrid Solver For Non-Uniform Sampling With TV Regularization
projects.summary: Develop a fast multigrid-based solver for the non-uniform interpolation problem. The underlying image is represented with box-splines, with a focus on total variation (TV) based regularizers. The student implements the framework in PyTorch.

projects.title: Penalized Maximum Likelihood Approach for Deconvolution of Microscopy with Learned Convex Regularizer
projects.summary: The project addresses deconvolution of microscopy images, where measurements are a convolution of the ground truth with a known blur kernel and are corrupted by Poisson noise. The goal is to derive a variational formulation of the problem and solve it using a convex data-driven regularizer, benchmarking its performance.

projects.title: Prediction and survival analysis of ovarian cancer through multimodal fusion of radiomic and multiomic data.
projects.summary: Develop AI and machine learning pipelines that fuse radiomic features from CT/MRI images with multiomics data to predict outcomes and perform survival analysis in high-grade serous ovarian cancer. The goal is to capture tumor heterogeneity and support personalized treatment strategies.

projects.title: Sparse Unrolled Auto-Encoders for Interpretable Analysis of Neural Data
projects.summary: The project investigates sparse autoencoder-style methods for interpreting neural computation. It proposes unrolling the greedy Matching Pursuit sparse approximation algorithm, as a simpler and easier-to-tune alternative to the unrolled ISTA used in the DUNL framework, to decompose multiplexed neural signals into temporally localized, more interpretable components.

projects.title: Diffusion Models for Magnetic Resonance Imaging Reconstruction
projects.summary: Develop and compare diffusion-model-based reconstruction methods for accelerated MRI, including baseline 2D diffusion reconstructions versus the lab's in-house deep learning method, new architectures and reconstruction frameworks, and a feasibility assessment of 3D diffusion reconstruction for MRI.

projects.title: Inverse Problems with ℓ1 Regularization: Extreme Points of the Regularization Polytope and Analysis vs Synthesis Formulations
projects.summary: The project aims to determine the extreme points of a regularization polytope defined by a regularization operator L, in order to analyse the structure of ℓ1-regularized inverse problem solutions and enable a synthesis formulation. The student would study inverse problems and ℓ1 sparsity, then design and implement an algorithm to compute these extreme points for a given L.

projects.title: Discretization of Non-Uniform Sampling Problems with Exponential Splines
projects.summary: Recover a continuous-time signal from noisy non-uniform samples by solving an inverse problem with generalized total-variation (gTV) regularization. The student studies L-spline theory and exponential splines, discretizes the problem with B-splines, and solves the resulting finite-dimensional optimisation problem.

projects.title: Likelihoods for Hawkes Processes
projects.summary: The student will implement a simulator for Hawkes process trajectories and two estimation algorithms, one based on the classical likelihood and one on a recently proposed binned likelihood. The project then compares their strengths and weaknesses for estimating the excitation kernel.

projects.title: Sampling from Learned Regularizers
projects.summary: Investigates posterior sampling for linear inverse problems using energy-based priors built from learnable potential functions applied to linear filter responses. The goal is to implement and analyze sampling algorithms such as the (annealed) Metropolis adjusted Langevin algorithm on these models for Bayesian uncertainty quantification.

projects.title: Improving Optimization Algorithms for Ptychography Phase Retrieval
projects.summary: The project aims to explore and improve the convergence and efficiency of optimization algorithms for ptychography phase retrieval. The student would implement and compare strategies such as quasi-Newton and conjugate gradient, using explicit gradients or automatic differentiation, and possibly investigate GPU acceleration and adaptive hyperparameter selection.

projects.title: High-Dimensional Gaussian Sampling: Cholesky versus Markov
projects.summary: Compares three approaches to sampling high-dimensional Gaussians: exact Cholesky-factorization-based linear algebra, iterative Markov Chain Monte Carlo methods, and Perturb-and-Map. The goal is to determine the best trade-off between computational speed and statistical accuracy for large-scale inverse problems.

projects.title: Vector-Valued Inverse Problems: B-Spline Discretization and Identification of Matrix Differential Operators for Regularization
projects.summary: The project aims to design and implement a Python package for two-dimensional vector-valued spline functions based on matrices of ordinary differential operators (MDOs), validated on a synthetic or real-world problem. It also targets methods to identify or learn a suitable MDO for regularizing vector-valued inverse problems from observations of correlated signals.

projects.title: Exploring Global Youth Art Through AI: A Semantic Analysis of the IMAJ Collection
projects.summary: Semantic analysis of a collection of more than 100,000 drawings by young artists aged 3 to 25 from 150 countries, using large language models adapted to the artistic and cultural context. The work starts by evaluating models on curated subsets, then scales up to generate textual interpretations that enrich the database with metadata.

projects.title: Investigating steerable wavelets to build Parseval frames
projects.summary: The project aims to develop a learned, convex regularizer for image reconstruction based on a parametric, steerable wavelet framework. The regularizer is trained via denoising and validated on diverse inverse problems using accelerated gradient methods.

projects.title: Training Complex-Valued Denoisers for Phase Retrieval
projects.summary: Train a denoiser that operates directly on complex-valued data to regularize magnitude and phase jointly in phase retrieval. The work compares Plug-and-Play, diffusion and flow-matching paradigms and benchmarks the joint complex denoiser against magnitude/phase splitting.

projects.title: Continuous-Domain Phase Retrieval in Dimension One
projects.summary: Develop and benchmark a coarse-to-fine (multiscale) numerical solver for recovering a complex-valued continuous-domain signal from magnitude-only linear measurements. The solver runs Wirtinger Flow at a coarse scale and propagates estimates up the resolution hierarchy as warm starts, and is compared with single-scale Wirtinger Flow with spectral initialization at full resolution.

projects.title: Continuous-Domain Phase Retrieval in Dimension One
projects.summary: Studies phase retrieval for one-dimensional signals formulated in the continuous domain. The page gives only the title and a supervisor.

projects.title: Training Complex-Valued Denoisers for Phase Retrieval
projects.summary: Concerns training complex-valued denoising networks for use in phase retrieval. The page gives only the title and supervisors.

projects.title: Exploring Global Youth Art Through AI: A Semantic Analysis of the IMAJ Collection
projects.summary: Aims at a semantic analysis of the IMAJ youth art drawing collection using AI methods. The page gives only the title and supervisors.

projects.title: High-Dimensional Gaussian Sampling: Cholesky versus Markov
projects.summary: Compares Cholesky-based and Markov-based approaches for sampling high-dimensional Gaussian distributions. The page gives only the title and a supervisor.

projects.title: Sampling from Learned Regularizers
projects.summary: Concerns sampling from priors defined by learned regularizers for inverse problems. The page gives only the title and supervisors.

projects.title: Analysis of dendritic spine changes using deep-learning encoding in a latent space
projects.summary: Analyses changes in dendritic spines using deep-learning encoding in a latent space. The page gives only the title and supervisors.

projects.title: Automated image analysis of tau fibrils in the human Alzheimer's disease brain
projects.summary: Develops automated image analysis of tau fibrils in human Alzheimer's disease brain tissue. The page gives only the title and supervisors.

projects.title: Spine motion replication
projects.summary: Replicate the spine motion and degrees of freedom of quadruped animals with fewer actuators, reducing weight, bulk and mechanical complexity. The work is mainly software.

projects.title: Modeling zebrafish sensorimotor integration using simulation and robots
projects.summary: Study and model zebrafish sensorimotor integration through neuromechanical simulation and the ZBot fishlike robot, in collaboration with Duke University. Possible directions include a new simulation framework, deep reinforcement learning for sensorimotor circuits, visually guided behaviors, and programming ZBot.

projects.title: Firmware development for ENVIROBOT
projects.summary: Continue the development of ENVIROBOT by adapting the existing firmware to a new generation of electronic boards and extending it with new functionality on the new platform.

projects.title: Paleorobotics of Armored Tail Strikes: Simulation, Compliance, and Energy Dissipation in Extinct Mammalian Weapons
projects.summary: Use paleorobotics to test whether extinct armored mammals could generate powerful tail-club strikes, by building MuJoCo and SIMM/OpenSim-type models of a tendon-driven tail and mapping how strike energy is transferred and absorbed. Optional work includes a biomimetic carapace and a tendon-driven tail prototype. The project is split between EPFL and University of Zurich.

projects.title: Radio communication module on 169.4 MHz
projects.summary: Finalise a prototype bidirectional serial link based on a CC1120 radio chip at 169.4 MHz, by redesigning the PCBs, improving communication software and stability, adding a simple user interface on the microcontroller, and adding flow control on the robot side.

projects.title: Robotic paleontology: tail strike defense
projects.summary: Design and build a life-sized robotic tail based on a dinosaur or Glyptodont club tail to measure the impact force and velocity of tail strikes, using bone-like material reproductions from fossils. Experiments take place at Empa Dübendorf.

projects.title: User-Centric Multimodal Interaction for Assistive Robotic Environments
projects.summary: Study the everyday challenges of wheelchair users and investigate how multiple interfaces (markerless body-language tracking, LLM/VLM natural-language control, tablet interface) can provide accessible control of mobile robotic furniture. The student can further develop or evaluate one interaction modality.

projects.title: Mobile Manipulation of Assistive Robotic Furniture
projects.summary: Integrate robotic arms with a mobile robotic furniture platform and develop a whole-body controller so that a mobile manipulator can fetch objects for a wheelchair user, such as bringing a cup of water, in simulation (MuJoCo) and on the real robot.

projects.title: Comparing Representational Hierarchies in Neural Networks
projects.summary: Investigates whether neural networks learn similar representations across their full layer hierarchies, rather than only at individually matched layers. The project aims to develop a principled comparison method and reassess evidence for representational convergence across pretrained multi-modal models.

projects.title: What Do Language Models Need from 3D Encoders?
projects.summary: Studies what 3D encoders (point clouds or Gaussian splats) contribute when connected to a language model, and how 3D representations could be learned to be more useful for LLMs reasoning about 3D scenes. The question is also extended to modeling spatial organization of cells.

projects.title: Learning patient-level predictions from the spatial proteome
projects.summary: Develops a multiple instance learning approach that aggregates single-cell, niche and tissue-level information from spatial proteomics data to predict patient-level outcomes such as cancer survival. The project evaluates performance versus training cohort size and whether model attention agrees with known pathology.

projects.title: Improving agents for single-cell genomics and biomedical discovery
projects.summary: Aims to improve the reasoning capabilities of LLM-based agents for single-cell biology tasks through agentic reinforcement learning, so that they can formulate hypotheses, design validation strategies and execute computational workflows.

projects.title: Deep Learning image reconstruction of cones free-running cardiac MRI
projects.summary: Master's project in cardiovascular MRI on deep learning-based image reconstruction for free-running cardiac MRI acquired with cones trajectories. Based at CHUV Biopôle, Lausanne.

projects.title: Optimisation of the process pipeline of cerebrovascular reactivity data for clinical research
projects.summary: Master project to optimise the data processing pipeline for cerebrovascular reactivity MRI data used in clinical research. Located at HUG, CIBM MRI HUG-UNIGE, Geneva.

projects.title: Novel hardware technologies for neuroimaging and neurostimulation
projects.summary: Master or semester project on new hardware technologies for neuroimaging and neurostimulation at EPFL CIBM, Lausanne.

projects.title: Functional magnetic resonance spectroscopy at 7 Tesla
projects.summary: Master or semester project on functional magnetic resonance spectroscopy at 7 Tesla at EPFL CIBM, Lausanne.

projects.title: Fast metabolic imaging by magnetic resonance fingerprinting
projects.summary: Master or semester project on fast metabolic imaging using magnetic resonance fingerprinting at EPFL CIBM, Lausanne.

projects.title: Zero knowledge succinct arguments, probabilistic proofs and complexity theory
projects.summary: Projects on zero knowledge succinct arguments, probabilistic proofs and complexity theory, which can be tailored to the student's experience and interests. Students apply by emailing the contact named on the page with their CV.

projects.title: Optimization, Formalization and Benchmarking
projects.summary: Projects on optimization, formalization and benchmarking of proof system components and techniques, which can be tailored to the student's experience and interests. Students apply by emailing the contact named on the page with their CV.

projects.title: Semester Project or Master Thesis: Flow Matching for Imaging Inverse Problems with Nonlinear Forward Operators
projects.summary: Develop flow matching generative models to solve imaging inverse problems with nonlinear forward operators. The work is aimed at image reconstruction.

projects.title: AI and Agentic Driven Generation of State-of-the-Art Branch Predictors
projects.summary: Use AI and agentic methods to automatically generate state-of-the-art branch predictors for processors.

projects.title: Synthetic Data Generation and Quality Assessment for the Mountain Biodiversity Knowledge Graph
projects.summary: Generate synthetic data for the Mountain Biodiversity Knowledge Graph and assess the quality of that data. The work applies NLP methods.

projects.title: Learning Atmospheric Similarity for Retrieval-Augmented Weather Forecasting
projects.summary: Learn atmospheric similarity to retrieve relevant past states for retrieval-augmented weather forecasting.

projects.title: Post-Training Quantization of Weather Foundation Models: Attention Quantization and Long-Rollout Calibration
projects.summary: Apply post-training quantization to weather foundation models, focusing on attention quantization and calibration over long rollouts.

projects.title: MSc thesis: Uncertainty-aware deep learning for large-scale mapping of mass movements using SAR interferometry
projects.summary: Develop uncertainty-aware deep learning to map mass movements at large scale from SAR interferometry data.

projects.title: MSc thesis: Evaluating explainable machine learning tools for understanding greenhouse gas flux time series
projects.summary: Evaluate explainable machine learning tools for interpreting greenhouse gas flux time series.

projects.title: Scalable Distributed Cache Coherency
projects.summary: Design scalable distributed cache coherence protocols that keep shared data consistent across cached copies while reducing the communication overhead that limits current protocols.

projects.title: Accelerating Safe ML Systems
projects.summary: Investigate how to use Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) to build machine learning systems that are both fast and secure for distributed training of large models.

projects.title: Distributed Resource Efficient Inference Engine
projects.summary: Work on the distributed inference engine Anyd, which aggregates heterogeneous hardware into a unified cluster that automatically schedules generative AI inference and handles failures transparently.

projects.title: Extracting Block I/O Stream Representations from Filesystems
projects.summary: Investigate how filesystems such as ext4, XFS, F2FS or Btrfs transform application file operations into block I/O, and derive a minimal set of block I/O streams that captures the steady-state, SSD-relevant behavior and write amplification of each filesystem-mediated workload.

projects.title: SSD-Aware RL for Data Placement in Storage Systems
projects.summary: Reproduce a reinforcement-learning data-placement baseline on heterogeneous SSDs and extend the agent with SSD-internal signals (garbage collection, write amplification, utilization, wear) and rewards that balance performance, write amplification and wear.

projects.title: Profiling Automated Verifiers
projects.summary: Build a profiler that attributes SMT-based verifier solving time (e.g., Dafny, KLEE) across the verifier stack, distinguishes useful from useless work and brute-force search from precise reasoning, and evaluates it on real verifier performance issues.

projects.title: Improving Coverage Reliability in Cortex-M Firmware Rehosting
projects.summary: Studies how the approximations of Cortex-M firmware rehosting systems affect the reliability of coverage reported by fuzzing, and records coverage together with execution context. The project then aims to develop techniques that improve coverage-guided fuzzing of rehosted Cortex-M firmware.

projects.title: Ownership-Aware Bug Hunting in Rust Crates
projects.summary: Aims to build an ownership-aware bug detection mechanism for Rust crates that models ownership transitions induced by unsafe APIs, in order to find bugs such as double-frees that the compiler cannot enforce. The project targets nested or recursive types where bitwise copies share heap allocations.

projects.title: Dynamic wetting measurement with image analysis on synchrotron x-ray tomography data
projects.summary: Measure dynamic wetting using image analysis applied to synchrotron X-ray tomography data.

projects.title: Semester Project: X-ray reconstruction corrections for mechanics and biology
projects.summary: Develop corrections for X-ray image reconstruction for applications in mechanics and biology.

projects.title: Event detection by signal processing to characterize optical fiber
projects.summary: Detect events in optical fiber signals using signal processing to characterize the fiber.

projects.title: Improving Segment Anything (SAM) output with Spline-Based Contour Editing
projects.summary: Improve the output of the Segment Anything model by editing its segmentation contours with spline-based methods.

projects.title: Learning Molecular Anisotropic Diffusion with Self-Supervised Deep Learning
projects.summary: Learn molecular anisotropic diffusion from imaging data using self-supervised deep learning.

projects.title: 3D skin tissue analysis
projects.summary: Analyse three-dimensional skin tissue imaging data.

projects.title: Python software development for automated single-cell protein isolation with a CryoWriter
projects.summary: Develop Python software to automate single-cell protein isolation with a CryoWriter instrument.

projects.title: Interactive Visualization of Scientific Image Datasets
projects.summary: Build interactive tools to visualize large scientific image datasets.

projects.title: Deep Learning System for Automated Segmentation and Object Classification in Scientific images
projects.summary: Develop a deep learning system that automatically segments and classifies objects in scientific images.

projects.title: 3D Contact Angle Measurements and Image Analysis in Solid-Oxide Cell Materials
projects.summary: Measure 3D contact angles and analyse images of solid-oxide cell materials.

projects.title: Bringing deep-denoising into X-ray CT reconstruction
projects.summary: Integrate deep-learning denoising into X-ray computed tomography reconstruction.

projects.title: Accelerating ecological connectivity analysis with graph neural networks
projects.summary: Develop graph neural network methods that learn coarse graph embeddings of fine-scale landscape features, to make resistance-distance gene flow predictions for ecological connectivity computationally tractable. Directions include graph coarsening strategies, approximation error bounds, and validation on ecological datasets.

projects.title: High-performance differentiable AMG in JAX with GPU acceleration
projects.summary: Develop an algebraic multigrid (AMG) solver in JAX that supports automatic differentiation and GPU acceleration, for use in scientific machine learning workflows that need differentiable iterative linear solves. The work involves analysing existing pyAMG and AMG.jl implementations and designing an architecture compatible with JAX's functional and just-in-time compilation model.

projects.title: Finding Slow Components in a Graph
projects.summary: Study how many random shortest-path distance queries are needed to identify a set of vertices V_1 with much larger exponential edge weights in a weighted graph, and how the query strategy (adaptive or non-adaptive) affects this. The work includes literature review, simulations, and theoretical accuracy bounds.

projects.title: Reusable Foundations for Probabilistic Proofs in Lean
projects.summary: Develop reusable foundations in Lean, on top of Mathlib, for probability theory (Markov chains, random walks, couplings) so that probabilists can formalize their results more easily. If time allows, the library will be used to formalize a paper on random graphs and branching processes.

projects.title: Reusable Foundations for Probabilistic Proofs in Lean
projects.summary: The project aims to combine existing and new tools into a coherent framework in Lean that makes formalizing probabilistic results more accessible to probabilists. The page cites missing tools for Markov chains and couplings as a motivation.

projects.title: Finding Slow Components in a Graph
projects.summary: The project studies a simple information spreading process on a graph in which some parts transmit information more slowly than others. It asks how to recover the slow component from measured transmission speeds between vertices, and how recovery differs between random and adaptive measurement strategies.

projects.title: High-performance differentiable AMG in JAX with GPU acceleration
projects.summary: The project aims to develop a high-performance algebraic multigrid (AMG) solver in JAX that supports automatic differentiation and GPU acceleration. The solver is intended to enable gradient-based optimization in scientific machine learning applications that require large-scale linear system solves.

projects.title: Accelerating ecological connectivity analysis with graph neural networks
projects.summary: The project develops a graph neural network approach that maps fine-scale landscape features onto lower-dimensional graph representations to speed up ecological connectivity analysis. The goal is high-resolution gene flow predictions across fragmented landscapes, with applications to conservation planning.

projects.title: Development and characterization of an acoustic matched source
projects.summary: Develop a numerical scheme (FDTD / Simulink) and an experimental set-up for an acoustic matched source that uses active control of a closed-box electrodynamic loudspeaker to match its impedance, characterized at multiple harmonics and then extended to broadband matching with a corona discharge actuator.

projects.title: Enhancing Protein Design Through Advanced Graph Neural Networks
projects.summary: The project focuses on protein sequence design, creating protein sequences that perform specific functions, with advanced Graph Neural Networks used to improve design methods. Applications include drug development and bioengineering.

projects.title: Modeling translation elongation dynamics through Variational AutoEncoders
projects.summary: Model ribosome density profiles from ribosome profiling data using Variational AutoEncoders, first reconstructing the profile in one condition and then extending the decoder to take nutrient availability into account.

projects.title: Optimization of corona discharge loudspeakers
projects.summary: Identify and implement corona discharge loudspeaker configurations with improved sound radiation efficiency, aiming for a band-pass response over a wide audible band. The work combines COMSOL/analytical modelling for geometry optimisation with prototype construction and anechoic testing.

projects.title: Design of unprecedented sound sources: a dream come true with plasma loudspeakers?
projects.summary: The project aims to identify and possibly implement a purely omnidirectional corona discharge (plasma) loudspeaker configuration approximating a pulsating sphere, and to extend the approach to other canonical electroacoustic sources. It involves COMSOL and/or analytical modelling for geometry optimisation, followed by prototype construction and anechoic testing.

projects.title: 3D Sound Localization
projects.summary: Build a toolbox that simulates human auditory localization behaviour, including the effect of hearing loss, to objectively assess whether hearing aid algorithms preserve spatial hearing cues. The project also involves measuring the HRTF of a Kemar dummy head and validating the toolbox with listening tests on normal-hearing and hearing-impaired participants.

projects.title: Auditory distance perception
projects.summary: Evaluate how hearing aids affect the auditory distance perception of hearing-impaired individuals. The project involves building a listening test facility with a loudspeaker on a motorised rail, then running listening tests with normal-hearing and hearing-impaired participants.

projects.title: Exploration and improvement of a data-agnostic multimodal deep learning architecture relying on a novel fusion strategy
projects.summary: Explore, improve and propose alterations of a data-agnostic multimodal deep learning architecture based on the Perceiver model, which integrates modalities sequentially. The work includes adapting layers for efficiency or performance, researching pre-training approaches, and testing data encoding tactics and combinations with standard fusion methods.

projects.title: Development of a Graphical User Interface for Electroacoustic Absorbers
projects.summary: Develop an analytical model and Simulink control interface for an Electroacoustic Absorber, implement direct impedance control on a prototype with a Speedgoat real-time target, and deliver a stand-alone GUI for characterising the absorber in an impedance tube.

projects.title: Plasmacoustic headphones
projects.summary: Design and simulate a fully open corona-discharge (plasma) headphone with no membrane, optimising the transducer geometry with COMSOL and/or analytical models, then build prototypes and test them on an artificial ear in anechoic conditions.

projects.title: Controlling the timbre of wind instruments with active control
projects.summary: Develop a scaled prototype of an active wind instrument: a cylindrical hollow duct with a ring of active electroacoustic absorbers that alter its acoustic impedance and thus its timbre. The work combines COMSOL FEM simulations, prototype development and acoustic assessment.

projects.title: VENOVA : an actively modified cylindrical cross-saxophone
projects.summary: Design an actuator and couplings, using CAD and 3D printing, to attach to the VENOVA instrument, then model the system and apply impedance control strategies to alter its sound in a playable way. The work includes objective measurements and playing tests.

projects.title: Controlling the timbre of wind instruments with active control
projects.summary: Active control of the timbre of wind instruments, which are modelled as axisymmetric hollow ducts with varying or constant cross-section. The visible page text is truncated.

projects.title: Plasmacoustic headphones
projects.summary: Development of headphones based on the corona discharge principle, which produces a linear acoustic flow velocity source without a conventional membrane.

projects.title: Development of a Graphical User Interface for Electroacoustic Absorbers
projects.summary: Design of a graphical user interface for Electroacoustic Absorbers, which use a closed-box loudspeaker whose membrane is given a prescribed acoustic impedance.

projects.title: Exploration and improvement of a data-agnostic multimodal deep learning architecture relying on a novel fusion strategy
projects.summary: Exploration and improvement of a data-agnostic multimodal deep learning architecture that learns from multiple information channels (modalities) using a novel fusion strategy.

projects.title: Auditory distance perception
projects.summary: Study of auditory distance perception, which supports spatial awareness, object localisation and obstacle avoidance.

projects.title: 3D Sound Localization
projects.summary: Work on sound localisation in 3D space, i.e. spatial hearing, the ability to perceive where sounds come from.

projects.title: Design of unprecedented sound sources: a dream come true with plasma loudspeakers?
projects.summary: Design of a novel sound source based on a spherical geometry, which is optimal due to limited scattering, using plasma loudspeakers.

projects.title: Optimization of corona discharge loudspeakers
projects.summary: Optimization of corona discharge loudspeakers, which achieve a linear acoustic flow velocity source without a conventional membrane.

projects.title: Modeling translation elongation dynamics through Variational AutoEncoders
projects.summary: Modelling of ribosome translation elongation dynamics from ribosome profiling data, using Variational AutoEncoders to capture codon-specific ribosome dwell times.

projects.title: Enhancing Protein Design Through Advanced Graph Neural Networks
projects.summary: Use of advanced graph neural networks to improve protein design, applying machine learning to biology.

projects.title: Development and characterization of an acoustic matched source
projects.summary: Development and characterisation of an acoustic matched source based on nonlinear or time-varying systems, which extend wave engineering beyond conventional materials.

projects.title: VENOVA: an actively modified cylindrical cross-saxophone
projects.summary: Project on VENOVA, an actively modified cylindrical cross-saxophone, building on a design developed by Yamaha engineers.

projects.title: Longitudinal Brain Connectomics and Functional Fingerprinting in Chronic Tinnitus
projects.summary: Investigates how large-scale brain networks reorganize during neurofeedback treatment for chronic tinnitus. The project is offered as a semester or MSc thesis project.

projects.title: Developmental Trajectories of Perinatal Resting-State fMRI dynamics
projects.summary: Aims to investigate the maturation of brain functional dynamics during the perinatal period, for example by applying Co-Activation Pattern (CAP) analysis.

projects.title: Dynamic mode decomposition of fMRI during film watching
projects.summary: Applies dynamic mode decomposition (DMD), a latent space discovery method, to fMRI data acquired while participants watch films, to explore brain activity under naturalistic stimuli.

projects.title: Encoding and Decoding fMRI during film watching
projects.summary: Studies human brain encoding and decoding during naturalistic stimuli, namely film watching, extending earlier work on simple images.

projects.title: Community Detection in Directed (Brain) Networks
projects.summary: Aims to develop community detection for directed and asymmetric networks, such as brain networks, rather than the undirected graphs usually assumed.

projects.title: Investigating memory consolidation during sleep with functional MRI
projects.summary: Uses a dataset of lucid dreamers scanned with fMRI while learning a hand motor sequence awake and during sleep, to investigate the brain mechanisms of memory consolidation.

projects.title: Graph signal processing to investigate structure-function coupling during sleep
projects.summary: Treats fMRI signals as defined on the structural brain graph to study how functional activity emerges from anatomical fiber bundles during sleep, using graph signal processing.

projects.title: The role of the hippocampus in tracking personal goals
projects.summary: Analyses fMRI scans of healthy subjects performing specific tasks to investigate the role of the hippocampus in distinguishing goals over time.

projects.title: Biophysical Modelling of Microstructural Diffusion MRI in the Rodent Brain
projects.summary: Use advanced biophysical models of diffusion MRI to extract quantitative maps of brain microstructure in animal models of disease compared with healthy controls. Possible applications include Parkinson's disease and creatine-related conditions.

projects.title: Structural connectivity of the human brain: what can we learn from intracerebral electrophysiological recordings in epileptic patients?
projects.summary: Study the structural connectivity of the human brain using intracerebral electrophysiological recordings from epileptic patients, within a connectomics framework that represents brain data in healthy and pathological conditions.

projects.title: Unraveling the contrast mechanism of neuromelanin-sensitive MRI
projects.summary: Investigate the contrast mechanism of neuromelanin-sensitive MRI, a technique that detects pathological alterations in diseases such as Parkinson's disease and schizophrenia, and that is thought to reflect catecholaminergic function rather than neuromelanin itself.

projects.title: [Performance/eBPF] Performance Modeling of eBPF Programs
projects.summary: Design a scalable and accurate performance model for eBPF programs that can quantify per-line performance, support performance debugging, and check new programs against functionally equivalent baselines. The page calls for community focus on the performance of eBPF programs, not only their safety.

projects.title: [Systems for ML] Improving the performance of ML workloads
projects.summary: Analyze and break down the software-stack overheads of ML inference and training, within a single machine and across machines. Based on this analysis, propose optimizations that improve the performance of these systems.

projects.title: Fused decompression and decoding
projects.summary: Explore fusing decompression with decoding so that redundant content in compressed streams (e.g. gzip+JSON) is decoded once and reused through backpointers instead of being re-decoded for every repetition.

projects.title: A deduplicating file system based on content-aware chunking
projects.summary: Design a deduplicating file system that splits files into content-defined chunks so that insertions do not break deduplication, possibly on a live system. A follow-up explores normalizing binaries (e.g. jump targets) before deduplication.

projects.title: Reducing common sources of branch target aliasing
projects.summary: Explore software and hardware approaches that reduce branch-prediction aliasing in lazy-value forcing code and bytecode interpreters, for example by giving each lazy value its own branch or exposing the interpreted program counter to the hardware.

projects.title: Compressed datastructures and application-specific RAM compression
projects.summary: Investigate application-specific compression schemes for in-memory data that stay compatible with the operations performed on the decompressed data, for example compressing the two sides of an Emacs gap buffer separately.

projects.title: Abusing the instruction cache to store data
projects.summary: Encode constant data in dynamically generated code so that it occupies the instruction cache rather than the data cache, for instance by unrolling a loop that adds a constant vector with the constants as immediates.

projects.title: Code-size optimizations for keyboard macros
projects.summary: Design and implement an optimizer that suggests shorter key combinations for keyboard macros as users type, such as replacing a multi-key sequence with an equivalent single binding. Follow-ups cover ergonomic hand models and telemetry across users.

projects.title: Hierarchical rendering of separation-logic formulae
projects.summary: Turn the SepViz system into a hierarchical renderer that alternates rendering and layout and nests diagrams and formulae, so that higher-order predicates, non-prenex quantification and complex predicates in iterated separating conjunctions can be displayed.

projects.title: Mixed rendering for proof presentation
projects.summary: Design a modular constraint-solving renderer that encodes common pretty-printing and graph layout problems and uses it to render proof goals mixing several domains, with a notation mechanism in Rocq and rendering close to previous goals for continuity.

projects.title: The user experience of mechanized diagram-chasing proofs
projects.summary: Build lightweight mockups of scripted interactions to explore layout algorithms, incremental re-layout, and representation choices for diagrams in diagram-chasing proofs within a proof assistant.

projects.title: A proof-friendly representation of hardware circuits
projects.summary: Design or identify a circuit representation that is easy to reason about in Rocq, to retarget the Kôika compiler and reduce its trusted base, and explore module representations including linking theorems.

projects.title: Hindley-Milner for Rocq
projects.summary: Explore adding Hindley-Milner style generalization of type variables to Rocq's type inference for simple non-dependently typed definitions such as map, and study how this approach fails.

projects.title: Early reclamation for lazy values in Scala
projects.summary: Change the JVM backend of the Scala compiler to null out stack variables right after their last use so that lazy lists are not pinned in memory, with a follow-up on avoiding leaks in iterators and coroutines.

projects.title: Better unification
projects.summary: Make Rocq's unification errors more eager by pinpointing where a naive unification attempt fails, instead of rejecting the whole goal against a lemma.

projects.title: Single-step eauto
projects.summary: Implement an eauto_one tactic for Rocq that applies a single lemma from a given hint database matching the current goal, to replace a complicated typeclasses eauto and shelve trick for forward reasoning.

projects.title: An Alectryon backend for coqdoc
projects.summary: Write a coqdoc backend that generates Alectryon documents, making it easier to switch between the two documentation tools for Rocq.

projects.title: Printing with sharing
projects.summary: Add a Rocq printing option similar to Lisp's *print-circle* that shows term sharing, to make it easier to debug term size and memory usage in performance issues.

projects.title: Profiling automated verifiers
projects.summary: Build a profiler that attributes SMT solving time across the verifier stack (e.g. symbolic executor and SMT solver) and identifies redundant solver work such as useless quantifier instantiations, evaluated on real verifier performance issues.

projects.title: A different kind of performance profiler
projects.summary: Design a profiler that uses memory snapshots and taint tracking to flag redundant or unused computations, reporting how many distinct results each function computes and whether its results are used, to suggest memoization or removal.

projects.title: Cross-language editing and debugging
projects.summary: Write a translator from a legacy language such as COBOL into readable, idiomatic Python so that standard Python tools can be used, together with a reverse translator that back-propagates changes to the source.

projects.title: Deriving tools from annotated grammars
projects.summary: Enhance a parser generator such as Menhir to accept indentation and other annotations, so that one grammar drives syntax highlighting, indentation, structural editing and folding, with error recovery for partial programs.

projects.title: Does semantic versioning work?
projects.summary: Study whether human-assigned version numbers follow semantic versioning, using static API diffs and downstream test breakage to check version increments in software ecosystems.

projects.title: What performance do compiler updates buy you?
projects.summary: Compile historical programs with successive versions of a compiler such as GCC to measure runtime gains and compilation cost, with a follow-up on which optimizations speed up compiling the compiler itself.

projects.title: Fixing reStructuredText
projects.summary: Design and implement a conservative extension of reStructuredText that supports nesting of inline constructs and reduces the need for heavy indentation of long text blocks.

projects.title: A collaborative document-annotation system based on reStructuredText
projects.summary: Extend reStructuredText with inline annotations and discussions that remain robust to changes in the document, keeping a single source of truth.

projects.title: Add post-macro-expansion mode to latexdiff
projects.summary: Patch latexdiff to expand simple custom LaTeX macros before running its diff algorithm, so that changes inside macro expansions are shown rather than only macro invocations.

projects.title: Static-checking RPG quests
projects.summary: Use automated program verification to prove reachability, liveness and linearity properties of role-playing game quests written in modding languages, to detect bugs such as stuck quests or rewards obtained twice.

projects.title: PCP encoding for Rocq's VM
projects.summary: Investigate a probabilistically checkable proof (PCP) encoding of traces of Rocq's virtual machine, so that a claimed proof reduction can be verified cheaply.

projects.title: Alectryon ports to new proof languages
projects.summary: Extend Alectryon to support additional proof languages and protocols beyond Rocq and Lean, such as F* and HOL-light, building on existing EasyCrypt support.

projects.title: Joint Master's Thesis with Empa – Spring 2027
projects.summary: A joint Master's thesis opening with Dr. Michael Stuer at Empa. The details are in a PDF on the page, and the work and supervision will mainly take place at Empa.

projects.title: Characterization of bone-tissue scaffolds
projects.summary: Explore the mineralization of hydrogels printed via tomographic volumetric additive manufacturing (TVAM) or digital light processing (DLP) printing, for bone-tissue scaffolds.

projects.title: Printing of hollow metal structures
projects.summary: Develop a method of fabricating hollow metal structures via digital light processing (DLP) printing.

projects.title: Sustainable metal sheet "printing"
projects.summary: Establish a proof-of-concept method for the polymer-derived fabrication of sheet metal.
skills: wet lab experience (required for ALCHEMY master projects)

projects.title: Double network semicrystalline polymers
projects.summary: Develop double network polymers based on ring-opening metathesis polymerization (ROMP).
skills: wet lab experience (required for ALCHEMY master projects)

projects.title: Evaluation of Single-Photon Detector for Elementary Particle Tracking
projects.summary: Evaluation of single-photon detectors for tracking elementary particles. The topic is listed both as a master project and as a semester project.

projects.title: RTL-to-GDS flow for Superconducting Electronic Circuits
projects.summary: Development of an RTL-to-GDS design flow for superconducting electronic circuits.

projects.title: Adaptive Digital Control and Self-Optimizing Calibration Architecture for Superconducting Qubit Systems
projects.summary: Design of an adaptive digital control and self-optimizing calibration architecture for superconducting qubit systems.

projects.title: Enhancing Superconducting Detectors by Improved Fabrication Procedures – Characterisation
projects.summary: Characterisation of superconducting detectors fabricated with improved fabrication procedures.

projects.title: Cryogenic Transistor Model for CMOS Electronics Used in Quantum Applications
projects.summary: Development of a cryogenic transistor model for CMOS electronics used in quantum applications.

projects.title: ML-based Parameter Extraction for Cryogenic Transistor Compact Models
projects.summary: Using machine learning to extract parameters for cryogenic transistor compact models. The topic is listed both as a master project and as a semester project.

projects.title: GPU implementation of bi-exponential decay in FLIM for real time assistance in cancer cell localization
projects.summary: GPU implementation of bi-exponential decay fitting for fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), to assist cancer cell localization in real time.

projects.title: Towards real time monitoring of brain oxygenation for premature born infants
projects.summary: Work towards real-time monitoring of brain oxygenation in premature newborn infants.

projects.title: Towards real time monitoring of blood oxygenation in human body through Time Domain Diffuse Correlations Spectroscopy
projects.summary: Work towards real-time monitoring of blood oxygenation in the human body using Time Domain Diffuse Correlation Spectroscopy.

projects.title: System development of a real-time quantum distillation imager
projects.summary: System development of a real-time quantum distillation imager.

projects.title: Test of a Photo Diode for the Swiss Light Source 2.0
projects.summary: Testing of a photodiode for the Swiss Light Source 2.0 synchrotron.

projects.title: RTL implementation for real time FLIM measurements
projects.summary: RTL implementation of hardware for real-time fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM) measurements.

projects.title: Ultra-Low Dead-Time SPADs: Chip Testing and Characterization
projects.summary: Chip testing and characterisation of ultra-low dead-time single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs).

projects.title: Low-cost cryogenic infrastructure
projects.summary: Development of low-cost infrastructure for cryogenic experiments.

projects.title: Mapping and scheduling Quantum Circuits on Distributed Cores with Logical Qubits
projects.summary: Mapping and scheduling of quantum circuits on distributed cores using logical qubits.

projects.title: RTL implementation for real time FLIM measurements
projects.summary: Implement the phasor-based FLIM lifetime computation (pile-up correction, background correction, phasor calculation, IRF deconvolution, lifetime calculation) in RTL on a Xilinx FPGA for real-time processing of SwissSPAD2 sensor data. The student would use Vivado High Level Synthesis to translate C/C++ into VHDL/Verilog.

projects.title: System development of a real-time quantum distillation imager
projects.summary: Develop a real-time quantum distillation imaging system by synchronizing two SwissSPAD2 single-photon avalanche diode cameras. The work includes PCB design to merge the two cameras' PCIe interfaces, RTL design on a Xilinx FPGA for correlation processing, and streaming the merged signal to a GPU over PCIe 3.0.

projects.title: Test of a Photo Diode for the Swiss Light Source 2.0
projects.summary: Characterise a 50 GHz photodiode and its amplifier and bandpass filter chain, set it up with a picosecond laser, and measure its instrument response. The goal is to assess whether measuring the frequency content in different bands can determine the length of electron pulses in the Swiss Light Source 2.0 storage ring.

projects.title: Towards real time monitoring of blood oxygenation in human body through Time Domain Diffuse Correlations Spectroscopy
projects.summary: The student will update an existing FPGA design to compute the g2 algorithm in real time for time-domain diffuse correlation spectroscopy (TD-DCS) using the Piccolo Gated 32x32 SPAD sensor. The student will also build the optical setup and run experiments on a phantom mimicking human brain blood flow.

projects.title: Towards real time monitoring of brain oxygenation for premature born infants
projects.summary: The project aims to bring SPAD camera technology to real-time monitoring of brain oxygenation in premature babies, in collaboration with UZH. The student updates an FPGA design of the Piccolo Gated 32x32 TCSPC SPAD sensor to add DNL correction, after-pulse reduction and HDR enhancement, and applies reconstruction algorithms to image objects hidden beneath a phantom.

projects.title: GPU implementation of bi-exponential decay in FLIM for real time assistance in cancer cell localization
projects.summary: Develop a GPU implementation of a GRU-based neural network that extracts bi-exponential fluorescence lifetime values from SwissSPAD2 SPAD sensor data for real-time FRET FLIM imaging, to assist in localizing cancer cells.

projects.title: Cryogenic Transistor Model for CMOS Electronics Used in Quantum Applications
projects.summary: Develop a SPICE-compatible compact model of transistors (extending the simplified EKV model) that captures their behaviour at room temperature and 4 K, implemented in Verilog-A and validated against measurements. The work covers extending the model to AC/RF, parameter extraction, Ngspice simulations, and documentation.

projects.title: ML-based Parameter Extraction for Cryogenic Transistor Compact Models
projects.summary: Develop a machine-learning algorithm to automatically and efficiently extract parameters of the sEKV transistor compact model, usable across model versions. The work targets cryogenic 22 nm FDSOI devices and includes verification with room-temperature PDK simulations and experimental cryogenic data.

projects.title: Enhancing Superconducting Detectors by Improved Fabrication Procedures - Characterisation
projects.summary: Characterise new fabrication techniques for superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) by building cryogenic test infrastructure and testing a range of devices, then use the conclusions to propose improved detector fabrication strategies.

projects.title: Low-cost Cryogenic Infrastructure
projects.summary: Develop low-cost, open-source electronics to read out and control commercial cryostats (Gifford-McMahon, pulse-tube and sorption coolers reaching below 1 K), along with mechanical interface components for attaching apparatus to the cryostat.

projects.title: Mapping and scheduling Quantum Circuits on Distributed Cores with Logical Qubits
projects.summary: Study the mapping and scheduling of quantum circuits on distributed quantum cores hosting logical qubits, with attention to inter-core CNOTs and T gates. The work uses STIM to simulate stabilizers and analyse error levels for different code distances, and to study decoder placement and timing constraints; it is a follow-up to earlier preliminary work.

projects.title: Adaptive Digital Control and Self-Optimizing Calibration Architecture for Superconducting Qubit Systems
projects.summary: Design a fully digital FPGA (or ASIC) control architecture for superconducting qubits that combines a DDS-based pulse generation engine with an autonomous calibration sequencer and an online learning algorithm. The goal is to continuously optimise qubit control fidelity while reducing hardware resource use, validated on a transmon qubit system with a Zurich Instruments SHFQC readout backend.

projects.title: RTL-to-GDS flow for Superconducting Electronic Circuits
projects.summary: Develop a full RTL-to-GDS design toolset for digital circuits in single flux quantum (SFQ) superconducting technology, covering logic synthesis, routing and timing analysis. The work includes setting up the flow in the Synopsys toolset, with LVS and DRC checks, and later integrating the lab's own standard cell designs.

projects.title: Ultra-Low Dead-Time SPADs: Chip Testing and Characterization
projects.summary: Experimental validation and characterization of low-dead-time Bolt SPAD chips on fabricated silicon, including light-emission checks, breadboard testing with an oscilloscope, room and cold temperature tests, radiation robustness, and testing under different photon rates.

projects.title: Evaluation of Single-Photon Detector for Elementary Particle Tracking
projects.summary: Characterize and evaluate state-of-the-art CMOS single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) devices through experiments and simulations, to better understand the physical mechanisms behind SPAD behaviour for use in particle detectors as alternatives to SiPMs.

projects.title: Masters project: AI-based generative approaches for de novo protein design
projects.summary: Develop diffusion generative models to design de novo proteins with specific biomedical applications. The student would help integrate physics-based loss functions into an existing deep learning framework for protein design.

projects.title: Microfluidic Tear Sampling for Alzheimer's Biomarker Detection
projects.summary: Develop a microfluidic system for sampling tears to detect Alzheimer's disease biomarkers. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Printed Electrodes Fabrication for Alzheimer's Biomarker Detection
projects.summary: Fabricate printed electrodes by screen printing for detecting Alzheimer's disease biomarkers. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Electrochemical Aptamer Biosensors for Alzheimer's Biomarker Detection
projects.summary: Develop electrochemical biosensors based on aptamers to detect Alzheimer's disease biomarkers. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Soft Multi-Modal Biosensing Patch for Continuous Physiological Vitals Monitoring
projects.summary: Design a soft, multi-modal biosensing patch for continuous monitoring of physiological vital signs. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Next-Generation Silicon Nanowire Biosensor for Cancer Marker Detection
projects.summary: Develop a silicon nanowire biosensor for detecting cancer markers. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: CMOS design for vision restoring by cortex stimulation
projects.summary: Design CMOS circuits for a vision restoration system based on electrical stimulation of the visual cortex. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Challenges in sub-millimetric Neurostimulators Wirelessly Powered via highly efficient Inductive Links
projects.summary: Address design challenges of sub-millimetre neurostimulators powered wirelessly through efficient inductive links. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: 3D microelectrode for ultra-miniaturized neural implant
projects.summary: Develop a 3D microelectrode integrated into an ultra-miniaturized neural implant. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Body Dust: CMOS Design for Remote Powering by Electromagn. Coupling
projects.summary: Design CMOS circuits for remote powering of miniature devices through electromagnetic coupling. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: NPK Sensor: How to Detect NPK in the Soil
projects.summary: Develop a sensor to detect nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium (NPK) content in soil. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Optimization of Schottky Barrier Formation for Reconfigurable Field Effect Transistors (RFETs)
projects.summary: Optimize the formation of Schottky barriers in reconfigurable field-effect transistors (RFETs). Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Lab-on-chip (LOC) based on memristive biosensor for project "in-memory sensing"
projects.summary: Develop a lab-on-chip based on a memristive biosensor for in-memory sensing. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Oscillatory Neuristor Based on SiNW Unipolar Memristor: Circuit Design & ODE Modeling
projects.summary: Design an oscillatory neuristor circuit based on a silicon nanowire unipolar memristor and model it with ordinary differential equations. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Energy-learning based on volatile memristor
projects.summary: Investigate energy-learning mechanisms based on volatile memristors. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Optimization of Schottky Barrier Formation for Reconfigurable Field Effect Transistors (RFETs)
projects.summary: The project aims to optimize annealing conditions (temperature profile, ramp rate, duration, atmosphere) for forming Schottky barriers between metals such as Ni or Al and silicon nanowires in reconfigurable FETs. The student would fabricate and characterize structural and electrical properties of the devices to derive guidelines for robust contacts.

projects.title: Microfluidic Tear Sampling for Alzheimer's Biomarker Detection
projects.summary: Design and build a passive microfluidic chip that collects tear samples for Alzheimer's diagnostics. The work covers capillary-driven flow simulation, low-cost scalable material selection and prototype fabrication, and testing of tear collection against simulation predictions.

projects.title: Printed Electrodes Fabrication for Alzheimer's Biomarker Detection
projects.summary: Develop scalable fabrication of biosensor electrodes using printing techniques such as screen-printing and inkjet printing. The work covers electrode design and material selection, a comparison of printing processes, and optimization of the best process for reproducible, medium-scale electrode fabrication.

projects.title: Electrochemical Aptamer Biosensors for Alzheimer's Biomarker Detection
projects.summary: Develop point-of-care electrochemical aptamer biosensors for Alzheimer's biomarkers. The 6-month project covers sensor functionalization and characterization, dose-response and calibration, and selectivity and specificity testing against interfering molecules.

projects.title: Metasurface-enhanced infrared spectroscopy for biochemical sensing applications
projects.summary: Develops infrared metasurfaces for surface-enhanced infrared absorption (SEIRA) spectroscopy to enable highly sensitive, multiplexed detection of bioanalytes in aqueous conditions and high-resolution mid-IR tissue imaging. The work also targets large-scale manufacturability for lab-on-chip and point-of-care devices.

projects.title: Label-free nanophotonic biosensing for spatiotemporal analysis of live-cell and tumoroid dynamics
projects.summary: Contributes to a platform based on plasmonic nanohole arrays and dielectric metasurfaces, integrated with microfluidics, to detect secreted biomolecules from single cells and tumoroids in real time. The goal is to study signalling dynamics for precision diagnostics, therapy monitoring and disease mechanisms.

projects.title: Self-illuminating plasmonic biosensors
projects.summary: Develops self-illuminating plasmonic biosensors based on metal-insulator-metal tunnel junctions that emit light through inelastic electron tunneling. The project covers design and nanofabrication of metasurface-based junctions, optical characterization of their emission, and biofunctionalization for selective analyte detection.

projects.title: Regulation of natural competence and type VI secretion in Vibrio cholerae and non-cholera Vibrios
projects.summary: Master thesis project on how natural competence and the type VI secretion system are regulated in Vibrio cholerae and related non-cholera Vibrios. The page links it to prior work on horizontal gene transfer mediated by type VI secretion.

projects.title: Reservoir computing for robust generation of complex temporal patterns
projects.summary: Study the robustness of reservoir computing networks to single or multiple fault events and parameter variations. The project develops a reservoir model, fault models and a strategy to counter faults, and analyses results on various waveforms.

projects.title: An Integrator-Differentiator Transimpedance Amplifier for Nanopore Sensing Systems
projects.summary: Design a low-noise, highly linear integrator-differentiator transimpedance amplifier for nanopore sensing readout and verify it by transistor-level simulations in CMOS.

projects.title: A Low-Power Multi-Channel Front-End Circuit for Biological Recording Systems
projects.summary: Design a low-power 8-channel recording front-end in which some blocks, such as the ADC, are shared between channels, and verify it by transistor-level simulations.

projects.title: A Non-binary Search Successive Approximation Analog-to-Digital Converter for Biological Recording Systems
projects.summary: Design a highly linear, power-efficient non-binary search successive approximation ADC for biomedical and life-science applications, verified by pre- and post-layout simulations.

projects.title: A High-Resolution Delta-Sigma ADC for Sensor-Interface Applications
projects.summary: Design a high-resolution, low-power first- or second-order delta-sigma ADC for life-science sensor interfaces, verified by pre- and post-layout transistor-level simulations.

projects.title: A Low-Power Digital Winner-Take-All (WTA) Circuit
projects.summary: Design a low-power digital winner-take-all circuit that identifies the largest input among several and verify it by transistor-level simulations.

projects.title: A High-Effectiveness Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting Interface Circuit
projects.summary: Design a piezoelectric energy harvesting interface circuit that stays efficient under varying vibration intensity, verified by transistor-level simulations.

projects.title: A Board-Level Energy Harvesting Interface Circuits
projects.summary: Design and implement a board-level piezoelectric energy harvesting interface that performs maximum power point tracking, and verify it by measurements.

projects.title: Design and implementation of a digital reservoir computing system
projects.summary: Develop a digital processor dedicated to efficient reservoir computing, with a study of topology and architecture and a prototype on an FPGA.

projects.title: Patient-specific implantable detection of seizure
projects.summary: Develop an FPGA-based processor with adaptable feature extractors and classifiers for patient-specific seizure detection in an implantable closed-loop stimulation system, including a test methodology.

projects.title: A Board-Level Switched-Capacitor Stimulation Circuit
projects.summary: Design and implement an energy-efficient switched-capacitor stimulation circuit at board level and verify it by measurements.

projects.title: A Multi-Phase High-Frequency Switched-Capacitor Neuro-Stimulation Circuit
projects.summary: Design an implantable, energy-efficient switched-capacitor neuro-stimulation circuit that avoids large off-chip capacitors, verified by transistor-level simulations.

projects.title: Wireless Power Transfer for Ventricular Assist Devices (VADs) and Total Artificial Heart Systems (TAHs)
projects.summary: Design and optimise an inductive wireless power transfer link to supply implanted cardiac assist devices, studying coil geometry, frequency, coupling and compensation through electromagnetic and circuit simulations, with an optional prototype.

projects.title: Wireless Power Transfer for Implantable Pacemakers at 2 GHz
projects.summary: Design and optimise a microwave wireless power transfer link at about 2 GHz with compact antennas (coils) for powering an implantable pacemaker, evaluated by full-wave simulations and possibly a prototype.

projects.title: Design of a Microwave Class-E Power Amplifier with Microstrip-Line-Based RF Networks for Wireless Power Transfer Applications
projects.summary: Design and optimise a microwave Class-E power amplifier, around 2 GHz, with microstrip-line matching networks for wireless power transfer, evaluated by circuit-level simulations.

projects.title: Self-Supervised fine-tuning of DNN in Edge AI processor
projects.summary: Industrial project with IMEC Holst Center (Neuromorphic Group) on self-supervised fine-tuning of deep neural networks on an edge AI processor.

projects.title: Event-based (Neuromorphic) radar signal encodings
projects.summary: Industrial project with IMEC Holst Center (Neuromorphic Group) on encoding radar signals in an event-based, neuromorphic form.

projects.title: Internship at Lumiphase AG, Firmware and electronics development
projects.summary: Firmware and electronics development project at Lumiphase AG, offered as an MSc diploma project or an internship.

projects.title: Peripherals for an FPGA development environment
projects.summary: Create virtual analog and digital peripherals (accelerometer, VGA, UART) for the DE10-Lite FPGA board and integrate them into the logisim-evolution design flow, with a PC graphical environment for displaying sensor data.

projects.title: Peripherals for a AVR STK-300 environment
projects.summary: Develop assembly-level software libraries for additional peripheral boards of the AVR STK-300 microcontroller system, plus a PC graphical environment for displaying MCU sensor data sent over UART.

projects.title: Regulation of metastatic dormancy in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer
projects.summary: The project aims to identify global regulators of epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) and metastatic dormancy in HR+ breast cancer using the MIND model. The student would gain experience with in vitro cell culture, ex vivo models and molecular biology techniques.

projects.title: Optimizing an ex vivo assay for testing hormone and drug response in hormone-sensitive breast cancer
projects.summary: The project proposes a biomaterial-based 3D system to test hormone and drug sensitivity of patient-derived xenografts and patient tumour biopsies, to support tailored endocrine therapy. The student would learn to encapsulate tumours in biomaterials and assess gene and protein expression.

projects.title: Beyond Estrogen: The Overlooked Role of Androgens in normal breast epithelium and breast cancer
projects.summary: The project investigates androgen receptor signalling in normal human breast epithelium and in breast cancer development, including the effects of testosterone and androgenic versus antiandrogenic progestins. The student would work with patient samples, patient-derived xenografts and mice.

projects.title: Towers and apartment blocks: understanding the verticalisation of Dakar, Kigali or Luanda (VERTICAF project)
projects.summary: Master's project topic on the growth and verticalisation of African cities, studying high-rise towers and apartment blocks in Dakar, Kigali or Luanda. It is part of the VERTICAF project.

projects.title: Living in informal neighbourhoods: density, health and basic services
projects.summary: Master's project topic on informal neighbourhoods in African cities, addressing density, health and access to basic services.

projects.title: Building with risk: flash floods and urban design in Kinshasa (DIGIKIN project)
projects.summary: Master's project topic on designing urban space in Kinshasa in relation to flash-flood risk. It is linked to the DIGIKIN project.

projects.title: Modern African heritage: documenting and designing (linked to WikiArchi)
projects.summary: Master's project topic on documenting and designing with modern African architectural heritage. It is linked to WikiArchi.

projects.title: Tours et immeubles : comprendre la verticalisation de Dakar, Kigali ou Luanda (projet VERTICAF)
projects.summary: Student project studying the vertical growth of African cities, using Dakar, Kigali or Luanda as case studies, within the VERTICAF project.

projects.title: Habiter les quartiers informels : densité, santé et services de base
projects.summary: Student project on informal neighbourhoods, focusing on density, health and access to basic services.

projects.title: Construire avec le risque : crues éclair et projet urbain à Kinshasa (projet DIGIKIN)
projects.summary: Student project on designing urban projects in Kinshasa that take flash-flood risk into account, within the DIGIKIN project.

projects.title: Patrimoine moderne africain : documenter et projeter (en lien avec WikiArchi)
projects.summary: Student project on documenting modern African architectural heritage and proposing future uses for it, in connection with WikiArchi.

projects.title: Project 1: Soil formation and sediment transport (semester project)
projects.summary: Examines how soil formation and depth-dependent sediment transport interact to control soil thickness and hillslope morphology over geologic timescales.

projects.title: Project 1: Nonlinear and nonlocal sediment transport in steep mountainous landscapes (master thesis)
projects.summary: Explores nonlinear and nonlocal sediment transport in steep terrain through 1D and 2D simulations with far-from-equilibrium transport laws, and their effects on erosion rates, hillslope morphology and long-term landscape evolution.

projects.title: Project 2: Rainfall, surface water and landscape evolution (semester project)
projects.summary: Learn landscape evolution modelling and run simulations with an efficient surface-water solver, comparing predicted river widths with river widths measured from digital elevation models using GIS, then tuning model parameters to reproduce observed landscape properties.

projects.title: Project 2: Rainfall variability and river network evolution (master thesis)
projects.summary: Investigates how the intensity and duration of short-term rainfall variability, with intense storms separated by dry periods, influence river network formation and long-term topographic evolution.

projects.title: Reconstructing long-term river organic carbon dynamics using machine learning
projects.summary: Uses an existing dataset of 53 catchments to reconstruct river total organic carbon time series from sparse observations with machine learning (LSTM, random forest and seasonal regression), and to assess long-term trends.

projects.title: Soil erosion and deposition effects on carbon and vegetation across climates and ecosystems: a multi-site modeling study (PDM and semester project)
projects.summary: Applies the 1D T&C-BG-Erosion ecohydrological model at multiple sites along a climatic gradient to assess how erosion and deposition affect soil organic carbon, nutrients and vegetation productivity across climates and ecosystems.

projects.title: Cover crops as an adaptation strategy: designing future climate and management scenarios
projects.summary: Identifies combinations of irrigation and management under future climate scenarios that keep cover crops beneficial for both crop yield and soil organic carbon, by running the T&C-crop model at existing sites.

projects.title: Thirsty computing: Scenario planning for data centre water risk (Project at IMD Business School)
projects.summary: Builds a scenario-based framework to assess water-related risk for data centre portfolios under climate and demand uncertainty, comparing planning strategies under hydroclimatic and water-supply scenarios.

projects.title: Aptamer-Modified Nanopipettes
projects.summary: Development of nanopipettes functionalised with aptamers, which are short single-stranded nucleic acid binders used for molecular recognition and sensing.

projects.title: Structure-Switching Aptamer Characterization
projects.summary: Characterisation of structure-switching aptamers, i.e. nucleic acid probes that change conformation upon binding a target.

projects.title: Focal Molography
projects.summary: Work on focal molography, a label-free optical biosensing technique for detecting biomolecular interactions.

projects.title: Aptamer-Based Lateral Flow Assays
projects.summary: Development of lateral flow assays, paper-based rapid tests, that use aptamers as the molecular recognition elements.

projects.title: Nanostructured DNA-Protein Architectures for Biosensing
projects.summary: Design structural DNA-protein architectures for sensitive detection of biomarker targets. The student screens architecture designs and characterizes their functional interactions using optical readout methods.

projects.title: Bioconjugation Strategies for Functional Molecular Probes
projects.summary: Optimize bioconjugation reaction conditions to obtain controlled stoichiometry in DNA-protein conjugates used for biomolecular sensing. The student works on protein biochemistry, molecular characterization and gel electrophoresis.

projects.title: DNA Nanotechnology for Spatial Biochemical Sensing
projects.summary: Engineer custom DNA molecular switches for localized biochemical monitoring and characterize their responsiveness with fluorescence-based assays.

projects.title: Neurotransmitter Sensing using Organic Transistors
projects.summary: Build new designs and configurations of organic electrochemical transistors (OECTs) to measure neurotransmitters for biosensing and neurotechnology applications.

projects.title: Separation of primary cell adipocytes by Deterministic Lateral Displacement
projects.summary: Develop a novel Deterministic Lateral Displacement (DLD) microfluidic platform to sort primary adipocytes from human tissue biopsies, adapting an existing lab device and optimising tissue digestion and pre-processing. The work is carried out jointly with the Naveiras group at UNIL.

projects.title: Development of a DLD-Based Platform for Enrichment of Cell-Cell Pairs
projects.summary: Develop a Deterministic Lateral Displacement (DLD) microfluidic platform to label-free enrich cell-cell doublets, building on an existing lab device. The work covers redesigning the array geometry and sorting size, minimizing shear-induced disruption, and validating enrichment efficiency and doublet integrity against FACS-based protocols.

projects.title: Analog waveform generation for future Point-of-Care Dielectrophoretic devices
projects.summary: Design a compact, programmable multi-channel analog waveform generator for the control signals of a 3D-micropillar dielectrophoresis (DEP) platform. The target is at least 6 channels covering 10 kHz to 30 MHz (ideally up to 50 MHz) and 1 V to 40 V, with a literature review, electromagnetic simulations of electrode traces, circuit design, firmware, and validation in DEP particle separation experiments.

projects.title: Evaluating the Biological Impact of Electric Fields in Microfluidic Cell Manipulation Platforms
projects.summary: The project investigates the biological effects of electric-field exposure on mammalian cells in microfluidic electrokinetic platforms, such as electrorotation and dielectrophoresis devices. The student will develop fluorescence-based assays to monitor cell viability, apoptosis, ROS generation and thermal effects before, during and after field exposure.

projects.title: Effect of Ca2+ flux on Bicc1 protein interactions
projects.summary: Assess how Ca2+/CaMKII signaling affects Bicc1 self-polymerization and other protein-protein interactions involved in metabolic regulation, using proteomics and imaging. The work is linked to polycystic kidney disease, where Bicc1 mutations cause renal cysts.

projects.title: Dynamics of cytoplasmic Bicc1 self-polymers
