projects.summary: Image fluorescent, photoconvertible Bicc1 fusion proteins in cultured renal epithelial cells to determine the dynamics of their self-association and how interacting mRNAs and proteins regulate them.

projects.title: Role of Bicc1 as an RNA chaperone
projects.summary: Test whether Bicc1 acts as an mRNA chaperone that controls access of miRNAs and other regulatory factors to target sites masked in stable RNA hairpins, using recombinant purified Bicc1 and mutant derivatives in cell-free assays.

projects.title: Assessment of Reinforced Concrete Structures by fib Model-Code 2020
projects.summary: Assess structural elements designed according to the CEB-FIP Model Code 1978 (fib bulletin 144), such as a post-tensioned box-girder road bridge, using the fib Model Code 2020 design tools and its different levels of approximation. The project compares past and current code verifications and designs cost-effective retrofits where needed to comply with current prescriptions.

projects.title: Automatic Recognition of Molecular Motifs
projects.summary: Translate the existing FORTRAN implementation of PAMM, a clustering technique for recurring molecular structural motifs, into modern scikit-learn-style Python modules within the scikit-cosmo package.

projects.title: Auto-Correlation Analysis of Atomistic Simulations
projects.summary: Extend and generalise the COSMO toolbox, a C++ library for efficient autocorrelation analysis, into a modular package that can interface with popular molecular simulation codes. Autocorrelation is used to de-correlate order parameters and to monitor time-dependent quantities such as diffusion coefficients and hydrogen-bond lifetimes.

projects.title: Visualizing structure-property relations in materials
projects.summary: Work with chemiscope, an online tool for exploring materials and molecular databases, by adding features, implementing data analytics on structural data, and applying the tool to computational materials discovery problems.

projects.title: Advanced atomistic simulations: theory and implementation
projects.summary: Study, benchmark and document one of the methods implemented in the i-PI universal force engine for atomistic materials simulations. Suited to students with little background in atomistic modelling and programming.

projects.title: A universal engine for the calculation of structural properties of materials
projects.summary: Extend the i-PI Python interface so that it can perform routine and advanced calculations of structural material properties such as equilibrium geometry and elastic constants, making these algorithms available to any energy and force engine.

projects.title: Making molecular dynamics more efficient
projects.summary: The project aims to bridge the gap between the very short integration time step of molecular dynamics and the much longer time scales of phenomena such as chemical reactions and phase transitions. It will investigate either correlated-noise Langevin dynamics to explore configuration space more efficiently, or adapting the simulation time step to the different time scales present in the system.

projects.title: Crevasse-Climbing Robot for Alpine Environments
projects.summary: Redesign and experimentally validate a robot that climbs inside crevasses, improving mass distribution, adding a stabilisation mechanism against drift, and tolerating non-parallel walls. The final goal is a field-capable prototype demonstrated in a real Alpine crevasse.

projects.title: Mechanical Design of an Underactuated Hand with Integrated Variable Stiffness Actuation
projects.summary: Design and 3D-print a compact underactuated finger or hand that integrates series and parallel variable stiffness actuator layouts, with springs, tendon routing and motors packaged within hand size limits. The work includes CAD sizing and prototype characterisation.

projects.title: Port-Hamiltonian Virtual Model Control of a Soft Arm with Learned Passive Dynamics
projects.summary: Learn the configuration-dependent dynamics of a tendon-driven soft arm with a passivity-preserving port-Hamiltonian neural model, then optimise the virtual model control parameters on the learned model. The approach is validated on reaching and contact tasks against hand-tuned baselines.

projects.title: Robotic data center maintenance, Imitation learning
projects.summary: Train a robotic arm to perform data center maintenance tasks, starting with hard-drive swaps on a mock server rack. Demonstrations are collected by teleoperation and imitation learning policies are trained from visual observations, then validated on a real robot.

projects.title: Robotic functional testing of surgical instruments
projects.summary: Automate the functional pass/fail testing of surgical instruments with a robotic arm that actuates each tool and uses force, torque and camera data. A machine learning layer will classify healthy versus worn instruments.

projects.title: Rail switching in a multi-robot system: transfer mechanism design and fleet path allocation
projects.summary: Design and prototype a mechanical switch that moves rail carriages between rails at a junction, and develop a planning layer that allocates routes to the fleet without collisions or deadlocks. Validation is done on the lab's rail robot platform.

projects.title: Lati-gami Heart, a Programmable Soft Robotic Heart Simulator for Valve Repair and Pathology Studies
projects.summary: Build a soft robotic heart simulator from origami structures and programmable 3D-printed lattices, whose disease state can be programmed to study cardiac pathologies and test heart valve repair strategies in vitro.

projects.title: Lattice Trunk, an Elephant-Inspired Soft Manipulator that Bends, Twists and Feels
projects.summary: Develop an elephant-trunk-inspired soft manipulator printed as one piece of programmable lattice, with embedded sensing for contact, pressure and shear. The trunk will be mounted on a tendon-driven base and used for wrapping, pinching and picking tasks.
skills: motors and sensors (Dynamixel, ESP32/Arduino) a plus

projects.title: Programmable thermochromic skin with sensorimotor control
projects.summary: Develop a multi-modal artificial skin with integrated sensing (color, temperature, proprioception) and programmable thermochromic heating, for robot-environment interaction and wearable gloves. The project covers electronics, sensor interfacing and data acquisition.

projects.title: Chewing Robot with Sensorimotor, CPG and EMG Control
projects.summary: Control a 6-DOF chewing robot (mouth, jaw and teeth) to reproduce human chewing movements, monitored with force sensors and cameras. The project includes CPG and PID control and EMG signal processing, with possible integration of artificial saliva and a soft tongue.

projects.title: Robotic Tongue and Lip-Dependent Speech Expression
projects.summary: Design a soft robotic oral cavity with a tongue that can replicate human tongue motions to produce articulate speech sounds, coordinated with lip expression. The work includes robot design, actuator and sensor integration, and sound data analysis.

projects.title: Tendon-driven Soft Robotic Stomach
projects.summary: Design and prototype a minimalistic tendon-driven soft robotic stomach that reproduces the mechanical motions of human digestion, based on a review of existing artificial stomach designs.

projects.title: First simulations with the new community snow model (“Helmut”)
projects.summary: Execute first simulations with Helmut, the new French/Swiss land surface model being developed by CEN (Météo-France) and SLF Davos, and compare its results with the state-of-the-art SNOWPACK model. The work takes place at SLF Davos.

projects.title: Modeling blowing snow events in the Arctic
projects.summary: Use the CRYOWRF model, with blowing-snow equations coupled to SNOWPACK, to study how blowing snow particles are transported and influence cloud microphysics and sea salt aerosol in the Arctic. Simulations will be validated against MOSAiC expedition observations.

projects.title: Monin-Obukhov theory and surface exchange
projects.summary: Investigate whether radiation penetration into the snow can explain the underestimation of latent heat fluxes in current models, combining numerical modelling with snow temperature measurements. Modelling will use SNOWPACK and OpenFOAM to capture vapour transport across the snow-atmosphere interface.

projects.title: Towards an Arctic Wind Atlas for Greenland and Svalbard based on machine-learning bias-correction of climate model reanalysis (CARRA)
projects.summary: Develop an Arctic wind atlas for Greenland (and possibly Svalbard and other Arctic regions) by applying machine-learning bias correction to CARRA reanalysis wind fields, using in situ observations and sub-grid orographic predictors. The aim is spatially continuous, bias-corrected wind distributions and wind energy metrics.

projects.title: Studying the atmospheric circulation and their related snow effects using observational methods at SLF Davos
projects.summary: Deploy a LIDAR system in the Flüela valley during winter and use data from the new Tschuggen station to study how mesoscale circulations (katabatic winds, rotors, etc.) affect snow in an Alpine valley. The work is a master's thesis at SLF Davos.

projects.title: Effects of extreme heatwaves on the Antarctic snow and firn
projects.summary: Systematically study how extreme atmospheric heatwaves in Antarctica affect snow and firn, including melt, refreezing, densification and surface energy balance. The work combines reanalysis-based detection of heatwaves with long-term distributed SNOWPACK simulations across Antarctica.

projects.title: Studying the heat flux representation by different reanalysis and climate models
projects.summary: Compile surface heat flux datasets over Antarctica and analyse them to quantify the uncertainty of reanalyses and climate models. The project also includes CRYOWRF simulations to examine the importance of grid resolution.

projects.title: Self-Supervised Learning of Flight Dynamics
projects.summary: Learn how an aircraft responds to control inputs by observing flight data with self-supervised methods such as Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA), without manually labeled data. The goal is to model flight dynamics for autonomous flight.

projects.title: Interpretable and Controllable Neural Shape Parameterizations
projects.summary: Develop neural representations of 2D and 3D shapes, building on approaches such as DeepGeo, that are easier to interpret and control than current mesh-based neural deformation methods. The aim is to make shape parameters predictable when changed.

projects.title: Structured 3D Shape Optimization with Part-Based Implicit Neural Representations
projects.summary: Use part-based implicit neural representations, where an auto-decoder decodes latent vectors and poses into shape parts, to generate, edit and optimize 3D shapes for modular engineering design.

projects.title: Recovering Thin Structures in 3D Foundation Models
projects.summary: Improve the handling of thin structures in transformer-based 3D foundation models that predict scene geometry and camera parameters in a feed-forward pass, since their rough patchification makes them less effective on thin structures.

projects.title: Applied Deep Learning for Computer Aided Engineering
projects.summary: Apply deep learning to automate Computer Aided Engineering (CAE) processes, reducing the time and human resources needed for simulation-based industrial engineering and manufacturing R&D.

projects.title: Real-Time 3D Tracking and Anomaly Detection for Maritime Kite Systems
projects.summary: Build a 360-degree vision-based redundancy system for real-time 3D tracking of kite wings for Aether Swiss Kite's plug-and-play maritime kite system, including anomaly detection for safety and reliability. It builds on a previous semester project that achieved 2D detection, trajectory mapping and orientation tracking.

projects.title: 3D Surface reconstruction using 3D Gaussians and SDF
projects.summary: Reconstruct 3D surfaces by combining 3D Gaussian Splatting with signed distance functions (SDF), either through ad-hoc surface extraction or by training a neural SDF jointly with the 3D Gaussians.

projects.title: Computer Vision for Waste Management (CVLab x Wasteflow)
projects.summary: A computer vision project for waste management in collaboration with Wasteflow, as named in the title.

projects.title: Efficient Diffusion Models via Quantization and Compression
projects.summary: Explore and systematically evaluate quantization and compression methods for diffusion models such as Stable Diffusion, to reduce their parameter count and memory footprint for deployment on resource-constrained devices.

projects.title: 3D Surface reconstruction using 3D Gaussians and SDF
projects.summary: The project explores building primitives so that a surface can be extracted from a 3D Gaussian Splatting scene with minimal extra computation, comparing ad-hoc approaches with neural SDFs trained alongside the Gaussians. Expected work includes a literature review and experiments with different SDF formulations.

projects.title: Real-Time 3D Tracking and Anomaly Detection for Maritime Kite Systems
projects.summary: Extend a vision system that tracks an automated maritime kite wing from 2D to 3D by integrating and calibrating a second camera for stereovision. The work also moves the previous ROS-simulated pipeline to a real-time hardware system and develops anomaly detection, such as tears, abnormal trajectories and wing shape estimation, linked to emergency control actions.

projects.title: Applied Deep Learning for Computer Aided Engineering
projects.summary: Students work on one of several CAE problems addressed with deep learning, such as object geometry modelling and parameterization, physical performance evaluation with surrogate models, and gradient-based optimization, applied to aeronautics engineering in collaboration with ISAE-SUPAERO.

projects.title: Applying Machine Learning to 4D/5D Neuroimaging Data to Advance Motor Control Research
projects.summary: Develop a machine learning approach to identify and reconstruct each individual neuron in large 4D/5D neuroimaging datasets, using neural dynamics along the time axis to improve segmentation over 3D U-net pipelines. The project is a collaboration with the Neuroengineering Lab, which provides datasets on how the nervous system coordinates fast, precise limb movements.

projects.title: Computer Vision for Waste Management (CVLAB x Wasteflow)
projects.summary: Develop a computer vision solution for WasteFlow's recycling facility service, covering real-time detection and classification of waste on conveyor belts, efficiency measurement, mass estimation, and purity assessment of sorted output. Edge deployment of models is also of interest.

projects.title: Digging into the Transformers of 3D Foundation Model
projects.summary: The project aims to study the transformer mechanisms inside the VGGT 3D foundation model for scene geometry and camera parameter prediction, with the goal of devising algorithms that make it faster and more accurate.

projects.title: Efficient Diffusion Models via Quantization and Compression
projects.summary: Explore and systematically evaluate quantization and compression methods (INT8/INT4, mixed-precision, pruning, low-rank factorization, distillation) for diffusion models such as Stable Diffusion, to reduce computational and memory requirements while preserving generative quality.

projects.title: Interpretable and Controllable Neural Shape Parameterizations
projects.summary: Build on DeepGeo, a neural network and mesh-based deformation approach for 2D and 3D shapes, to develop methods that make neural shape parameterizations more interpretable, controllable, and efficient to optimize. Possible directions include automatically finding parameter directions tied to geometric properties such as airfoil thickness, camber, or wing twist.

projects.title: Proton Irradiation of Nvidia GPU
projects.summary: The student will run proton irradiation experiments at the Paul Scherrer Institute on a Nvidia Jetson Orin NX executing a machine learning algorithm, to study single event effects and bit flips. The work includes validating the experimental results against simulations and analysing fault propagation through the device.

projects.title: Recovering Thin Structures in 3D Foundation Models
projects.summary: 3D foundation models based on feed-forward transformers reconstruct scene geometry and camera parameters, but they perform poorly on thin structures because of coarse patchification. The project investigates how to improve the performance of such models (illustrated with Depth Anything 3) on thin structures.

projects.title: Self-Supervised Learning of Flight Dynamics
projects.summary: The project explores self-supervised methods, such as Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA), to learn how an aircraft responds to control inputs from sensor measurements. The goal is to make the learned dynamics models useful for control, with tests on simulated flight data and possibly real measurements from the lab's experimental aircraft.

projects.title: Structured 3D Shape Optimization with Part-Based Implicit Neural Representations
projects.summary: Extend a part-based implicit neural representation (PartSDF) to engineering-driven 3D shape representation and optimization under physical and design constraints, such as aerodynamics or structural efficiency. The work also targets scalable learning for many-part objects without invalid outputs.

projects.title: In silico screening and AI-assisted discovery of small-molecule inhibitors targeting the ceramide transfer protein CERT in CerTra syndrome
projects.summary: An in silico screen of a large compound library (over 100,000 molecules) to find small-molecule inhibitors of the ceramide transfer protein CERT, using molecular docking and AI/machine learning for scoring, clustering and ADMET prediction. The project also models disease-associated CERT mutants to assess differences in compound binding, with the aim of identifying candidate leads for CerTra syndrome.

projects.title: Habiter l'autoroute
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Marseille, part of the Made in Marseille studio on food-related housing and community facilities in transformed existing buildings. The title names the highway as the site of housing.

projects.title: Habiter la corniche
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Marseille, part of the Made in Marseille studio on food-related housing and community facilities in transformed existing buildings. The title places the housing along the coastal corniche.

projects.title: Habiter les quartiers ouverts
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Marseille, part of the Made in Marseille studio on food-related housing and community facilities in transformed existing buildings. The title targets the open housing estates bordering the city.

projects.title: Habiter les industries hors-la-ville
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Marseille, part of the Made in Marseille studio on food-related housing and community facilities in transformed existing buildings. The title focuses on housing in obsolete industrial infrastructure outside the city.

projects.title: Habiter les plateformes
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Marseille, part of the Made in Marseille studio on food-related housing and community facilities in transformed existing buildings. The title refers to housing on platforms built over urban infrastructure.

projects.title: Habiter les infrastructures hydrauliques
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Marseille, part of the Made in Marseille studio on food-related housing and community facilities in transformed existing buildings. The title focuses on housing within water infrastructure.

projects.title: Les garages dans la topographie
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns garages integrated into the topography of the city.

projects.title: Les rives du lac privatisées
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns the privatised lakeshore.

projects.title: Les rues-belvédère
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns streets conceived as lookout points over the city.

projects.title: Les raccourcis piétons
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns pedestrian shortcuts across the city.

projects.title: Les plateformes d'immeuble accessibles à 2 niveaux
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns building platforms accessible on two levels.

projects.title: Les coopératives ouvrières
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns worker cooperative housing.

projects.title: Les infrastructures franchissant la vallée du Flon
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns infrastructure crossing the Flon valley.

projects.title: Les habitations disposées en série
projects.summary: Architectural design project in Lausanne, part of the Made in Lausanne studio. The title concerns housing arranged in series.

projects.title: Web development for graphic music analysis app
projects.summary: Rewrite the serverless web app for reductive music analysis in type-safe code with a modern event-driven JavaScript framework, or develop features and fix bugs in the existing legacy code base. The app lets researchers express music analyses as graphs embedded in MEI music scores.

projects.title: Perceptual abilities of musical experts
projects.summary: Replicate existing behavioural music perception experiments with top-level performing artists to compare their perceptual abilities with those of non-musicians and typical musicians. The project involves critically updating the methods, implementing an online version of the experiment, and analysing the data.

projects.title: LARS Testing & Quality Assurance (C++ & Python)
projects.summary: Build a comprehensive test suite (unit, integration, regression and load tests) for the C++ and Python components of the LARS real-time interactive music system, and set up automated CI testing workflows. The goal is to improve the reliability and maintainability of LARS.

projects.title: LARS Python Utilities to C++ Core Migration
projects.summary: Move key Python utilities of the LARS music system to optimised modern C++, keeping Python bindings via nanobind. The project also contributes to a C++ version of the pattern language used for algorithmic composition in LARS.

projects.title: LARS Performance Optimization & Benchmarking
projects.summary: Profile the LARS real-time music system to find bottlenecks, optimise C++ code paths and threading/concurrency, and build benchmarking tools with automated performance regression tests. The goal is to improve real-time performance and scalability.

projects.title: LARS Audio Processing
projects.summary: Add audio capabilities to the LARS system, including computing hardware delays and extracting audio features such as beat tracking and key finding. The project targets low-latency real-time processing.

projects.title: Expanding the data-driven controller synthesis framework to new performance objectives
projects.summary: Extend the lab's data-driven controller synthesis framework, which currently supports H2, H-infinity and IQC-based robustness specifications, to alternative objectives such as H1 performance and regret-based criteria. The work covers theory, implementation in the lab's datadriven library, and validation on experimental systems, with focus on actuator saturation constraints.

projects.title: Adaptive optics controller synthesis for ground-based telescopes
projects.summary: Design and synthesise a robust, real-time controller for an adaptive optics system that corrects atmospheric wavefront distortions in ground-based telescopes. Validation is planned through simulation and hardware implementation on an AO testbed.

projects.title: Data-driven controller synthesis with Distributionally Robust Control
projects.summary: Investigate Distributionally Robust Control (DRO) as an alternative control objective and develop corresponding data-driven controller synthesis methods. The work includes implementation in the lab's datadriven library and experimental validation with a focus on saturation-related constraints.

projects.title: Partial feedback linearization for inverted pendulum swing-up
projects.summary: Implement a partial feedback linearization algorithm for the swing-up control of an inverted pendulum, and extend the algorithm to the data-driven paradigm. The controller will be implemented on the hardware setup using LabVIEW.

projects.title: Data-driven adaptive control of an active suspension test bench
projects.summary: Set up an active suspension system test bench and apply data-driven adaptive control techniques to it, with data acquisition and controller implementation in LabVIEW on NI DAQs. The controller should be robust to parametric uncertainties and is to be verified and validated on the test bench.

projects.title: Coercion-resistant proof of personhood as a foundation for digital democracy
projects.summary: Prototype, test, and evaluate a coercion-resistance mechanism for remote e-voting in the context of in-person pseudonym parties, which authenticate real humans while limiting vote buying and coercion. The project includes building a usable app mockup, running a volunteer user study, and writing a report that could lead to a publication.
skills: communication with volunteers and administrative authorities

projects.title: Paradox-resistant reasoning in automated theorem provers
projects.summary: Formalize, validate, and metalogically reason about Grounded Deduction, a non-classical logic foundation that allows unrestricted recursive definitions while defusing semantic paradoxes such as the Liar and Yablo's paradox. The work uses a proof assistant or automated theorem prover such as Isabelle, Coq, or Lean, and may extend to a grounded set theory in the LISA prover.

projects.title: Writing and editing tools based on matchertext and MinML
projects.summary: Develop tools around MinML, an experimental markup language based on the matchertext syntactic discipline that is a more readable alternative to HTML/XML. Possible work includes refining the language, integrating MinML into authoring tools, and designing a LaTeX-like MinML for document authoring.

projects.title: Master's Engineering Internship | Instrument Development (Microfluidics, Electronics & Optics)
projects.summary: Two master's internship positions to help develop the next generation of the IRIS instrument, a deterministic microfluidic platform for high-throughput live-cell imaging and AI-driven single-cell phenomics. Tracks cover mechatronics and microfluidics (mechanical and fluidic assemblies) or electronics and optics (control systems and optical subsystems).

projects.title: Dynamic modelling and real time simulation of a transmission network
projects.summary: Develop a dynamic model of a transmission network and run it in real-time simulation. The page lists it as a bachelor semester project and as a master semester project, with the status 'Coming soon'.

projects.title: Electronics Upgrade and Electromagnetic Compatibility of a Reduced Scale Hyperloop Pod
projects.summary: Upgrade the electronics of a reduced-scale Hyperloop pod and assess its electromagnetic compatibility.

projects.title: Mechanical Modelling and Characterisation of a Reduced-Scale Hyperloop Pod for Levitation Control
projects.summary: Build a mechanical model and experimentally characterise a reduced-scale Hyperloop pod to support levitation control. The page lists it as a master semester project and as a master thesis.

projects.title: H55 – Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy for battery health diagnostics in aviation applications
projects.summary: Use electrochemical impedance spectroscopy to diagnose battery health for aviation applications.

projects.title: Services Industriels de Lausanne (SiL) – Régimes de neutre pour un réseau de distribution moyenne tension
projects.summary: Study neutral-earthing regimes for a medium-voltage distribution network, proposed by Services Industriels de Lausanne.

projects.title: Design and Experimental Validation of an Electromagnetic Levitation Controller for a Hyperloop Pod
projects.summary: Design an electromagnetic levitation controller for a Hyperloop pod and validate it experimentally.

projects.title: Self-aware load control for ex-post grid tariffs: Design and field-test on the EPFL smart-grid platform
projects.summary: Design a self-aware load control approach for ex-post grid tariffs and field-test it on the EPFL smart-grid platform.

projects.title: A Framework for Carbon Flow Tracing in Swiss Power Distribution Grids
projects.summary: Develop a framework for tracing carbon flows in Swiss power distribution grids.

projects.title: Zaphiro Technologies – Phase Identification in medium voltage network
projects.summary: Identify the phases of loads or lines in a medium-voltage network, proposed with Zaphiro Technologies.

projects.title: Zaphiro Technologies – PMU-based oscillation detection, characterization and source identification
projects.summary: Detect, characterise and identify the source of oscillations in power systems using PMU measurements, proposed with Zaphiro Technologies.

projects.title: Zaphiro Technologies – Incipient Fault Detection Using Waveform Analysis
projects.summary: Detect incipient faults in power networks through waveform analysis, proposed with Zaphiro Technologies.

projects.title: A Framework for Carbon Flow Tracing in Swiss Power Distribution Grids
projects.summary: Enhance an existing framework that estimates the carbon content of electricity in medium and low voltage grids by combining public electricity market data with local factors. The student extends the framework to model carbon flows in MV grids and to include additional generation technologies beyond solar.

projects.title: Phase Identification in medium voltage network
projects.summary: Develop and evaluate algorithms for automatic phase identification in medium-voltage networks using real PMU voltage and current phasor measurements from primary and secondary substations. The work includes reviewing existing methods, implementing new algorithms in Python, validating them on PMU datasets with ground truth, and testing performance with distributed generation.

projects.title: Incipient Fault Detection Using Waveform Analysis
projects.summary: The project investigates waveform-based methods for detecting incipient faults, which are low-magnitude, developing anomalies that can precede permanent faults in power systems. It aims to review state-of-the-art techniques, propose an improved detection method, and validate it through simulations and case studies.

projects.title: PMU - based oscillation detection, characterization and source identification
projects.summary: Develop a data-driven framework using Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) data to detect power system oscillations, estimate their modal characteristics (frequency, damping, mode shape), and identify their likely source. The project covers methods such as Prony analysis, spectral methods and machine learning, evaluated on synthetic or real PMU datasets.
skills: signal processing (FFT, Prony, wavelet, spectral analysis)

projects.title: Régimes de neutre pour un réseau de distribution moyenne tension
projects.summary: Comparative study of neutral-earthing regimes for a medium-voltage distribution network that Services Industriels de Lausanne plans to raise from 11.5 kV to 21 kV. The student models a representative network in Pandapower, simulates single-phase earth faults and protection impacts, and recommends a solution for SiL.

projects.title: Dynamic modelling and real time simulation of a transmission network
projects.summary: Build a dynamic model of a portion of a real transmission network in MATLAB/Simulink, structure it for real-time simulation with RT-lab, and validate the implementation through a real-time simulation.

projects.title: Self-aware load control for ex-post grid tariffs: Design and field-test on the EPFL smart-grid platform
projects.summary: Design a self-aware load-control algorithm that recognises its own contribution to grid load and forecasts the ex-post tariff its dispatch helps create, then test it first in simulation and then on the EPFL smart-grid demonstrator. The work studies rebound peaks caused by automated price-responsive loads under ex-post distribution grid tariffs.

projects.title: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy for battery health diagnostics in aviation applications
projects.summary: Investigates how far electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) can be used with external, non-invasive instrumentation to diagnose aviation-grade battery modules. It covers detecting a single defective cell within a healthy module and using high-frequency EIS as a proxy for a cell's internal temperature.

projects.title: Electronics Upgrade and Electromagnetic Compatibility of a Reduced Scale Hyperloop Pod
projects.summary: Improve the onboard electronics of the reduced scale epfloop hyperloop pod, with a focus on characterising and mitigating electromagnetic interference that degrades analogue sensor measurements. The work also covers redesigning the electronics (including replacing the onboard controller and PCB design) and improving the battery energy storage system current measurement.

projects.title: Design and Experimental Validation of an Electromagnetic Levitation Controller for a Hyperloop Pod
projects.summary: Design, implement and experimentally validate a control algorithm for the electromagnetic levitation of a Hyperloop pod, stabilising heave, pitch and roll and tracking a desired air-gap trajectory. The project includes modelling, simulation, implementation on the pod's sbRIO FPGA, and, in a second phase, decoupled propulsion-levitation control tested on the epfloop circular infrastructure.

projects.title: Mechanical Modelling and Characterisation of a Reduced-Scale Hyperloop Pod for Levitation Control
projects.summary: Model and characterise the mechanics of the epfloop hyperloop pod, including mass properties, chassis flexibility and vibration modes, and improve chassis rigidity and test-bench stability. The student will also design a setup to measure the static levitation force of a levitation unit and validate the existing electromagnetic model.

projects.title: Preparing and Evaluating Vintage Language Models
projects.summary: Build the methodological and technical foundations for language models trained only on historical corpora, studying contamination control, chronological training pipelines, and historically grounded evaluation benchmarks.

projects.title: Temporal Language Models and the Dynamics of Language Change
projects.summary: Extend temporal language modelling approaches inspired by TLM-1 to analyse semantic drift, narrative evolution and forecasting of linguistic change in diachronic corpora.

projects.title: Discovering Historical Events Through Spatio-Temporal Analysis
projects.summary: Design a reproducible pipeline that detects historically significant intersections of time and place in the Flickr Commons archive, in collaboration with the Flickr Foundation, using unsupervised anomaly detection.

projects.title: Pleiades Integration into the TimeAtlas
projects.summary: Design and prototype the integration of the Pleiades gazetteer of ancient places into the Time Atlas infrastructure, including data mapping and ingestion pipelines.

projects.title: IIIF Document Information Extraction for Time Atlas
projects.summary: Build a pipeline that retrieves manuscript images via IIIF, processes them with language-vision models to extract text, layout and named entities, and prepares structured data for the Time Atlas.

projects.title: Geolocating Artworks
projects.summary: Use vision-language models and multimodal embeddings to identify the places depicted in paintings, engravings and illustrations, and link artworks to spatial entities in the Time Atlas.

projects.title: News Articles in Space and Time
projects.summary: A project on analysing news articles along spatial and temporal dimensions, as named in the title. No detailed description is published yet.

projects.title: Preparing Historical Data for Apertus
projects.summary: Collect, filter, clean and document historical corpora (books, newspapers, archives) to prepare training material for a future training cycle of the open Apertus language model.

projects.title: EPFL Digital Twin Foundation Model
projects.summary: Prototype a foundation model of the EPFL campus by aligning datasets from the Urban Digital Twin ecosystem (buildings, mobility, food, schedules) into a unified spatiotemporal representation for forecasting and simulation.

projects.title: Bias analysis of cultural heritage manipulation classification of Wikipedia edits by LLMs
projects.summary: Analyse biases of open-source LLMs when classifying Wikipedia edits on Armenian and Ukrainian cultural heritage as manipulative, compare against human labels, and explore simple bias mitigation strategies.

projects.title: ArmEpiC: EpiDoc Corpus Creation & Geolocation
projects.summary: Transform the IndiaArmEpiC corpus of Armenian inscriptions from India (based on EAP1721) into a structured TEI/EpiDoc dataset and geolocate its entries.

projects.title: ArmEpiC: AI-Assisted Authority Files & Validation Dashboard
projects.summary: Develop AI-assisted workflows to enrich authority files for the Armenian epigraphic corpus and build a validation dashboard.

projects.title: ArmEpiC: Standalone Web Visualisation
projects.summary: Create a standalone web tool to visualise and analyse the Armenian epigraphic corpus.

projects.title: ArmEpiC: Armenian Editorial Signs Converter
projects.summary: Build a converter that transforms Armenian editorial signs in the epigraphic corpus into standardised representations.

projects.title: Dense Language Encoders for Agglomerative Models
projects.summary: Build a dense text encoder aligned with EUPE dense features (similar to Talk2DINO) to enable zero-shot open-vocabulary semantic segmentation with agglomerative vision models.

projects.title: World Model Semantic Surprise as a Measure for Multimodal Urban Incongruity
projects.summary: Develop embedding-space semantic trajectory tools and apply them to urban trajectories from driving videos, street-view imagery, LiDAR or text to measure how incongruous parts of the built environment are.

projects.title: Reconstructing the Past: Generating 3D Models of Lost Buildings from Stylistically Diverse Inputs with Geometry Transformers
projects.summary: Test and fine-tune feed-forward geometry transformers on stylised historical images to generate 3D models of destroyed or lost buildings from the DHLAB's historical image collections.

projects.title: 3D Question Answering at City-Scale: Multimodal LLMs
projects.summary: Implement a multimodal LLM for question answering over city-scale 3D models, build a city-scale 3D QA benchmark from historical data, and integrate the system into the Time Atlas.

projects.title: Converging Conceptual Abstraction in Self-Supervised Models
projects.summary: Develop a representation convergence measure that compares the conceptual abstractions learned by sparse autoencoders or transcoders across self-supervised vision models.

projects.title: Driving Representation Convergence using Image Aesthetics
projects.summary: Test whether aesthetic images produce distinct or more convergent representations across vision models, using aesthetics datasets and an internationally and historically balanced dataset.

projects.title: Tarot Deck Motif Analysis
projects.summary: Prepare the computational analysis of visual motifs across historical Tarot decks: corpus collection, motif taxonomy, and prototype detection and classification tools.

projects.title: Spatial Intelligence at Scale: Implicit Reconstruction
projects.summary: Support training of an open-vocabulary model for city-scale 3D scenes by preparing datasets and extending the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer toward egocentric semantic understanding.

projects.title: Spatial Intelligence at Scale: Hierarchical Reconstruction
projects.summary: Investigate object-part hierarchies in city-scale 3D data derived from open-vocabulary point labels, including hyperbolic embeddings for hierarchical scene representations.

projects.title: Spatial Intelligence at Scale: Human Interaction
projects.summary: Design user interfaces for querying and manipulating large-scale 3D scenes with multimodal queries, including 3D-native search and retrieval-augmented chat with MLLMs, within the Time Atlas.

projects.title: The Social Life of Images: Using Social Metadata to Enhance AI Generated Descriptions of Digital Image Archives
projects.summary: Develop and evaluate methods that combine vision models with social metadata (tags, comments, galleries) from Flickr Commons to produce richer descriptions of historical archival images.

projects.title: Annotation of Culture-Specific Data for LLM Evaluation Using the Psychosocial Categorisation Model (PSCM)
projects.summary: Create a bilingual (Armenian-English) culturally annotated dataset using the PSCM schema and use it to evaluate LLM and MT performance on culture-specific meaning.

projects.title: Tracking the Weaponization and Manipulation of Cultural Heritage in Armenia
projects.summary: Retrieve and analyse Wikipedia editing histories, talk pages and related sources to monitor manipulation of Armenian cultural heritage narratives.

projects.title: Detection, Linking, and Georeferencing of Place Names in Historical Newspapers
projects.summary: Scale multilingual location detection and georeferencing, with a focus on sub-city levels, across the Impresso historical newspaper corpus.

projects.title: What's in those millions of images? Generating accurate descriptions for 4 million historical newspaper images
projects.summary: Evaluate and apply vision-language models to generate accurate multilingual captions for historical newspaper images, and define an evaluation method for description quality.

projects.title: VLM Finetuning for Accurate Features from Images of Degraded Point Clouds
projects.summary: Evaluate the gap between real and synthetic (point cloud) images for vision-language models and fine-tune them to produce accurate semantic features from synthetic renderings of 3D scenes.

projects.title: Projecting Representations of Beauty
projects.summary: Build a pseudo-labelling pipeline that projects image aesthetic assessment labels onto 3D scenes and distil a model that predicts aesthetic labels from point cloud structure.

projects.title: Biology of a VLM: Transcoder Training for Multimodal Interpretability
projects.summary: Train a transcoder replacement model for a vision-language model and use it to study concept representations and reasoning steps in the model's internals.

projects.title: Armenian Epigraphy and Cultural Heritage Data Analysis
projects.summary: Collect and clean books on Armenian epigraphy and cultural heritage, build a database, and extract key terms and themes with NLP techniques.

projects.title: Identification and Classification of Maps in Historical Newspapers
projects.summary: Train image classifiers to detect maps in historical newspaper pages and to classify the country or region each map represents.

projects.title: Exploring the structure of the Venetian urban fabric with 3-dimensional isovists
projects.summary: Analyse the structure of Venetian urban space using three-dimensional isovists.

projects.title: Typological analysis of Venetian floor plans through Computer Vision
projects.summary: Use computer vision to conduct a typological analysis of Venetian floor plans.

projects.title: Semi-automated historical GIS construction for Venetian secondary sources
projects.summary: Semi-automatically build a historical GIS from Venetian secondary sources.

projects.title: Reconstructing the topology of Venetian domestic space through cadastral analysis
projects.summary: Reconstruct the topology of domestic space in Venice by analysing cadastral records.

projects.title: Tracking the Weaponization and Manipulation of Cultural Heritage in Ukraine by Russia
projects.summary: Analyse Wikipedia editing histories, talk pages and related sources to monitor manipulation of Ukrainian cultural heritage narratives.

projects.title: Data Visualization Dashboard for Monitoring and Quality Control of Large-Scale Data Processing
projects.summary: Implement a modular, lightweight dashboard that shows the stages and quality of the Impresso data processing pipeline and deploy it online.

projects.title: Exploring Large Vision Models for Historical Newspaper Segmentation
projects.summary: Evaluate large vision models for segmenting and labelling logical layout units (articles, headlines, tables, images) on historical newspaper pages from the Impresso corpus.

projects.title: Evaluating the Novelty of Knowledge in Texts with Large Language Models
projects.summary: Develop algorithms that assess whether textual sources contain knowledge that was not present in the training data of open-source LLMs, with applications to historical research.

projects.title: Mapping Newspapers: Creation of a database of Swiss historical newspapers based on Blaser's bibliography
projects.summary: Extract semi-structured information from Fritz Blaser's Swiss Press Bibliography (PDF) into a lightweight database documenting Swiss newspapers from 1803 to 1958.

projects.title: Analysing Layout Elements of Historical Maps
projects.summary: Detect map layout elements such as cartouches, scale bars and legends in a dataset of about 400,000 historical maps and analyse their similarity and clustering across authors, regions and periods.

projects.title: Limiting interference of code generation to analytical query execution through remote JIT-ing
projects.summary: Explores how to limit the interference of code generation with analytical query execution by performing just-in-time compilation remotely.

projects.title: Cost models & tuning the query optimizer of a JIT analytical engine
projects.summary: Targets the cost models and tuning of the query optimizer in a just-in-time compiled analytical query engine.

projects.title: Memory-Aware Hash Joins for Heterogeneous Memory Environments
projects.summary: Focuses on designing hash join algorithms that take into account heterogeneous memory environments.

projects.title: Efficient Concurrent Interval Container for Multicore Systems
projects.summary: Concerns the design of an efficient concurrent interval container for multicore systems.

projects.title: Understanding and Mitigating Real-World Global Serializability Violations
projects.summary: Investigates real-world violations of global serializability in distributed transactional systems and how to mitigate them.

projects.title: Cost models & tuning the query optimizer of a JIT analytical engine
projects.summary: The student learns Apache Calcite and builds cost models for the operators of Proteus, an in-house analytical DBMS engine, then extends them to parallelism and resource allocation. The project also includes an auto-tuning infrastructure to select cost-model hyper-parameters for different machines.

projects.title: Limiting interference of code generation to analytical query execution through remote JIT-ing
projects.summary: The project studies how just-in-time code generation interferes with analytical query execution in a DBMS, and proposes running code generation remotely on a separate machine to isolate it. The student will benchmark the interference, use LLVM remote JIT, and modify the Proteus engine to allow a low-footprint version to run on a low-end machine.

projects.title: Efficient Concurrent Interval Container for Multicore Systems
projects.summary: Design and implement a concurrent interval container, inspired by the Boost Interval Container Library, that supports overlap and containment queries and atomic updates that may split, merge, or aggregate intervals. The prototype is to be evaluated against a sequential container under a global lock and against concurrent-index baselines.

projects.title: Understanding and Mitigating Real-World Global Serializability Violations
projects.summary: The project studies global serializability violations in multi-database transactions of microservice applications. The student empirically analyses 2-3 open-source microservice applications, then integrates existing mitigation methods (such as Sonata and the Ticket method) and evaluates their performance.

projects.title: Memory-Aware Hash Joins for Heterogeneous Memory Environments
projects.summary: The project studies the design space of hash join implementations in heterogeneous memory environments such as CXL memory. The student evaluates existing state-of-the-art hash joins, analyzes the design space, and proposes memory-aware design choices evaluated on SSB and TPC-H.

projects.title: Cross-Query Reuse for Efficient Semantic Query Processing
projects.summary: Design, implement, and evaluate a reuse layer for semantic query processing over unstructured data, so that LLM work shared across several semantic queries is done only once. The project covers caching operator results, grouping queries into shared LLM calls, and deriving answers from related cached results, combined in a cost-based optimizer compared against independent execution and single-prompt baselines.

projects.title: Three-Dimensional UWB Localization for Heterogeneous Ground–Aerial Robot Teams
projects.summary: Extend a Webots UWB localization simulation framework so that aerial robots can be localized with ground-based anchors, including 3D estimation and LOS/NLOS measurement models. The work is evaluated across environments, anchor configurations and aerial trajectories, with optional hardware-in-the-loop and motion-capture experiments for a master project.

projects.title: Cooperative Gas Source Localization with Infrastructure-Free UWB Positioning
projects.summary: Investigate cooperative gas source localization with heterogeneous robot teams whose positions come from infrastructure-free UWB relative localization. The student builds a simplified 2D gas-source environment, implements a cooperative estimation algorithm, and evaluates it with ground-truth, noisy and UWB-estimated robot positions.

projects.title: Robotic Gas Sensor Calibration
projects.summary: Design an efficient calibration set-up, run before take-off, to estimate absolute gas concentration with low-cost MOX and PID gas sensors mounted on a quadcopter. The set-up integrates temperature, humidity, flow, gas sensors and actuators (pump, valve, quadcopter), building on prior deconvolution work to compensate slow sensor dynamics.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Gas Source Localization
projects.summary: Extend the reinforcement learning approach for gas source localization (DDPG, SAC on a Gas Distribution Mapping basis) to a multi-robot system using multi-agent RL. The work studies what information agents should exchange, robustness to communication limits such as packet drops, and efficient message compression.

projects.title: Asymmetric Multi-modal Deep Vision Model Compression
projects.summary: Compress neural networks that fuse RGB and thermal images so they can run in real time on small robots with limited compute. The project applies pruning and quantization to reduce memory, inference time and energy, and studies how robust each visual modality is to compression.

projects.title: Thermal Burst Imaging for Optical Gas Imaging
projects.summary: Increase the signal of thermal frames for detecting weak signals such as gas by burst imaging with motion-compensated dense image matching. The method must be robust to a dynamic scene and can use classic variational methods, learned methods, or a combination.

projects.title: Robust indoor–outdoor state estimation for a compact multirotor
projects.summary: Design and test a sensor fusion strategy that keeps the position estimate of a micro aerial vehicle continuous and accurate when flying between outdoor (GNSS) and indoor (visual-inertial odometry) spaces. The work measures sensor behaviour across transitions in real flights and reproduces the degradations in Webots simulation.

projects.title: Comparing PSO and Reinforcement Learning for Training Robot Controllers
projects.summary: Perform a fair comparison of Particle Swarm Optimization and reinforcement learning when both train the same feedforward neural network controller on a multi-robot benchmark. The project includes a literature review, implementation of both algorithms in a high-fidelity simulator, and analysis of the solutions found under comparable evaluation budgets.

projects.title: Active Sound Source Localization and Ego-Noise Mitigation for Mobile Robots
projects.summary: Develop an onboard acoustic localization framework in which a mobile robot with a microphone array localizes sound sources despite its own motor and wheel noise. The work characterizes and suppresses ego-noise, then implements multi-channel localization (GCC-PHAT, SRP-PHAT or trilateration) and evaluates it on real hardware.

projects.title: Vision-Language Uncertainty Maps for Drone Search
projects.summary: Build a per-cell probability and uncertainty map of target location for drone search, combining a satellite-image prior scored with a vision-language model, a fine-tuned compact VLM detector on drone images, and in-flight observations. The method is benchmarked in simulation on satellite images with known target locations.

projects.title: Multi-Robot Inspection with ToF-Based Replanning
projects.summary: Detect, cell by cell, where an observed asset differs from its prior voxel map using onboard Time-of-Flight depth frames, and replan viewpoints and task assignments accordingly in a multi-MAV inspection system. The approach is evaluated in Webots on deliberately modified assets and, if time allows, with real MAVs.

projects.title: Lattice Algorithms and Integer Programming
projects.summary: Project on algorithms for lattices and their connection to integer programming. The page gives no further detail.

projects.title: Real-Time Scheduling and Routing
projects.summary: Project on scheduling and routing under real-time constraints. The page gives no further detail.

projects.title: Real Magnetic Fields from Quantum Materials Driven by Bright Circularly Polarized Terahertz Pulses
projects.summary: The student joins experiments that use circularly polarized THz pulses to resonantly drive chiral phonons and test whether they generate a real magnetic field around the sample, using new optical magnetometry methods. The work may include calculations, simulations, or help with scientific instrumentation.

projects.title: Optical Control of Quantized Magnetic Flux
projects.summary: The student joins experiments that use ultrafast intense laser pulses to locally destroy superconductivity in a ring-shaped superconductor, aiming to add or remove single flux quanta and probing the trapped magnetic field with optical magnetometry. The work may include simulations or help with scientific instrumentation.

projects.title: Flexible cryogenic heat link
projects.summary: A technical TP IV project to set up a flexible cryogenic heat link for the laboratory's low-temperature experiments. Students should contact Gregor Jotzu directly.

projects.title: Fast laser beam modulator
projects.summary: A technical TP IV project to build a fast modulator for the laser beam used in the laboratory's ultrafast optics experiments. Students should contact Gregor Jotzu directly.

projects.title: Advanced magneto-optic detection
projects.summary: A technical TP IV project on developing advanced magneto-optic detection methods for the laboratory's experiments. Students should contact Gregor Jotzu directly.

projects.title: 4forests
projects.summary: The project uses explainable machine learning on satellite imagery to identify drivers of tropical deforestation and patterns of landscape change at global scale. The goal is to predict future deforestation before trees are cut, rather than only detecting it after the fact.

projects.title: Knowledge-guided Explanations for Satellite Images
projects.summary: Develop approaches that describe satellite images and their changes in natural language, producing explanations accessible to non-experts. The work uses knowledge from large textual corpora such as Wikipedia or specialised web pages, in collaboration with the NLP lab.

projects.title: AI for topographic mapping
projects.summary: Develop new robust AI models for land cover and land use mapping from satellite and aerial imagery, addressing difficulties in class delimitation, multi-modal data integration (e.g. text and ground-level images), and model interpretability. The work is carried out with Swisstopo.

projects.title: An AI assistant to interact with remote sensing images
projects.summary: The project aims to develop a natural-language interface that lets non-experts extract information from satellite images by asking questions in English and receiving answers. It applies remote sensing visual question answering and aims for transparent, interpretable answers.

projects.title: Mapping vulnerable populations with AI
projects.summary: The project aims to create fine-grained population maps for developing countries, where census data are outdated and only available as coarse aggregate counts. It uses weakly supervised machine learning on the available coarse census data and open geodata, with the goal of predicting fine-grained population censuses in Africa. The maps are intended to support humanitarian action by NGOs.

projects.title: Transforming Underwriting for Commercial Insurance with High-Resolution Remote Sensing
projects.summary: The project addresses the problem of limited labeled data in very high resolution aerial imagery. It investigates how change detection models can be learned efficiently under these conditions. The project is run with AXA as partner.

projects.title: Buckling analysis of arcs using a local probing technique
projects.summary: Investigates the buckling of clamped semi-circular carbon-fiber arcs under a point force, using a poker-based nondestructive probing technique that tracks the basin of attraction and stability landscape. The goals are to study the effect of imperfections on edge states and to determine when the probing technique reliably predicts the spontaneous buckling load.

projects.title: Analysis of Bioaerosol Measurements from the West Coast of Greenland
projects.summary: Study biological aerosol particles along the south-west coast of Greenland using bioaerosol measurement data.

projects.title: Processing aerosol particles concentration data from airborne measurements in coastal Antarctica
projects.summary: Analyze and interpret aerosol particle concentration data from a flight campaign in coastal Antarctica.

projects.title: Aerosol background concentrations at Neumayer Station III
projects.summary: Analyze long-term observational aerosol data from the Neumayer Station III in coastal Antarctica.

projects.title: Improvement of a tethered balloon payload
projects.summary: Perform laboratory experiments and code data processing routines to improve a tethered balloon payload.

projects.title: Analysis of Bioaerosol Measurements from the West Coast of Greenland
projects.summary: Process and analyse WIBS (Wideband Integrated Bioaerosol Sensor) measurements collected in Greenland's west-coast fjords during the summers of 2025 and 2026. The work applies statistical methods to characterise Arctic bioaerosol types and their variability under different environmental conditions.

projects.title: Improving the payload of a tethered balloon
projects.summary: Compare old and new instruments of a tethered balloon payload (wind sensors and cloud droplet spectrometers) to ensure consistent observations, including processing of new sonic anemometer data and building a cloud generation setup in a climate chamber at ALPOLE.

projects.title: Processing aerosol particles concentration data from airborne measurements in coastal Antarctica
projects.summary: Combine airborne aerosol particle concentration measurements, GPS tracks and ERA5 reanalysis data from the RINGS campaign in coastal Antarctica (summer 2024-25) to characterize particle concentrations and their size distribution. Results are to be compared with the literature and with EERL balloon-borne measurements at Neumayer III station. A master's thesis could extend this to horizontal and vertical variations linked to atmospheric circulation and air-mass source case studies.

projects.title: Warm air mass intrusions in the Arctic
projects.summary: Evaluate the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model's representation of meteorology and cloud properties during a MOSAiC warm air intrusion event, and test how microphysics schemes and secondary ice production affect simulated cloud phase and precipitation.

projects.title: Structural system documentation of an existing masonry building
projects.summary: Survey and document the structural system, materials and key details of a Swiss building scheduled for renovation or demolition, and qualitatively discuss its weak points under various loads, with some quantitative assessments.

projects.title: Design of a RC building
projects.summary: Working in groups of two, design the structural system of a regular multi-storey reinforced concrete building that transfers loads from the superstructure to the foundation.

projects.title: Generation of geometrical digital twins of stone masonry walls using an image-based pipeline
projects.summary: Use an existing image-based pipeline and available datasets to reconstruct rubble stone masonry wall geometry, extract individual stones and refine digital models for numerical analysis, including automating detection and correction of stone collisions.

projects.title: An efficient point cloud compression via harmonic decomposition
projects.summary: Develop a modelling framework for walls built from demolition pieces, storing point cloud data as expansion coefficients of spherical, hemispherical or disk harmonics instead of explicit surface data.

projects.title: Deep learning for feature matching in geometrical digital twinning of stone masonry walls
projects.summary: Implement and compare traditional (SIFT, ORB) and deep learning (SuperPoint, D2-Net) feature matching methods and integrate them into a 3D reconstruction pipeline for geometrical digital twins, evaluating accuracy, robustness and efficiency.

projects.title: Erosion properties of earthen materials
projects.summary: Experimentally investigate the erosion of earthen construction materials such as rammed earth and compressed earth blocks under freeze-thaw cycles, wind and rain, and estimate the influence of soil composition.

projects.title: Numerical simulation and uncertainty evaluation of shake-table building tests
projects.summary: Build an equivalent frame model of a building tested on a shake table, simulate its seismic response, and compare it with experimental measurements to interpret discrepancies and uncertainties in model calibration and validation.

projects.title: Seismic assessment of historic rubble masonry building via optimization-based rigid block modeling
projects.summary: Apply an optimization-based rigid block model to building-level seismic analysis of a historic rubble masonry case study, including limit analysis and pushover analysis through its Python interface.

projects.title: Optimization-based rigid block modeling of URM pier spandrel systems with macro elements
projects.summary: Model unreinforced masonry pier spandrel systems with macro elements using an optimization-based rigid block method, identifying failure mechanisms and performing limit and pushover analysis via a Python interface. Other case studies are also available.

projects.title: Improving the in-plane stiffness of compressed earth floors
projects.summary: In collaboration with Terrabloc, test bonding systems (screws, pins, etc.) between wood boards and beams or rammed earth elements to improve the in-plane strength and stiffness of an Earth-Timber floor, then propose and test a practical solution at real scale.

projects.title: Numerical simulation of modern masonry walls with bed-joint reinforcement under seismic loading
projects.summary: Use a micro-modelling approach to calibrate a numerical model of modern brick masonry walls against EESD tests, then assess how different bed-joint reinforcement typologies and ratios affect their in-plane seismic response.

projects.title: Building Inelastic Torsional Response and Design Guidelines
projects.summary: Conduct inelastic dynamic analyses of simple structures to quantify torsional response, compare prediction methods with time-history results, and derive simple guidance for design standards on when torsional effects matter and how to consider them.

projects.title: Numerical simulation of the effect of flanges on the seismic response of modern masonry walls
projects.summary: Use a micro-modelling approach calibrated on EESD experimental tests to investigate how different flange geometries and configurations affect the in-plane seismic response of brick masonry walls.

projects.title: Optimization-based rigid block modeling for historic rubble masonry building across scales
projects.summary: Analyse a rubble masonry building by combining micro-scale rigid block models of each element, used for limit analysis, with macro models assembled into a full-building pushover analysis, using a Python interface.

projects.title: Effect of the axial load ratio (ALR) in the horizontal stiffness in stone masonry walls
projects.summary: Evaluate how the axial load ratio affects the stiffness of stone masonry walls by running pushover analyses in OpenSees with an equivalent frame model in which the elastic modulus depends on ALR, and comparing with experimental curves from literature.

projects.title: Behaviour of building aggregates in a city center
projects.summary: Study how different building heights within building aggregates in Zagreb, affected by the 2020 Croatia earthquakes, influence their behaviour, damage mechanisms and fragility, using nonlinear numerical models in OpenSees.

projects.title: Experimental assessment of shear strength at the concrete-mortar interface
projects.summary: Experimentally test the shear strength of concrete-mortar interfaces with various sustainable mortar types and precompression levels, complemented by life cycle assessment of masonry solutions and numerical wall-level simulations.

projects.title: Numerical simulation of the in-plane response of rammed earth walls
projects.summary: Review modelling approaches for rammed earth, select and validate constitutive models against experimental data, and use the model to study the in-plane response of rammed earth walls under diverse boundary conditions.

projects.title: Numerical investigation of masonry microstructure influence on the seismic response of multi-leaf rubble stone walls
projects.summary: Develop and calibrate a micro-continuum model of multi-leaf rubble stone walls in Abaqus, then run parametric simulations on virtual and real microstructures to correlate geometric indices with strength, stiffness and drift capacity.

projects.title: Analyse théorique et expérimentale de couplage entre conducteurs parallèles
projects.summary: Theoretical and experimental study of electromagnetic coupling between parallel conductors. The page lists it as an example of an electromagnetic compatibility bachelor project.

projects.title: Développement d’un programme de simulation du rayonnement électromagnétique d’un canal de foudre
projects.summary: Develop a simulation program for the electromagnetic radiation emitted by a lightning channel. The page lists it as an example of an electromagnetic compatibility bachelor project.

projects.title: Méthodes de calcul et de mesure des paramètres des lignes multiconductrices
projects.summary: Methods for computing and measuring the parameters of multiconductor transmission lines. The page lists it as an example of an electromagnetic compatibility bachelor project.

projects.title: Conception et réalisation de démonstrations en rapport avec le cours de compatibilité électromagnétique
projects.summary: Design and build demonstrations illustrating the electromagnetic compatibility course content. The page lists it as an example of an electromagnetic compatibility bachelor project.

projects.title: Development of portable impulse generator with output up to 1 kV
projects.summary: Develop a portable voltage generator producing impulse-shaped output, with a rapid rise to peak in a few microseconds and decay in tens to hundreds of microseconds, to test the lightning-transient response of equipment such as transformers, cables and grounding systems. The generator uses a voltage multiplier and a MOSFET electronic switch.

projects.title: Enabling low-cost far-field imaging thanks to electromagnetic time-reversal and software-defined radios
projects.summary: Build an experimental platform that uses software-defined radios and electromagnetic time reversal to localise radiation sources in the far field at low cost. The work addresses the challenges of generating radio-frequency signals with SDRs.

projects.title: High Voltage and High Frequency Unipolar Connector
projects.summary: Develop a numerical model of a high-voltage, high-frequency unipolar connector proposed by LEMO, to improve its withstand voltage and partial discharge performance. The project is co-supervised by LEMO.

projects.title: Design of an electric field sensor for the measurement of lightning electric field
projects.summary: Design and laboratory calibration of a wideband electric field sensor for lightning discharges, using a flat plate antenna connected to two electronic integrators with different sensitivity and measuring range.

projects.title: Simulation and Scaled Model Measurements of Grounding Systems in Elevated Terrain
projects.summary: Investigate, through simulations and measurements on a reduced-scale model, how non-flat terrain affects the grounding resistance of structures such as telecommunication towers and wind turbines. The student is provided with the measurement setup and simulation framework.

projects.title: Lightning current waveform analysis
projects.summary: Investigate how the lightning channel-base current waveshape depends on channel geometry, using recordings and measurements from the Säntis Observatory (current waveform recording, broadband interferometry and high-speed video).

projects.title: Comparison of lightning characteristics over land and ocean
projects.summary: Use geostationary satellite data over the Americas to estimate the number, energy and spatial coverage of lightning flashes in 20-second windows, and statistically compare these parameters between land and ocean.

projects.title: Localisation of multi electromagnetic sources using electromagnetic time reversal (EMTR) and machine learning (ML)
projects.summary: Localise multiple electromagnetic sources inside a medium by combining electromagnetic time reversal with convolutional neural networks, using data from multiple electric or magnetic sensors.

projects.title: Numerical Validation of Electromagnetic Time Reversal for Geolocation of Lightning Strike Using 3D-FDTD
projects.summary: Extend a 2D-FDTD electromagnetic time reversal algorithm for lightning return stroke localisation to 3D, so that lossy ground, terrain and antenna directivity are modelled. The project also explores 1-bit time reversal and clipping techniques.

projects.title: Numerical Validation of Electromagnetic Time Reversal for Partial Discharge in Power Transformers Using Green's Functions
projects.summary: Use Green's functions instead of FDTD or FEM to detect partial discharges in power transformers via electromagnetic time reversal, with the aim of significantly reducing computation times.

projects.title: DORT-Based Method Applied to Locating Resistive electrical faults
projects.summary: Study the DORT (time-reversal operator decomposition) theory and develop a DORT-based method to locate resistive, high-impedance electrical faults in wired systems, where existing EMTR methods struggle.

projects.title: Microdroplet-aided isolation of arsenic-methylating microorganisms from soil
projects.summary: The project aims to optimize a method combining droplet-based microfluidics, arsenic whole-cell biosensors and FACS to isolate anaerobic arsenic-methylating microorganisms from paddy soil, and to further characterize the new isolates.

projects.title: Arsenic methylation as 'microbial warfare' strategy
projects.summary: The project tests the hypothesis that anaerobic microbes methylate arsenic to produce toxic compounds used against competitors, using time-lapse microscopy of a methylator and a control strain co-cultured in microfluidic chips, with image analysis to quantify the warfare effect.

projects.title: Arsenic partitioning in solid and aqueous phases in Mekong Delta sediments
projects.summary: The project investigates arsenic speciation in solid and aqueous phases of Mekong Delta sediments through field observations and laboratory experiments, focusing on how iron mineral transformations and microbial responses to seasonal variation influence arsenic release into groundwater.

projects.title: Development of high-throughput method for DNA extraction from groundwater samples
projects.summary: The project investigates the role of microorganisms in nitrogen transformations in Mekong Delta sediments and their links to arsenic mobility, combining field observations and laboratory experiments, and involves developing a high-throughput method for DNA extraction from groundwater samples.

projects.title: Generative Workflow for Navigable 3D Worlds from a Large-Scale Panoramic Painting
projects.summary: Develop a reproducible generative AI workflow that turns segments of the 360° Murten Panorama painting into navigable 3D scenes for VR/XR, combining world models and 3D asset generation and placing scenes on a geolocated map.
skills: generative AI tools for images and 3D

projects.title: Beyond the Strings: LLM-Based Knowledge Extraction for Historical Puppetry Knowledge Graphs
projects.summary: Evaluate LLM-based extraction of historical relationships and scholarly interpretations from theatrical and archival texts about Sophie Taeuber-Arp's König Hirsch marionettes, producing structured data for knowledge graph integration under a predefined ontology.

projects.title: Evaluation Framework for Cross-Domain Visual Retrieval in Cultural Heritage Image Collections
projects.summary: Develop a reproducible evaluation framework for cross-domain visual retrieval and visualization tools applied to cultural heritage image collections, including the Murten Panorama and 15th-century illuminated manuscripts. The work covers dataset survey, construction of evaluation sets with generative AI, and metric definition.

projects.title: Tracking Novel Research Through the Publication Process: A Text-Embedding Approach
projects.summary: Measure the novelty of submitted manuscripts with text embedding models for semantic similarity, and build a framework matching rejected papers to their eventual publications. The goal is to study scientific conservatism in peer review, using anonymized manuscript metadata and peer review outcomes from over 2,000 Elsevier journals provided through the ICSR Lab collaboration.

projects.title: Measuring Entrepreneurial and Industry Identity in the Asteroid-Mining Industry with NLP
projects.summary: Build an NLP pipeline that collects longitudinal text data (company websites, communications, interviews, media) and uses machine learning to separate general topics from individual and collective identity claims in the asteroid-mining industry. The project studies how entrepreneurs and institutions describe themselves as a new industry takes shape.

projects.title: Microarchitectural explorations for biomedical applications
projects.summary: Explore whether an in-order superscalar RISC-V core in place of the single-scalar core of X-HEEP can improve energy efficiency for biomedical wearable applications from BiomedBench. The student builds a lightweight RISC-V simulator, generates execution traces, and models superscalar execution, with optional evaluation of area/power overheads and domain-specific extensions.

projects.title: Bubble-free water electrolysis
projects.summary: Design and optimize a bubble-free, capillarity-driven flow cell for electrolysis. The project examines how different electrodes and membranes, with various geometries and materials, affect performance.

projects.title: Controlled vapor sorption and smart water release
projects.summary: Studies hygroscopic metal organic framework (MOF)-based materials, which are promising for energy-efficient cooling and water harvesting. The focus is on controlled vapor sorption and water release.

projects.title: Modeling energy savings of passive cooling panels
projects.summary: Quantifies annual building-level energy savings of passive cooling panels across diverse climates and integration pathways. It also compares the net benefit of these panels against PV cells to guide technology selection.

projects.title: Hydrogel Overlayer on Metal Scaffold (HOMeS)
projects.summary: Investigates hydrogel overlayers on metal scaffolds for cooling. The page reports that evaporative texturing gives significant cooling improvement only when thermal coupling to the interface is preserved.

projects.title: Collective bubble behavior in boiling
projects.summary: Aims to understand and control collective bubble behavior to explore boiling physics and improve nucleation reliability.

projects.title: Probing contamination in microscale porous evaporator
projects.summary: Aims to investigate the accumulation of impurities in a microscale porous evaporator non-invasively, using advanced metrology and spectroscopy.

projects.title: Demand flexibility provision in Swiss households
projects.summary: Build a common database of metering and sub-metering data from Swiss households, then develop non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) and customer segmentation models. The project aims to evaluate household demand flexibility potential and design demand flexibility programs, in collaboration with EMPA.

projects.title: Large Language Model (LLM) Agent-Based Modeling (ABM) of Residential Energy Behavior under Flexible Load Management Scenarios
