projects.summary: Use existing LLM-agent frameworks to simulate Swiss households' energy behavior, using collected demographic and time-use survey data. The goal is to study population-level behavioural shifts and individual reactions to demand response policies and extreme weather scenarios.

projects.title: Beyond occupancy through multimodal social sensing
projects.summary: Use multimodal, privacy-preserving sensors (distributed acoustic and environmental measurements) to characterize social interactions in office environments. The project covers sensor deployment, data collection, feature extraction and analysis of how interactions vary across space, time and workspace conditions.

projects.title: Clustering of urban form for sustainable mobility
projects.summary: Apply machine learning clustering to urban form data (buildings, street networks, public space) to identify natural city forms. The results are to be interpreted using surveys of residents' experiences as pedestrians and cyclists.

projects.title: Urban rhythms across public spaces
projects.summary: Use privacy-preserving spatiotemporal observations to identify and compare activity patterns across public spaces. The project develops methods to aggregate, visualize and cluster public spaces by recurring temporal signatures, and to compare shared and city-specific rhythms.

projects.title: Understanding the similarities and differences in occupant behavior around the world based on domestic appliances usage
projects.summary: Study global differences and similarities in occupancy and occupant behavior using smart meter data and end-use energy distributions in residential units. The aim is to explain how dwelling type, household size, income, appliances and weather shape energy use.

projects.title: Strategies for demand side management based on insights from energy meter disaggregation
projects.summary: Disaggregate household energy meter data with non-intrusive load monitoring to extract appliance usage signatures. The goal is to identify user types and deferrable versus non-deferrable appliances, and to develop household-specific demand response strategies.

projects.title: Bureau Action Située – Multi-scale indicators of walkability and cyclability
projects.summary: Develop a composite index of walkability and cyclability that integrates infrastructure, mobility practices, air pollution and noise across street, neighborhood and municipality scales. The framework will be piloted in the Canton of Vaud, using TLM networks and open data.

projects.title: Bureau Action Située – Activity space and carbon consumption
projects.summary: Examine how the shape and extent of individuals' activity spaces (covered areas, distances traveled, spatial dispersion) relate to their daily carbon footprint. The aim is to identify low-carbon mobility profiles while maintaining access to essential activities.

projects.title: Bureau Action Située – Mobility of care and transport hubs
projects.summary: Investigate how transport nodes such as train stations, bus stops and multimodal hubs can be redesigned to better accommodate care-related mobility. The project aims to characterize care mobility chains and build multidimensional accessibility indicators to diagnose caregiving-friendly hubs.

projects.title: Investigating Genomic Data Transformations for Predicting Disease Outcomes using Machine Learning
projects.summary: Investigates how large-scale SNP genotype data can be transformed into compact, biologically meaningful features for disease prediction, including transformations based on biological databases, polygenic risk scores, and foundational DNA models. The goal is to improve genomic disease prediction with machine learning and deep learning.

projects.title: Enhancing Cardiovascular Disease Prediction by Integrating Rare Variants into Polygenic Risk Scores
projects.summary: Aims to improve polygenic risk scores for cardiovascular disease by integrating rare, high-impact genetic variants with a baseline common-variant PRS built from UK Biobank data. The project compares the integrated model against the baseline and optionally tests generalizability on Swiss HIV Cohort Study data.

projects.title: Study of the viscous dewetting morphologies on micro-structured substrates
projects.summary: The project studies how viscous liquid films dewet from rough or micro-textured substrates, combining microfabrication of textured silicon surfaces, thin-film deposition, literature comparison, and theoretical and computational simulations of the observed fluid-dynamics phenomena.

projects.title: Functional Magnetic Textiles and Fibers with Integrated Sensing
projects.summary: The project develops soft multi-material magnetic fibers, made by thermal drawing with integrated sensing, and weaves them into functional textiles for programmed shape morphing, with the aim of demonstrating magnetic textiles for rehabilitation with human subjects.

projects.title: FiberLab Project
projects.summary: The project develops new sensing strategies and materials compatible with thermal drawing for FiberLab, a low-cost multicapillary lab-in-fiber platform that performs colorimetric chemical assays on microliter samples, aiming to deliver a functional demonstrator by the end of the semester.

projects.title: Soft fibers for actuation and robotic
projects.summary: Develop new elastomer-based soft composite materials for thermally drawn multi-material fibers that can sense and adapt to their environment, with applications in soft robotics and wearable devices.

projects.title: Fabrication of microchannels for thin film dewetting
projects.summary: Study liquid film dewetting on rough microtextured substrates by fabricating microtextured silicon or silica surfaces with lithography and etching, coating them with thin films, and analysing dewetting of chalcogenide glass.

projects.title: New fabrication methods for metallic and all-dielectric nano-object arrays
projects.summary: Investigate a simple and scalable nano-imprint and thin-film approach to fabricate 2D and 3D ordered arrays of metallic and all-dielectric nano-objects.

projects.title: Tencer Metamaterials: Unit Cell Generation and Rigid Motion Analysis
projects.summary: Generation of unit cells for Tencer metamaterials and analysis of their rigid motion. The topic combines geometric modeling with mechanical analysis of metamaterial structures.

projects.title: Simulation and Design of Transformable Elastic Linkages
projects.summary: Simulation and design of elastic linkages that can change shape. The topic focuses on computational modeling of transformable mechanical linkage structures.

projects.title: Computational Design with Multiple Tension Elements: Elastic Cables and Sheets with Elastic Rod Structures
projects.summary: Computational design of structures combining elastic cables and sheets with elastic rod structures. The topic explores how multiple tension elements interact in designed forms.

projects.title: Inverse design of highly curved surfaces for surface-based inflatables
projects.summary: Inverse design of highly curved surfaces intended for surface-based inflatable structures. The topic targets computing the surface geometry needed to achieve a desired inflated shape.

projects.title: Tencer Metamaterials: Unit Cell Generation and Rigid Motion Analysis
projects.summary: The project aims to build an automatic tool that generates diverse candidate unit-cell topologies built from tencers (tension-constrained elastic rods), for systematic exploration of metamaterial designs. It also seeks a strategy to refine these designs so that no undesired relative rigid motion between components is possible, yielding a database of interesting designs.

projects.title: Inverse design of highly curved surfaces for surface-based inflatables
projects.summary: Develop a parameterization method for highly curved surfaces that respects the contraction bounds of surface-based inflatables, using cone singularities to keep the scale factors within physically realizable limits. The project asks how cone placement and angles can be optimized, how the resulting cuts can be realized physically, and how much this extends the achievable shapes.

projects.title: Computational Design with Multiple Tension Elements: Elastic Cables and Sheets with Elastic Rod Structures
projects.summary: The project studies how elastic rods held in target curves by cables and sheet patches can be designed with both kinds of tension elements combined and interchangeable. The student will develop methods for form-finding cable-patch configurations, evaluating and comparing designs, intersection-free layout, and topology optimization under constraints, building on the existing Tencer inverse design and cable-to-patch pipelines.

projects.title: Simulation and Design of Transformable Elastic Linkages
projects.summary: Study and simulate how elastic beams and joints can be designed and connected to achieve desired transformations, shapes, and functions, building on deployable systems such as X-Shells, C-Shells and BamX. The project can explore new deployable linkage designs guided by geometric insight and numerical simulation.

projects.title: Boundary Element simulations for elasto-static
projects.summary: Help develop and test a fast boundary element code in 2D and 3D for elastostatic problems, possibly with many cracks, and apply it to problems in solid mechanics.

projects.title: Fracture statistics of quasi-brittle rock from CT scan images
projects.summary: Analyse the statistics of fracture traces picked by a deep convolutional network from more than 10,000 microCT scan images of fractured rock, to learn about fracture in quasi-brittle materials, and possibly retrain the network.

projects.title: Distributed fiber optic strain sensing – Inversion for load reconstruction
projects.summary: Reconstruct the loading responsible for strain measured by a distributed fiber optic sensing system in a solid of known mechanical properties, combining mechanical experiments and inverse-problem modelling.

projects.title: Fluid driven fault re-activation associated with H2 / CO2 storage
projects.summary: Study how pore-pressure and stress changes from subsurface fluid injection or withdrawal can reactivate faults, using finite element thermo-hydro-mechanical modelling.

projects.title: Fracture thermal energy storage
projects.summary: Explore the efficiency of storing seasonal heat in impermeable strata by engineering fractures and cycling hydrothermal loading and unloading, using lab experiments and modelling.

projects.title: Imaging of failures using active and passive acoustics
projects.summary: Monitor quasi-brittle materials such as concrete and rock with active and passive acoustics to image the evolution of damage and failure, using signal processing and seismological methods.

projects.title: Design of a polyaxial frame for rock mechanics testing
projects.summary: Use finite element simulations of a true triaxial reacting frame, including platen and sample friction, to design a polyaxial frame for rock mechanics testing.

projects.title: Limit analysis for the design of geotechnical engineering
projects.summary: Numerically model soil-structure interaction problems for the ultimate limit state in geotechnical design. Students must have taken the Computational Geomechanics course.

projects.title: Modelling of the failure of quasi-brittle material
projects.summary: Reproduce numerically novel experiments characterising the fracture mechanical behaviour of quasi-brittle materials such as rock and concrete, in particular the recently developed gap test for concrete failure, using distinct element modelling. The project is carried out in mobility at Georgia Institute of Technology with Prof. H. Huang.

projects.title: Understanding hydromechanical deformations around volcanic systems
projects.summary: Study the hydromechanical deformations occurring around volcanic systems.

projects.title: Rock slope stability under climate change
projects.summary: Investigate how climate change affects the stability of rock slopes.

projects.title: Predicting the excavation damage zone of tunnels in quasi-brittle rocks
projects.summary: Predict the extent of the excavation damage zone around tunnels excavated in quasi-brittle rocks.

projects.title: Interaction between Shear-banding & re-inforcements in geotechnical engineering
projects.summary: Study the interaction between shear banding and reinforcements in geotechnical engineering.

projects.title: Elastic rebounding due to retreating Glaciers in the Alps
projects.summary: Study the elastic rebound of Alpine bedrock caused by retreating glaciers.

projects.title: Limit analysis for geotechnical engineering ULS design
projects.summary: Apply limit analysis to ultimate limit state design in geotechnical engineering.

projects.title: Modeling the geomechanical response of hydrogen/co2 storage in porous media
projects.summary: Model the geomechanical response of porous media to hydrogen or CO2 storage.

projects.title: Imaging of fracture and defects using active and passive acoustics
projects.summary: Image fractures and defects in materials using active and passive acoustic methods.

projects.title: Analysis of an in-situ injection experiment at the Bedretto Res. Lab.
projects.summary: Analyse data from an in-situ fluid injection experiment at the Bedretto Underground Laboratory for Geosciences and Geoenergies.

projects.title: Revisting the Barbarbunga magmatic intrusion sequence
projects.summary: Revisit the magmatic intrusion sequence of the Bárðarbunga volcanic system.

projects.title: Imaging of fractures and defect via acoustic imaging (lab)
projects.summary: A semester project on imaging fractures and defects in materials using acoustic imaging, carried out in the laboratory.

projects.title: Modeling of fracture propagation in geo-materials
projects.summary: A semester project on numerically modeling how fractures propagate in geological materials.

projects.title: Numerical limit analysis for geotechnical design
projects.summary: A semester project applying numerical limit analysis to geotechnical design problems.

projects.title: Modeling/monitoring of surface deformation induced by fluid injection/withdrawal
projects.summary: A semester project on modeling and monitoring the surface deformation caused by fluid injection and withdrawal in the subsurface.

projects.title: Deep learning and neural network approaches for Solid Oxide Cell based Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy analysis
projects.summary: Apply deep learning and neural networks to analyse electrochemical impedance spectroscopy data from solid oxide cells.

projects.title: Characterization of Sorbents for Hot Gas Desulfurization in Biogas-Fueled SOFC Systems
projects.summary: Characterize sorbent materials used for hot gas desulfurization of biogas feeding solid oxide fuel cell systems.

projects.title: Solid Oxide Cell based Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Dataset for Deep Learning and Neural Network Applications
projects.summary: Build a dataset of electrochemical impedance spectroscopy measurements on solid oxide cells for use in deep learning and neural network applications.

projects.title: System modeling and optimization of co-SOE/FT system for e-fuels production- Modelling
projects.summary: Model and optimise a combined solid oxide electrolysis and Fischer-Tropsch system for producing e-fuels.

projects.title: Ammonia to electricity: performance and stability of a Solid Oxide Fuel Cell
projects.summary: Study the performance and stability of a solid oxide fuel cell operating on ammonia to produce electricity.

projects.title: System modeling and optimization of co-SOE/FT system for e-fuels production – TEA/LCA
projects.summary: Perform a techno-economic and life cycle assessment of a combined solid oxide electrolysis and Fischer-Tropsch system for e-fuels production.

projects.title: Life Cycle Assessment of Hydrogen Generation by the emerging Electrolyzer Technologies
projects.summary: Assess the environmental impacts of hydrogen generation using emerging electrolyzer technologies through life cycle assessment.

projects.title: Physics-based Modeling of PEM Fuel Cell Systems using Modelica
projects.summary: Develop physics-based models of PEM fuel cell systems using the Modelica language.

projects.title: 3D Modeling (with CFD and Heat transfer) of a Solid Oxide Electrolyzer for Syngas Production
projects.summary: Build a 3D model combining CFD and heat transfer of a solid oxide electrolyzer producing syngas.

projects.title: Kinetic Modeling of Hot Gas Desulfurization for Biogas-Fueled SOFC Systems
projects.summary: Develop a kinetic model of hot gas desulfurization for solid oxide fuel cell systems fuelled by biogas.

projects.title: Evaluating the effect of the dispersion media on the colloidal stability in catalyst inks for PEMFC
projects.summary: Evaluate how the dispersion medium affects the colloidal stability of catalyst inks for PEM fuel cells.

projects.title: Effect of the dispersion protocol on the colloidal stability of PEMFC inks
projects.summary: Investigate how the dispersion protocol influences the colloidal stability of PEM fuel cell inks.

projects.title: Accelerated Stress Tests for Anion Exchange Membrane Water Electrolyzers
projects.summary: Design and run accelerated stress tests on anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers to assess their durability.

projects.title: CFD Simulation: Two-Phase Flow in Porous Media
projects.summary: Simulate two-phase flow in porous media with computational fluid dynamics.

projects.title: Magnetotomography Investigation on a new method for fuel cell current density distribution measurement
projects.summary: Investigate magnetotomography as a new method for measuring the current density distribution in fuel cells.

projects.title: AEMWE Bubble Imaging Setup
projects.summary: Build an imaging setup to observe gas bubbles in anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers.

projects.title: Structural Mechanics Study for a Pressurized AEMWE Stack
projects.summary: Carry out a structural mechanics study of a pressurized anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer stack.

projects.title: Lock-In Thermography for Identification of Bubble Production Hot Spots
projects.summary: Use lock-in thermography to locate hot spots of bubble production in electrolyzers.

projects.title: Engineering a Corrosion-Resistant Stack for Direct Seawater Electrolysis
projects.summary: Engineer an electrolyzer stack resistant to corrosion for direct electrolysis of seawater.

projects.title: Design and Experimental Validation of Electrochemical Models Using a Reference-Electrode Setup
projects.summary: Design a reference-electrode setup and use it to experimentally validate electrochemical models.

projects.title: Surrogate model development for of a water electrolyzer using deep learning
projects.summary: Develop a deep learning surrogate model of a water electrolyzer.

projects.title: Modelling of Parasitic Electrolyzer Currents
projects.summary: Model the parasitic currents that occur in electrolyzers.

projects.title: Electrochemical Simulation of an Electrolyzer
projects.summary: Simulate the electrochemical behaviour of an electrolyzer.

projects.title: Fast EIS Development of a new technique for fast electrochemical impedance spectroscopy
projects.summary: Develop a new technique that allows electrochemical impedance spectroscopy to be measured faster.

projects.title: Valorization of cheese whey in a bio-electrolysis stack
projects.summary: Valorise cheese whey as feedstock in a bio-electrolysis stack.

projects.title: Continuous Solvo-Chemical Reactor
projects.summary: Develop a continuous solvo-chemical reactor.

projects.title: Experimental characterization of metal hydride cells under challenging conditions
projects.summary: Experimentally characterise metal hydride cells under demanding operating conditions.

projects.title: Solid Oxide Cell based Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Dataset for Deep Learning and Neural Network Applications
projects.summary: Build the first solid oxide cell (SOC) electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) dataset from GEM's historical data and literature, to support deep learning and neural networks that separate the electrochemical processes inside the cell. The work includes a literature review, data collection, and building a pandas-based dataset in Python.

projects.title: Deep learning and neural network approaches for Solid Oxide Cell based Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy analysis
projects.summary: Study how deep learning and neural network methods can analyse solid oxide cell electrochemical impedance spectroscopy data, including curve smoothing, noise removal, and separating electrochemical processes to quantify their resistances, building on existing DRT, equivalent circuit and CNLS fit methods.

projects.title: AEMWE Bubble Imaging Setup
projects.summary: Build an imaging setup with a high-speed camera and transparent endplates to record hydrogen and oxygen bubble evolution in an anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer (AEMWE) as a function of applied current. Segment the bubbles and compute their properties, such as size distribution and occupied volume, and repeat for different porous transport layer (PTL) configurations.

projects.title: Accelerated Stress Tests for Anion Exchange Membrane Water Electrolyzers
projects.summary: The project aims to conduct accelerated stress tests (ASTs) under adverse conditions such as high currents, voltages, temperatures, KOH concentration and cyclic loading to study degradation of the anodic porous transport layer in anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers. It is part of the HyPrAEM Horizon Europe project and its results feed long-term stack testing.

projects.title: Characterization of Sorbents for Hot Gas Desulfurization in Biogas-Fueled SOFC Systems
projects.summary: Evaluate various sorbents for hydrogen sulfide removal from contaminated biogas under different temperatures and gas flow rates, to identify the most effective sorbents and optimal hot gas desulfurization conditions compatible with SOFC operation. The work includes a literature review and experimental characterization of selected sorbents.

projects.title: Lock-In Thermography for Identification of Bubble Production Hot Spots
projects.summary: Study how oxygen bubbles trapped in the porous transport layers of anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers affect cell efficiency, using lock-in thermography to locate bubble accumulation hot spots and inform cell design and PTL design.

projects.title: Magnetotomography: Investigation on a new method for fuel cell current density distribution measurement
projects.summary: Reconstruct the internal 2D current density distribution of a fuel cell MEA from external magnetic field measurements taken with small magnetometers. The work combines a literature review, numerical inverse-problem solving, and validation on a 3x3 wire array with controlled currents.

projects.title: Structural Mechanics Study for a Pressurized AEMWE Stack
projects.summary: Study the structural mechanics of a 500 cm2 circular anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer (AEMWE) stack, integrating a new circular flow channel design into the existing model. The goal is to optimize the stack design for operation at 100 bar as part of scaling up to 100 kW.

projects.title: Ammonia to electricity: performance and stability of a Solid Oxide Fuel Cell
projects.summary: Investigate the direct use of ammonia in a Solid Oxide Fuel Cell by screening a single cell under varied temperature, fuel utilization and gas composition, assessing ammonia's effect on performance and degradation using cyclic voltammetry, EIS, and gas analysis. The work is within the EU AMON project.

projects.title: System modeling and optimization of co-SOE/FT system for e-fuels production
projects.summary: The project covers system-level modeling and optimization of a co-electrolysis (co-SOE) and Fischer-Tropsch (FT) system that converts renewable electricity, steam and CO into syngas for e-fuels and sustainable aviation fuel. It includes multi-objective optimization and uncertainty and sensitivity analyses, with attention to heat integration, cell degradation and coking. The work is done in collaboration with GEM and IPESE.

projects.title: Life Cycle Assessment of Hydrogen Generation by the emerging Electrolyzer Technologies
projects.summary: Build a life cycle assessment model of the manufacturing of anion exchange membrane (AEM) and proton conducting ceramic cell (PCC) electrolyzers in OpenLCA, identify the key manufacturing steps driving emissions, and run sensitivity analyses on scenarios such as material recycling rate and energy source.

projects.title: Physics-based Modeling of PEM Fuel Cell Systems using Modelica
projects.summary: Develop and refine a dynamic PEM fuel cell system model in Modelica/OpenModelica, covering stack voltage losses, gas utilization, balance of plant (air, hydrogen, cooling), feedback control, and validation against manufacturer and load data. The work is done in collaboration with GEM and IPESE.

projects.title: System modeling and optimization of co-SOE/FT system for e-fuels production
projects.summary: Model and optimize a co-electrolysis solid oxide electrolysis (co-SOE) and Fischer-Tropsch (FT) system producing e-fuels such as sustainable aviation fuel. The work includes techno-economic analysis (TEA) and life cycle assessment (LCA) under different scenarios, identifying key processes and running sensitivity analyses.

projects.title: CFD Simulation: Two-Phase Flow in Porous Media
projects.summary: CFD simulations of two-phase (gas bubble) flow in porous transport layers of anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers, varying microstructure properties such as porosity and permeability and adding a porosity gradient via an intermediate microporous layer, to help optimise the PTL microstructure. The work includes improving an existing multi-physics model developed in the lab.

projects.title: 3D Modeling (with CFD and Heat transfer) of a Solid Oxide Electrolyzer for Syngas Production
projects.summary: Build and validate a steady-state COMSOL model of a solid oxide electrolysis cell operated in co-electrolysis of H₂O and CO₂ to produce syngas. The project then uses the validated model to study how temperature, inlet H₂O:CO₂ ratio and current density affect outlet H₂:CO ratio and cell efficiency.

projects.title: Kinetic Modeling of Hot Gas Desulfurization for Biogas-Fueled SOFC Systems
projects.summary: Develop a dynamic 0D kinetic model of a fixed-bed hot gas desulfurization reactor that predicts H2S breakthrough curves for multicomponent biogas as a function of temperature, gas composition, flow rate and sorbent type. The model will be benchmarked against experimental breakthrough data generated in parallel, to support the protection of solid oxide fuel cells from sulfur poisoning.

projects.title: Evaluating the effect of the dispersion media on the colloidal stability in catalyst inks for PEMFC
projects.summary: Investigate how different solvent mixtures and ionomer contents affect the colloidal stability of Pt-C catalyst inks for PEM fuel cells, using zeta-potential and particle size (DLS) measurements, with xDLVO calculations for validation.

projects.title: Effect of the dispersion protocol on the colloidal stability of PEMFC inks
projects.summary: The project investigates how the dispersion protocol affects the colloidal stability of PEM fuel cell catalyst inks. The student evaluates agglomeration kinetics over time through particle size analysis and zeta potential measurements, after selecting solvent mixture and ionomer content from the literature.

projects.title: Engineering a Corrosion-Resistant Stack for Direct Seawater Electrolysis
projects.summary: The project develops corrosion-resistant and lightweight stack components for direct seawater electrolysis. It combines a literature review and corrosion testing of materials and coatings on an existing test bench with the design and prototyping of polymer-based stack parts and ways to integrate electrical current paths into them.

projects.title: Surrogate model development for of a water electrolyzer using deep learning
projects.summary: Improve a deep neural network surrogate model of an anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer (AEMWE) by adding more electrolyzer parameters and using real experimental data. The goal is faster, more accurate efficiency predictions for new operating conditions, to support long-term control and a future digital twin.

projects.title: Design and Experimental Validation of Electrochemical Models Using a Reference-Electrode Setup
projects.summary: The project focuses on designing and using a reference-electrode setup to independently measure anode and cathode potentials in an anion exchange membrane electrolyser operated with direct seawater. The experimental data will be used to validate separate anode and cathode electrochemical models.

projects.title: Engineering a modified centriole duplication cycle in human cells
projects.summary: Engineer and analyze the centriole duplication cycle in human cells with altered control of organelle number. The project relies on molecular and cell biology, expansion microscopy, super-resolution microscopy and live imaging.

projects.title: Analyzing novel centriolar proteins in Chlamydomonas reinhardtii
projects.summary: Identify the localization and test the function of novel centriolar proteins in the green alga Chlamydomonas reinhardtii, using CRISPR/Cas9-mediated GFP tagging and disruption together with expansion and super-resolution microscopy.

projects.title: Investigate mechanisms of centriole elimination using C. elegans
projects.summary: Discover the mechanisms that regulate centriole half-life during C. elegans oogenesis and embryogenesis, using an RNAi-based functional genomic screen and live imaging.

projects.title: Analyzing centriole fate during zebrafish muscle formation
projects.summary: Monitor centrosome and centriole fate during muscle formation in zebrafish embryos using 4D light-sheet live imaging, RNA/DNA injection, and tracking algorithms developed and applied by the student.

projects.title: Single cell RNA-seq of centriole biogenesis in Naegleria
projects.summary: Discover and characterize components induced during de novo centriole biogenesis in the protist Naegleria gruberi, using single-cell RNA-seq together with cell biology, immunofluorescence, expansion microscopy and live imaging.

projects.title: Evolutionary diversity and origin of centriolar proteins
projects.summary: Identify homologues of fundamental centriolar proteins across the domains of life to help trace the origin of the centriole, and test candidates in cell-free assays. The project is a collaboration between the Bitbol and Gönczy laboratories.

projects.title: Determination of the bioavailability of chemical additives from plastics and tire particles using simulated lung fluid
projects.summary: Study the bioavailability of chemical additives released from plastic and tire particles, using simulated lung fluid as the test medium.

projects.title: Development of an analytical method based on molecular rotors for the detection of nanoplastics in environmental samples
projects.summary: Develop an analytical method using molecular rotors to detect nanoplastics in environmental samples.

projects.title: Evaluation of the contamination of the lake sediments by per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)
projects.summary: Evaluate the contamination of lake sediments by per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

projects.title: Assessing the contamination of fishes by micropollutants using non-targeted analysis
projects.summary: Assess the contamination of fish by micropollutants using non-targeted analysis.

projects.title: Pollutants analysis in the environment
projects.summary: The project concerns the analysis of pollutants in environmental samples. The page gives no further detail on methods or objectives.

projects.title: Traitement des déchets verts sur le campus EPFL : évaluation d'un activateur de compostage en vue de l'accélération du traitement local et durable de résidus organiques
projects.summary: Evaluate a composting activator to speed up local and sustainable treatment of green waste produced on the EPFL campus. The goal is to accelerate the processing of organic residues on site.

projects.title: Interactions between microplastics and micropollutants
projects.summary: Study the interactions between microplastics and micropollutants in the environment.

projects.title: Interactions between micro-/nano-plastics and planktonic bacteria
projects.summary: Investigate how micro- and nanoplastics interact with planktonic bacteria in aquatic systems.

projects.title: Extraction and analysis of nanoplastics
projects.summary: Develop methods to extract and analyse nanoplastics from environmental samples.

projects.title: Formation of carcinogenic N-nitrosamines in natural and engineered aquatic systems
projects.summary: Study how carcinogenic N-nitrosamines form in natural and engineered aquatic systems.

projects.title: Reconstructing experience through real-time decoding of neural data
projects.summary: Develop a fast pipeline that compresses and extracts features directly from streaming calcium imaging video of the mouse hippocampus. The features are used for real-time decoding of the animal's position in a virtual environment, and decoding accuracy is compared to decoding from ground-truth neuron segmentation.

projects.title: LLM-Evolved Repair Layers for Neural Optimal Power Flow Proxies
projects.summary: Develops repair layers, evolved with large language models, to improve neural network proxies for optimal power flow in power systems.

projects.title: Grid-Aware, Fair and Adaptive Formation of Local Energy Communities
projects.summary: Studies how local energy communities can be formed in a grid-aware, fair and adaptive way.

projects.title: Optimal PV Feed-in Limits in Swiss Distribution Grids: Trading off Curtailment Remuneration against Grid Reinforcement
projects.summary: Investigates optimal photovoltaic feed-in limits in Swiss distribution grids, weighing curtailment remuneration against grid reinforcement costs.

projects.title: Dynamic Operating Envelopes Using Voltage Sensitivity for Distribution Networks
projects.summary: Explores dynamic operating envelopes for distribution networks based on voltage sensitivity analysis.

projects.title: Fair and Efficient Optimization of Distribution Grid Interconnection Queues Using Flexible Connection Agreements
projects.summary: Aims to optimize distribution grid interconnection queues fairly and efficiently using flexible connection agreements.

projects.title: Physics-Grounded RAG-Enhanced LLM Agents for Reliable Power-System Simulation, Optimization, and Security Assessment
projects.summary: Develops LLM agents grounded in physics and augmented with retrieval for power-system simulation, optimization and security assessment.

projects.title: Data-driven Network Reduction for Electrical Distribution Networks for TSO-DSO Coordination
projects.summary: Studies data-driven network reduction of electrical distribution networks to support coordination between transmission and distribution system operators.

projects.title: Extrapolation and Directional Anisotropic Behavior of Neural Operators for Power-Flow Applications
projects.summary: Examines extrapolation and directional anisotropic behaviour of neural operators applied to power-flow problems.

projects.title: Dynamic Operating Envelopes Using Voltage Sensitivity for Distribution Networks
projects.summary: Develop a framework for computing dynamic operating envelopes in distribution networks that combines local voltage measurements with voltage sensitivity information to define adaptive, risk-aware, real-time limits on DER power injection or consumption. The work includes a baseline DOE implementation, a feedback-based DOE design, and performance comparison on a distribution grid model.

projects.title: Data-driven Network Reduction for Electrical Distribution Networks for TSO-DSO Coordination
projects.summary: Develop data-driven techniques to reduce the complexity of electrical distribution network models while preserving the operational characteristics needed for TSO-DSO coordination. The reduced-order models are to be evaluated for accuracy, computational efficiency, and suitability for congestion management, flexibility assessment and voltage stability analysis.

projects.title: Extrapolation and Directional Anisotropic Behavior of Neural Operators for Power-Flow Applications
projects.summary: Study how neural network and physics-informed neural network surrogates for power flow and optimal power flow solvers extrapolate beyond their training regions. The goal is to quantify the reliability radius of these surrogates, its directional anisotropy, and its scaling with network width and depth.

projects.title: Physics-Grounded RAG-Enhanced LLM Agents for Reliable Power-System Simulation, Optimization, and Security Assessment
projects.summary: Develop an agentic AI framework in which LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and power-system simulation tools (e.g. pandapower) answer natural-language requests such as power flow, optimal power flow and N-1 contingency analysis, with physics-based validation of the results and explanatory reports.

projects.title: Fair and Efficient Optimization of Distribution Grid Interconnection Queues Using Flexible Connection Agreements
projects.summary: Develop and test an optimization-based framework for allocating scarce distribution-grid capacity among queued DER connection projects. The work explores flexible or curtailable connection agreements to increase connected projects while maintaining network security and fairness.

projects.title: Grid-Aware, Fair and Adaptive Formation of Local Energy Communities
projects.summary: Develop a scalable method that recommends which buildings should form a local energy community, how benefits are shared, and how the community adapts as members change. The approach combines coalition formation, fair benefit sharing (Shapley, nucleolus, pro-rata) and optimisation-based control of heat pumps, storage and EVs within distribution system operator limits.

projects.title: Optimal PV Feed-in Limits in Swiss Distribution Grids: Trading off Curtailment Remuneration against Grid Reinforcement
projects.summary: Develop an optimization-based planning framework to find the optimal PV feed-in limit k* in Swiss distribution grids, minimising the DSO's curtailment remuneration cost plus grid reinforcement capex. The approach uses a two-stage stochastic MILP with LinDistFlow constraints and compares fixed-tariff, spot, and DLMP remuneration.

projects.title: LLM-Evolved Repair Layers for Neural Optimal Power Flow Proxies
projects.summary: Uses large language models in an evolutionary program-search loop to design repair procedures that turn neural-network optimal power flow proxy outputs into feasible operating points. The goal is to restore AC feasibility faster and closer to optimality than hand-designed repairs, and to test whether the evolved programs transfer across grids, proxies and operating conditions.

projects.title: Stability of Gravity Jets
projects.summary: Investigates the dynamics of a horizontal jet of heavy salt water injected into lighter fresh water, which is relevant to pollutant dispersion and outfall design. The work combines theoretical analysis and OpenFOAM numerical simulations to clarify how trajectory, dilution and mixing depend on the Richardson number.

projects.title: Wind driven rotating sloshing waves in hydro turbine draft tube
projects.summary: Develops a theoretical description of the wind-driven free-surface sloshing wave in a partially filled hydro turbine draft tube operating in condenser mode. The work starts from linear stability analysis of gravity waves under parallel air flow and extends it to a cylindrical geometry to study azimuthal modes.

projects.title: Bubble vortex breakdown in a cylindrical cavity
projects.summary: Studies the base flow and axisymmetric stability of a swirling flow in a cylindrical cavity with a small second-phase bubble on the axis. Numerical simulations (COMSOL or Basilisk) are used to determine parameter ranges (Reynolds, Froude, Weber numbers and aspect ratio) that sustain a stable bubble.

projects.title: Exploring triggers, co-adoption patterns, and spatial contexts in the residential building sector
projects.summary: Investigates the triggers, co-adoption patterns and spatial contexts of building-sector changes in the residential sector. Students apply for the open project by sending a CV and a brief project proposal to the lab.

projects.title: Urban resilience at the international level: Using the global human settlement area data for analyzing urban resilience across continents
projects.summary: Uses global human settlement area data to analyse urban resilience across continents. Students apply by sending a CV and a brief project proposal to the lab.

projects.title: Urban metabolism revisited: Quantifying urban stocks of durables and simulating circularity scenarios
projects.summary: Quantifies urban stocks of durable goods and simulates circularity scenarios for cities. It builds on urban metabolism and material flow analysis.

projects.title: Sequencing in urban transitions: Analyzing the role of time in urban transitions
projects.summary: Analyses the role of time and sequencing in urban transitions. Students apply by sending a CV and a brief project proposal to the lab.

projects.title: A social-ecological typology of civic nature-based solutions in cities
projects.summary: Aims to develop a social-ecological typology of civic nature-based solutions in cities. Students apply by sending a CV and a brief project proposal to the lab.

projects.title: Improving urban land surface temperature mapping: Comparing thermal sharpening methods
projects.summary: Compares thermal sharpening methods to improve the mapping of urban land surface temperature. Students apply by sending a CV and a brief project proposal to the lab.

projects.title: Supply-side interventions and behavioral options in urban provisioning systems: Developing a database and assessment framework for cities
projects.summary: Develops a database and assessment framework for cities covering supply-side interventions and behavioural options in urban provisioning systems. It is offered as a specialization project for the Master in Urban Systems (MUS).

projects.title: Co-living for urban sufficiency: Identifying regulative and institutional barriers, and well-being impacts of new housing models
projects.summary: Identifies regulative and institutional barriers to co-living and assesses the well-being impacts of new housing models for urban sufficiency. Students apply by sending a CV and a brief project proposal to the lab.

projects.title: Exploring Triggers, Co-Adoption Patterns, and Spatial Contexts in the Residential Building Sector
projects.summary: The thesis investigates the spatial heterogeneity of energy retrofits and low-carbon technology adoption in residential buildings, identifying triggers that motivate homeowners to act and how co-adoption dynamics vary across spatial contexts. It builds on the ABM4EnergyTransition survey of 2,410 homeowners in Styria, Austria, using GIS and statistical modelling in R and/or Python.

projects.title: The impact of real-time indoor air quality awareness on occupant behavior and ventilation rates in student dwellings
projects.summary: Investigates whether a visible CO2 meter display changes occupants' behaviour and improves indoor air quality in student dwellings. CO2, temperature and humidity are monitored in bedrooms and living rooms over two weeks, with and without display feedback.

projects.title: Indoor air quality and thermal comfort assessment at university campus building
projects.summary: Assesses indoor air quality and thermal comfort in regularly occupied campus offices and an auditorium using multi-pollutant and thermal instruments, combined with occupant surveys. Results are compared with local and international standards and green building certifications.

projects.title: Building and testing a low-cost thermal manikin
projects.summary: Hands-on project to design and build a simplified, low-cost thermal manikin as an alternative to commercial models costing over 100,000 CHF. The prototype is tested using infrared imaging, temperature and velocity measurements, and smoke visualization.

projects.title: Performance assessment of natural ventilation in Swiss residences
projects.summary: Investigates the performance of natural ventilation through window openings in residential buildings, considering outdoor conditions and occupant behaviour. The work uses direct measurements in residences or building performance simulation tools such as EnergyPlus.

projects.title: Assessment of air quality and thermal comfort on public transport
projects.summary: Measures air pollutants and thermal comfort parameters inside trains, buses and metros to characterise passenger microenvironments. The goal is to assess exposure and comfort during commuting.

projects.title: Human inhalation exposure to carbon dioxide and particulate matter in built environment
projects.summary: Aims to better understand individuals' exposure to carbon dioxide and particulate matter across indoor and outdoor spaces in daily life. The project uses portable scientific instruments to measure exposure levels.

projects.title: Integrating Indoor Air Quality and Life Cycle Assessment of Ventilation Strategies in Buildings
projects.summary: Compares mechanical, natural and hybrid ventilation strategies in terms of indoor air quality and life-cycle environmental impact, using a real case-study building. The aim is a framework linking IAQ performance with embodied and operational energy.

projects.title: Exploring the Global Thermal Comfort Database
projects.summary: Explores the ASHRAE Global Thermal Comfort Database II using its interactive visualization tool and the full dataset. The student identifies variables influencing thermal comfort perception and critically examines standard comfort assumptions.

projects.title: Assessing building energy performance and indoor thermal conditions under extreme heat
projects.summary: Studies the trade-off between saving building energy and protecting occupants from heat during extreme weather. The project combines engineering and public health methods, and students would work on the energy modelling components.

projects.title: Building and Testing an Air Cleaner for Enhanced Indoor Air Quality
projects.summary: Students build a Corsi-Rosenthal box air cleaner and test its performance in indoor environments with air quality instrumentation. The project assesses how well the device reduces particulate matter, allergens and other pollutants.

projects.title: Mapping Spatiotemporal Indoor Environmental Quality (IEQ) Dynamics in a Naturally Ventilated Office
projects.summary: Analyses high-resolution IEQ data from about 20 low-cost sensors in a naturally ventilated shared office at EPFL Fribourg. The goal is to quantify spatial and temporal variations and their drivers, such as occupancy, window use and outdoor conditions.

projects.title: Mitigating Dust Exposure in Indoor Climbing Gyms
projects.summary: Measures particle concentrations and size distributions during climbing activities in indoor climbing gyms using optical particle counters. Occupant surveys on comfort and health are combined with the data to identify particle reduction strategies.

projects.title: Identification of Braess links in traffic networks
projects.summary: The project studies Braess links, road links whose addition worsens traffic congestion, in stylized and general road networks. It aims to identify them, find their common properties, and develop heuristics to detect them without extensive computation.

projects.title: Exploring critical origin-destination (OD) pairs for congestion mitigation
projects.summary: The project investigates critical origin-destination pairs whose vehicles, when strategically controlled, bring traffic close to the system optimum. It aims to characterise their distribution across networks and to design metrics that evaluate how critical an OD pair is.

projects.title: Scheduling problem of transportation network maintenance
projects.summary: Studies how to schedule maintenance works on road, tram, and rail networks, where links under maintenance are blocked and resources are limited. The goal is to keep network quality while minimizing the impact on transport efficiency.

projects.title: Labeling Algorithm Design for Mobile Sensing Vehicle Routing
projects.summary: Extends classical labeling algorithms from vehicle routing to mobile sensing routing, which involves repeated visits, nonlinear sensing objectives, and diminishing returns. The project includes developing dominance rules and pruning strategies and benchmarking against a commercial solver.

projects.title: Optimal transport based urban pollution modeling and prediction
projects.summary: Investigates whether urban air pollution transport can be modeled with optimal transport, and compares an OT-based spatiotemporal interpolation approach to standard baselines.

projects.title: Activity-based individual pollution exposure estimation
projects.summary: Aims to estimate personalized air pollution exposure by combining high-resolution pollution data from Lausanne and Geneva with individual mobility traces. The project includes propagating model uncertainty into exposure estimates and validating them.

projects.title: Pollution-aware route planning for EPFL community (HOMES x Campus Motion)
projects.summary: Develops a routing algorithm for walking and jogging that balances route length, directness, and cumulative air pollution exposure, using HOMES' high-resolution pollution map. The routing is to be tested in daily scenarios with the EPFL community in collaboration with Campus Motion.

projects.title: Stationary and mobile info-box location design on EPFL campus (HOMES x Campus Motion)
projects.summary: Formulates a customized facility location problem for placing info boxes on the EPFL campus and proposes adaptive relocation strategies based on user data. The work is evaluated through simulations and/or real data.

projects.title: FLEX-TUS: fMRI Data Acquisition During a Reversal Learning Task After Thalamic TUS in a Healthy Cohort
projects.summary: Collect structural and functional MRI data from a healthy cohort (n=20) performing a reversal-learning task after transcranial ultrasound stimulation of the mediodorsal thalamus, including recruitment and data collection. A side project on reinforcement learning modelling, ultrasound acoustic simulations or sonication placement planning may also be included.

projects.title: Understanding the electrophysiological impact of striatal tTIS on the STN during effort-based decision-making through invasive recordings
projects.summary: Study how striatal temporal interference stimulation (tTIS) affects subthalamic nucleus local field potentials recorded through new-generation DBS implants in Parkinson's disease patients during an effort-based decision-making task, ON and OFF dopaminergic treatment, to find a neural signature of tTIS.

projects.title: Neural network correlates of Temporal Interference Stimulation in human decision-making
projects.summary: Investigate the neural network correlates of effort-based decision-making and the neural effects of striatal temporal interference stimulation (tTIS) in healthy older participants scanned with fMRI, combining fMRI analysis and computational modelling.

projects.title: Dynamic coactivation patterns of motor networks in stroke patients during hand-gripper tasks
projects.summary: Use coactivation pattern (CAP) analysis of task-based fMRI to characterise time-resolved motor network dynamics during hand-gripper tasks in stroke patients, and relate CAP measures to motor performance and recovery.

projects.title: From slow waves to perturbational complexity: nonequilibrium brain dynamics after stroke
projects.summary: Link slow-wave dynamics measured with TMS-EEG and resting-state fMRI to temporal irreversibility and the perturbational complexity index in stroke patients, to understand network dysfunction and recovery potential.

projects.title: Hybrid EEG–fMRI mapping after stroke
projects.summary: Apply hybrid connectivity independent component analysis (connICA) to resting-state EEG and fMRI data from stroke patients to identify joint EEG–fMRI connectivity networks that differ between lesioned and healthy regions and track their changes during recovery.

projects.title: Longitudinal analysis of post-stroke brain dynamics using DySCo
projects.summary: Apply the Dynamic Symmetric Connectivity Matrix (DySCo) framework to longitudinal fMRI data from stroke patients to derive time-varying connectivity and relate network dynamics measures to recovery.

projects.title: Dissecting stimulation-induced mechanisms of post-stroke brain reorganization through BOLD co-fluctuation dynamics
projects.summary: Apply a cascade-based framework of BOLD co-fluctuation dynamics to resting-state fMRI from stroke patients acquired with and without temporal interference stimulation of the striatum, to identify stimulation-specific changes in brain dynamics and functional connectivity.

projects.title: Behavioral dynamics of hand motor performance in stroke patients: longitudinal and virtual lesion analyses
projects.summary: Analyse behavioural data from stroke patients performing an isometric hand-gripper task, comparing grip force performance across time points and between baseline and TMS-induced virtual lesion conditions to identify behavioural markers of recovery.

projects.title: Shape Light with Nanostructures – Semester Project in Ultrafast Photonics
projects.summary: A semester project on shaping light with nanostructures in the context of ultrafast photonics. The page lists it under master thesis announcements.

projects.title: Development of a heterodyne detection system
projects.summary: Development of a heterodyne detection system, a measurement technique used in photonics and terahertz research.

projects.title: Cryogenic study of millimeter-wave/terahertz integrated chips
projects.summary: Cryogenic characterisation of integrated chips operating at millimeter-wave and terahertz frequencies.

projects.title: Designing and simulation of phase-matched THz transmission line on fully etched thin-film lithium niobate
projects.summary: Design and simulation of a phase-matched terahertz transmission line and integrated THz device on fully etched thin-film lithium niobate.

projects.title: Designing, Simulating and Characterizing Periodically Poled Lithium Niobate Waveguides
projects.summary: Design, simulation and characterisation of periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) waveguides.

projects.title: Cryogenic study of millimeter-wave/terahertz integrated chips
projects.summary: Characterise millimeter-wave and terahertz photonic integrated circuits on thin-film lithium niobate at cryogenic temperatures (4 K or below) using a cryostat or dilution refrigerator. The work involves designing microwave and fiber-based optical setups inside the cryostat.

projects.title: Designing and simulation of phase-matched THz transmission line on fully etched thin-film lithium niobate
projects.summary: Design a new integrated THz device structure with a phase-matched transmission line on a fully etched thin-film lithium niobate waveguide (about 600 nm) to avoid the crosstalk and interference signal seen in partly etched (about 300 nm) designs. The work includes simulation of the device.

projects.title: Shape Light with Nanostructures – Semester Project in Ultrafast Photonics
projects.summary: Design, simulate and experimentally characterize photonic nanostructures that control the phase and amplitude of femtosecond laser pulses. Simulated nanostructures are to be fabricated at CMI and tested by reconstructing the shaped pulse with FROG.

projects.title: Development of a heterodyne detection system
projects.summary: Develop a heterodyne detection system that mixes a monochromatic reference laser with unknown light on a photodetector, so that the resulting AC voltage can be used to characterise the spectrum of the light under test. The work includes a systematic study of measurement characteristics across hardware and software configurations.

projects.title: Periodically Poled Lithium Niobate Waveguides
projects.summary: Design, simulate and characterize periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) waveguides for second harmonic generation, for applications in quantum technologies and telecommunications. The student would also work on poling stations and optical characterization setups.

projects.title: Dynamic Frequency Allocation for Speech Separation
projects.summary: Investigates whether a speech separation model should allocate its frequency resolution dynamically according to each input mixture, keeping the computational budget fixed. Experiments use EchoSet and a new pathological speech mixing dataset based on PC-GITA.

projects.title: Efficient Robot Data Collection through Geometric Shared Autonomy
projects.summary: Extends the GeoSACS canal-surface interface so users can collect robot manipulation demonstrations with a joystick in a low-dimensional correction space. The approach is compared with conventional teleoperation on speed, data quality and workload.

projects.title: Assessing Lyrics-Based Item Profiles for Music Information Retrieval
projects.summary: Studies whether text-based item profiles built from lyrics and lyric-related resources give more task-relevant representations than direct lyric embeddings for MIR tasks such as genre, mood and tag prediction, and retrieval.

projects.title: A Cross-Cultural Study of Podcasts for Well-Being Information Dissemination
projects.summary: Analyses how health and well-being topics are framed in podcasts across cultures and languages, combining NLP on podcast metadata and transcripts with grounded-theory qualitative analysis, and relates framing to audience engagement.

projects.title: Faithful Vision-Language Explanations for Unified Face Attack Detection
projects.summary: Develops a face attack detector combined with a vision-language model that explains its decisions, with a verifier that tests whether generated explanation claims are causally supported by perturbing the image evidence.

projects.title: From Scientific Data to Citizen Communication: Weather Nowcasting in Malabo, Equatorial Guinea
projects.summary: Builds an end-to-end machine-learning pipeline for short-term torrential rain nowcasting in Malabo using open data and a local weather station, then a basic text-based alert system tested in a real scenario with local partners.

projects.title: Adapting foundation models for knowledge transfer in out-of-distribution medical data
projects.summary: Develops adaptive fine-tuning methods for foundation models that reduce performance disparities under distribution shift in medical data, together with benchmarks and evaluation protocols for drift and equity-performance trade-offs.

projects.title: Advancing CT-Based Characterization of Poorly Understood Vascular Diseases Through Foundation Models
projects.summary: Builds an interpretable computer-aided diagnostic tool for fibromuscular dysplasia from renal artery CT angiography, including 3D segmentation of renal arteries and machine learning classification of lesions across vessel regions, in collaboration with CHUV.

projects.title: Multimodal Learning for Automated Grading of Retinal Inflammation in Dynamic Imaging
projects.summary: Designs multimodal machine learning models to automatically detect and grade retinal inflammation from fluorescein angiography images and videos, and identifies interpretable imaging biomarkers of inflammatory eye disease.

projects.title: Pseudo labeling of Sensitive Attributes in Medical Imaging for Demographically Fair Machine Learning
projects.summary: Trains models that pseudo-label sensitive attributes such as gender or age in medical imaging datasets lacking demographic annotations, and assesses how incorporating these attributes affects fairness and performance of downstream models.

projects.title: Towards Scalable and Interpretable Foundation Models for physiologicals signals recorded during human sleep
projects.summary: Develops self-supervised pretraining strategies for polysomnographic and EEG signals to build transferable physiological signal encoders, evaluated on sleep staging, seizure detection and cross-dataset generalization.

projects.title: Agentic retrieval augmented generation interface for sleep Medicine
projects.summary: Builds a retrieval-augmented generation agent that retrieves sleep scoring guidelines and medical literature, integrates it with a central LLM reasoning hub, and provides a GUI demonstrator for clinicians to interact with and trace diagnostic rationale.

projects.title: From Audiobooks to Character Utterances: Automatic Annotation of Speakers in Literary Fiction
projects.summary: Aims to build a pipeline that automatically annotates speech utterances from LibriVox dramatic readings with their speaking character, creating a large annotated dataset for quotation attribution in English fiction.

projects.title: From Personal Stories to Collective Narratives: Computational Analysis of Health Narratives in Podcasts
projects.summary: Develops a computational framework that identifies personal health narratives in podcast transcripts and clusters them to reveal recurring narrative themes.

projects.title: Whole-Body Manipulation with Explicit Self-Balancing Control for Humanoid Robots
projects.summary: Develops a whole-body control strategy for a humanoid robot that jointly handles balance and manipulation, accounting for the mass and inertia of arms and manipulated objects, validated on the Unitree G1 platform.

projects.title: Robotics: Automated discovery of material properties using dextrous manipulation, vision tools, and learning agents.
projects.summary: Develops a classification framework for solid and semi-solid materials in an automated sampling workflow, using FR3 and UR3e robots, vision and force-torque sensing to identify properties such as viscosity, adhesiveness, cohesiveness and granularity.

projects.title: Design of robotic teleoperation interface
projects.summary: Designs a web-based teleoperation interface for the Lio robot, with back-end functions for navigation, manipulation and speech, and a tablet or phone frontend for demonstrations and assistive robotics design studies.

projects.title: Gaze-Guided Shared Autonomy for Object Manipulation
projects.summary: Enhances a joystick-based shared autonomy framework for object manipulation by fusing eye gaze with joystick input to predict user intent earlier and more accurately, especially in cluttered scenes.

projects.title: Cognitive architecture for assistive robots
projects.summary: Integrates the Lio robot with the DIARC cognitive architecture by connecting it to ROS and creating a Lio agent profile, then developing human-robot interaction demos.

projects.title: Scaling Pre-training for Gaze Following
projects.summary: Pre-trains gaze following models on large curated video datasets using pseudo-annotations from strong gaze following models, optionally adds weak auxiliary supervision, then fine-tunes and evaluates on annotated video datasets.

projects.title: Spatio-temporal Modeling of Human Behavior in Videos
projects.summary: Uses end-to-end spatio-temporal video encoders to learn facial behavior representations for head gesture and facial expression recognition, with possible joint weakly-supervised learning from pseudo-annotations.

projects.title: Research Spotlight: Crafting An Interactive Webpage Template for Showcasing Science
projects.summary: Develops a generic, feature-rich webpage template for showcasing research papers, including components for interactive model demonstrations built with tools such as Streamlit or Gradio.

projects.title: Person Head Detection
projects.summary: Compiles public datasets with head annotations and trains an object detector to locate whole human heads, including extreme head poses, with data augmentation, packaged as a modular inference pipeline for gaze tracking and head pose applications.

projects.title: From Gaze Following to Joint Attention
projects.summary: Trains and evaluates a transformer-based gaze following model on a new dataset, then extends it to predict joint attention between people end-to-end, to pseudo-annotate video segments with joint attention.

projects.title: Parametric Gaze Following
projects.summary: Explores casting gaze following as prediction of a parametric probability distribution, such as a mixture of Gaussians, instead of a heatmap, and proposes new metrics that capture more information about the predicted distribution.

projects.title: Pathological speech enhancement
projects.summary: Examines how state-of-the-art speech enhancement approaches perform on pathological speech affected by reverberation and noise, and develops approaches targeting pathological speech if time permits.

projects.title: Pathological speech detection in adverse environments
projects.summary: Evaluates automatic speech processing approaches for diagnosing motor speech disorders under the noise and reverberation of clinical recordings, and develops approaches targeting such adverse scenarios if time permits.

projects.title: Automatic speech recognition of air-traffic communication using grammar
projects.summary: Builds a baseline ASR engine for air-traffic controllers in Kaldi and explores context-free grammar language modelling based on ICAO phraseology, alone or combined with statistical language models.

projects.title: Error correction in speech recognition using large pre-trained language models
projects.summary: Investigates whether large pre-trained language models can correct errors in speech recognition transcriptions, including rescoring of N-best hypotheses and analysis of which error types are fixed.

projects.title: Speech/Music Classification
projects.summary: Develops a classifier that discriminates speech from music, and possibly noise, after analysing existing speech/music detectors and evaluating them with standard binary classification metrics.

projects.title: Speaker identification enhanced by the social network analyser
projects.summary: Builds a speaker identification engine and a graph analysis tool, then studies combining speech and social network information to improve person identification on simulated lawful-investigation data.

projects.title: Automatic named entity recognition from speech
projects.summary: Combines speech recognition and named entity recognition into a single end-to-end framework to detect named entities such as names and locations directly from speech, and compares it with independently trained modules.

projects.title: Punctuation restoration on automatic speech recognition output
projects.summary: Trains a model to add punctuation, and optionally capitalization, to ASR output to improve readability and downstream use, evaluated on several languages and real scenarios.

projects.title: Social media and crowdsourcing for social good
projects.summary: Offers several multidisciplinary projects on social media analytics, visualization of social and crowdsourced data, and smartphone apps for mobile crowdsourcing, in collaboration with researchers in Europe and the Majority World.

projects.title: Understanding the robustness of machine learning models on underspecified tasks
projects.summary: Studies how pre-training and fine-tuning affect the trade-off between in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance of deep learning models, with the goal of identifying robust models and preparing results for a scientific publication.

projects.title: Audiovisual person recognition
projects.summary: Develops audiovisual person identification by fusing existing audio and visual biometric systems, or by building a single system that takes both audio and visual embeddings as input.

projects.title: An open-source framework for the quantification of Urban Heat Islands in Switzerland
projects.summary: Builds an open-source Python or C++ framework that turns Swiss open data into inputs for CitySim and ENVI-met, adds Physiological Equivalent Temperature as a comfort indicator in CitySim, and compares the two simulation tools on Swiss case studies.

projects.title: Automatic identification of flight information from speech
projects.summary: Develops a unified module, for example an adapted BERT model, that maps speech directly to aircraft call-signs, and compares it with independently trained speech recognition and concept extraction modules for air traffic control.

projects.title: Understanding generalization in deep learning
projects.summary: Studies how properties of data and architectures, including randomly initialized networks, shape the inductive biases and generalization of deep learning models, through theoretical or practical contributions.

projects.title: Using large pretrained language models in speech recognition
projects.summary: Measures how large language models help speech recognition by rescoring N-best hypotheses of an ASR model, comparing model sizes and architectures and assessing the value of retraining the language model.

projects.title: Structure-Aware Generative Models for Spatiotemporal Systems
projects.summary: Explore how structural information about sensor networks can be built into diffusion and flow matching generative models to improve their effectiveness and efficiency for spatiotemporal signal processing of industrial systems.

projects.title: Physics-Informed Graph Neural Networks for Composite Material Simulation
projects.summary: Improve graph neural network surrogates of finite element simulations by adding physical and engineering inductive biases to the architecture, aiming for stable rollouts and simulation of dynamic oscillations of composite plates.

projects.title: Accurate Simulation of Materials with Graph Neural Network Finite Element Models
projects.summary: Incorporate material constitutive laws into a graph neural network so that it predicts material stress accurately, and evaluate this physics-informed approach against learning stress as a distinct objective.

projects.title: Federated Foundation Models for Electricity Load Forecasting
projects.summary: Build a federated fine-tuning pipeline for time-series foundation models on public smart-meter data, using parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA, and benchmark it against zero-shot, local fine-tuning and centralised training for load forecasting.

projects.title: Data-Driven Prioritization of Railway Track Inspections
projects.summary: Use historical SBB track measurements, infrastructure information and maintenance records to build predictive models and prioritisation strategies that identify track sections likely to need maintenance within a limited inspection budget.

projects.title: Building Self-Improving AI Research Agents for Prognostics and Health Management
projects.summary: Scale up and extend a multi-step agentic AI workflow that extracts structured knowledge from prognostics and health management papers and links it to benchmark tasks and evaluation criteria, producing a literature-to-evaluation pipeline prototype.

projects.title: Battery Lifetime Prediction under Changing Operating Conditions with Neural SDEs
projects.summary: Develop Neural Stochastic Differential Equations that learn battery degradation dynamics from simulated lifetime data generated with NASA's ProgPy, and forecast capacity and remaining useful life under changing future operating schedules.

projects.title: Robust Multi-Modal 3D Reconstruction
projects.summary: Develop 3D scene reconstruction methods that combine RGB and thermal imaging without strict pixel-level alignment, using contrastive learning for cross-modal correspondences and feature alignment in 3D space.

projects.title: Test-time Domain Adaptation for OOD Detection
projects.summary: Improve out-of-distribution detection under domain shift by applying and modifying test-time domain adaptation methods so that detection works online during inference, with road anomaly detection as an application case.

projects.title: Exploring Mimed and Covert Speech Decoding from EEG
projects.summary: Design and validate an EEG experiment for mimed and covert speech, collect a dataset, and assess whether a small vocabulary can be decoded. The project also studies which electrode locations and reduced channel configurations give the best decoding performance. It is designed for two students, each responsible for one speech condition.

projects.title: Patient-Independent Seizure Detection from Intracranial EEG
projects.summary: Develop deep learning methods that detect seizures from intracranial EEG recordings and generalize to unseen patients. The project evaluates models on public datasets and studies learned representations to improve robustness across subjects.

projects.title: Speech Decoding for Brain-Computer Interfaces
projects.summary: Develop and evaluate deep learning models that decode speech from neural activity for speech brain-computer interfaces. The project explores strategies to improve generalization across sessions and conditions and analyzes learned neural representations.

projects.title: Circuit Design and Verification for a Low-Power Neural Network Accelerator for Neural Decoding
projects.summary: Design and verify circuits that operate near threshold voltage with low leakage power, starting with a level shifter and SRAM for a neural decoding accelerator. Students review the literature, define specifications with PhD researchers, and evaluate the fabricated integrated circuit. The project is part of a joint effort with Neuromorphic Cognitive Systems (UZH & ETHZ).

projects.title: Accurate movement trajectory decoding for high-performance brain-machine interfaces
projects.summary: Build a regressor that decodes continuous movement trajectories, such as hand or finger positions, from ECoG and/or spiking activity in patients. Students study informative biomarkers and implement feature-engineered and end-to-end machine learning models.

projects.title: Circuit design for stimulation artifact cancellation in concurrent neural recording and stimulation
projects.summary: Design artifact cancellation circuits that remove large stimulation artifacts from low-amplitude neural recordings during concurrent recording and stimulation. Candidate algorithms and hardware architectures are explored and assessed with Cadence simulations, with the goal of prototype integrated circuits.
skills: analog/mixed-signal or digital CMOS IC design

projects.title: Resource-efficient machine learning algorithm design for on-implant neurological symptom detection
projects.summary: Develop efficient machine learning models that process electrophysiological neural data in real time for neurological symptom detection on implants. Students focus on low power, small chip area, fast inference, or a trade-off between these metrics, and estimate hardware complexity.

projects.title: Machine learning chip design for on-implant neural decoding
projects.summary: Design an efficient feature extraction and/or machine learning processor that classifies or decodes neural data in real time on an implant. Candidate algorithms are designed in Cadence and assessed for power, area, and latency, and prototype integrated circuits are tested.
skills: analog/mixed-signal or digital CMOS IC design

projects.title: Detecting mental fatigue and symptoms of psychiatric disorders from continuous neuronal recordings
projects.summary: Explore machine learning methods that detect the onset of mental fatigue and neuropsychiatric symptoms from multi-channel ECoG and LFP recordings, mainly in primates. Students study biomarkers and optimize detection accuracy and latency.

projects.title: Exploring Representation Learning for Neural Signal Decoders
projects.summary: Improve representation learning for neural signal decoders used in brain-spine interfaces, decoding ECoG signals from movement attempts. Proposed directions include vector-quantization on transformer foundation models, comparing self-supervised approaches, and applying neural collapse theory to generalization.

projects.title: Energy-Efficient and Interpretable Neuromorphic Decoding for Neural Signal and Movement Decoding
projects.summary: The project aims to co-design energy-efficient, reliable and interpretable neuromorphic processing architectures for decoding neural and muscle signals (EMG, ECoG, LFP, intracortical spikes, IMU data) using spiking neural networks. It also quantifies the accuracy, latency and energy trade-offs against state-of-the-art deep learning decoders for implantable brain-computer interfaces.

projects.title: Advanced Flexure-Mechanism Design
projects.summary: Develop a new design and modelling framework for flexure-based mechanisms that addresses several performance criteria at once and robustness to manufacturing tolerances. The work includes literature review, analytical and numerical modelling, design, and experimental validation. The project is a Master's project from January 2027 to August 2027, with an option to continue as a PhD thesis from October 2027.

projects.title: Rotoprinter 1 – Interface material for 3D printing
projects.summary: Experimentally compare interface materials for 3D printing. The project is part of the Rotoprinter line of work on additive manufacturing.

projects.title: Mechanical analog computation with flexures mechanisms
projects.summary: Develop new miniaturized fully mechanical computing modules based on flexure mechanisms, as an alternative to electronic computing for extreme environments. The work covers mechanical design, modelling, simulation and prototyping, with possible development of digital logic families.

projects.title: Design of a new musical instrument: acoustic simulation and modeling of sound generation through stick and slip, followed by prototyping
projects.summary: Simulate a new type of musical instrument based on stick-slip sound generation and model its acoustics. Depending on the student's profile, the project can also include mechanical design and prototyping to test the theoretical predictions.

projects.title: Surgical knot tension measurement device
projects.summary: Design and prototype a handheld or table-mounted mechanical device that measures the pretension applied when tying surgical knots, with a tunable force-limitation system and ergonomic design. The device is intended for surgeon training and evaluation, and is validated with different filaments and knots. The project can be a semester project or a master's thesis.

projects.title: Biomimetic Mechanical Sound Generation
