projects.summary: Design a new biomimetic sound-producing mechanism inspired by cricket stridulation, for applications such as watch alarms or musical instruments. The project offers either mechanical design and manufacturing of a prototype, or physical modelling of the stridulation principle.

projects.title: Flexure based surgical tool
projects.summary: Develop a flexible flexure-based structure for a micro-surgical tool providing two rotational degrees of freedom, with a gripper or other end effector adapted to the medical application. The tool should be usable with manual or robotic actuation.

projects.title: Dataset Acquisition for Low-Light Image Denoising
projects.summary: Build a new dataset of clean-noisy image pairs and dark calibration frames captured at many exposure times, to extend the 2-Shots in the Dark low-light denoising method to a wider range of exposure times and sensor temperatures. The student captures, organizes and preprocesses the data, then publishes it on Hugging Face with a dataset card. All acquisition equipment is provided by the lab.
skills: Basics of image and signal processing
DSLR shooting in manual mode (ISO, exposure time)

projects.title: Extending data-driven controller synthesis to new performance objectives
projects.summary: Extend the lab's data-driven controller synthesis framework, which currently handles H2, Hinf and IQC-based robustness specifications, to alternative objectives such as H1 and regret-based criteria. The work includes theory, implementation in the datadriven library, and experimental validation on lab systems with saturation constraints.

projects.title: EPFL babyfoot ball handling and control improvement
projects.summary: Improve the ball handling of the EPFL babyfoot robot so it can capture a moving ball, pass it, juggle, and shoot toward the opponent goal. Students may also propose their own improvements.

projects.title: Digital twin of an industrial thermal process with neural optimal control
projects.summary: Build a digital twin simulator of an industrial thermal process (e.g. oven, dryer or reactor) with a PID controller in the loop. Then apply neural-network optimal control methods to outperform the baseline PID controller.

projects.title: Contextual data-driven robust control with conformal prediction
projects.summary: Develop a contextual data-driven robust control framework that builds context-dependent uncertainty sets from historical data using conformal prediction, with coverage guarantees for the disturbance. The work includes theory and validation on benchmark control tasks.

projects.title: Robust real-time controller for adaptive optics
projects.summary: Design and synthesise a robust real-time controller for an adaptive optics system that corrects atmospheric wavefront distortions in ground-based telescopes. Validation is planned through simulation and on an adaptive optics testbed. The project is run with an external partner at the Department of Astronomy, University of Geneva.

projects.title: Distributionally robust control within data-driven controller synthesis
projects.summary: Extend the lab's data-driven controller synthesis framework with Distributionally Robust Control (DRO) objectives. The work includes theory, implementation in the datadriven library, and experimental validation on lab systems with saturation-related constraints.

projects.title: Partial feedback linearization for inverted pendulum swing-up
projects.summary: Implement a partial feedback linearization algorithm for swinging up an inverted pendulum, then extend the algorithm to the data-driven setting. The controller will be tested on the hardware setup using LabVIEW.

projects.title: Performance boosting for non-holonomic bumper cars
projects.summary: Improve the performance of three non-holonomic bumper cars in a 7x10 arena so they reach target positions with a prescribed final orientation. The method uses reference Performance Boosting, a learned component added to a base controller on top of a data-driven MLP model of the cars, while preserving stability guarantees.

projects.title: Meta-learning neural controllers for quadcopter disturbance rejection
projects.summary: Use meta-learning (e.g. MAML) to train neural-network controllers that adapt quickly to changing disturbance profiles such as wind. Methods will be implemented in a simulated quadcopter environment and compared with standard training from scratch.

projects.title: Meta-learning for neural network control of the Franka robot
projects.summary: Investigate meta-learning methods such as MAML for neural-network controllers in control tasks, integrating control-specific architectures. Performance will be assessed through simulations of the Franka robot.

projects.title: Online switching schemes for performance-boosting controllers (wind turbine)
projects.summary: Design new online switching schemes for performance-boosting controllers, inspired by online convex optimization, and prove regret guarantees for them. The schemes will be tested in simulation for wind turbine control. The project is linked to the external DECODE project.

projects.title: Data-driven adaptive control of an active suspension test bench
projects.summary: Set up an active suspension test bench and apply data-driven adaptive control techniques to it. The controller should be robust to parametric uncertainties and will be verified on the test bench.

projects.title: Bachelor project : Mini-segway racing
projects.summary: A bachelor project on mini-segway racing, in which a self-balancing mini-segway is used as a platform for control and racing. The page gives only the title and general context on the lab's student projects in control and robotics.

projects.title: Control of a Soft Biomimetic Fish Robot
projects.summary: Implement a control algorithm to position the caudal fin of a soft robotic fish driven by fiber-reinforced dielectric elastomer actuators with a buckling beam, enabling steering and speed control. The work includes a state-of-the-art review of control for multi-stable systems and integration with the hardware into a working demonstrator.

projects.title: Smart Actuators: Exploring Ultrasonic Vibration Sources
projects.summary: Explore, design and evaluate compact actuators based on piezoelectric and magnetostrictive smart materials to generate high-frequency vibrations for the core actuation unit of a dental medical device. The project includes building a proof-of-concept prototype and experimentally characterising its frequency, amplitude and temperature variation, in collaboration with an industry partner.

projects.title: Characterization of a miniaturized actuation module used in biomedical applications
projects.summary: Characterise experimentally and model numerically the miniature coreless DC motor and gear train that actuates modules of a reconfigurable diabetic insole. The goal is to identify lumped electro-mechanical parameters, validate an analytical model, estimate energy consumption, and optimise a commercial ripple-counting motor driver firmware.

projects.title: Investigation of auxetic meta-structures for intelligent offloading footwear
projects.summary: Investigate synclastic auxetic meta-structures capable of double Gaussian curvature to redistribute plantar pressure in an intelligent offloading insole. The project covers a Python tool for unit-cell design, experimental validation on a test bench, and fabrication of prototypes.

projects.title: Multilayer Dielectric Elastomer Actuators for Intelligent Pressure Offloading in Diabetic Footwear
projects.summary: Design and fabricate multilayer dielectric elastomer actuators with around 100 layers to provide large displacement and stiffness modulation for plantar pressure offloading. The student will characterise displacement, force, stiffness and reliability, and investigate failure mechanisms.

projects.title: Soft Fluidic Memory Sensor for Intelligent Offloading Footwear
projects.summary: Perform a first experimental validation of a soft fluidic sensing element based on a flexible polymer structure with conductive fluid, whose impedance changes under compression. The project tests fabrication, compares design variations and evaluates signal amplitude, repeatability, drift and transient response.

projects.title: Self-Clearing Carbon Black Electrodes for Durable Soft Cardiac Actuators
projects.summary: Develop ultra-thin self-clearing carbon black electrodes for dielectric elastomer actuators used in soft heart assist devices. The student will prepare formulations varying carbon black concentration and deposition, and characterise conductivity, adhesion, stretchability, cyclic stability and self-clearing behaviour.

projects.title: Bidirectional Flyback converter for high voltage applications
projects.summary: Add bidirectionality to a flyback DC-DC converter that steps low voltages up to kilovolt levels to power a dielectric elastomer actuator, enabling energy recovery from the load. The project covers topology analysis, simulation with parasitic-aware component selection, implementation and validation.

projects.title: Self-sensing for artificial muscles
projects.summary: Investigate using dielectric elastomer actuators as self-sensing elements by exploiting their deformation-dependent capacitance, including parallel configurations to increase sensitivity. The student will fabricate prototypes and correlate electrical measurements with mechanical deformation for real-time monitoring.

projects.title: Origami\Kirigami as Negative Biasing Mechanism for Dielectric Elastomer Actuators
projects.summary: Use Kresling origami and kirigami structures as a bistable negative biasing mechanism to provide optimal pre-stretch for stacked dielectric elastomer actuators and achieve high strains. The student will fabricate the structures, integrate them with DEA prototypes and characterise the actuation performance.

projects.title: Dielectric Elastomer Actuators characterization
projects.summary: Characterise tubular dielectric elastomer actuators as distributed transmission-line structures by extracting per-unit-length RLCG parameters from impedance measurements. The project also includes building a mechanical setup to map capacitance against controlled deformation, as a step towards self-sensing.

projects.title: Control of a Soft Biomimetic Fish Robot
projects.summary: Implement a control algorithm to position the caudal fin of a soft robotic fish driven by fiber-reinforced dielectric elastomer actuators, enabling steering and speed control of a future untethered version. The work includes a state-of-the-art review of control for multi-stable systems and integration with the hardware into a working demonstrator.

projects.title: Smart Actuators: Exploring Ultrasonic Vibration Sources
projects.summary: Explore, design and evaluate compact actuators based on piezoelectric and magnetostrictive smart materials to generate high-frequency vibrations for a dental medical device. A proof-of-concept prototype will be built and characterized for frequency, amplitude and temperature variation.

projects.title: Characterization of a miniaturized actuation module used in biomedical applications
projects.summary: Experimentally characterize and numerically model the miniature coreless DC motor and gear train of a reconfigurable insole module, identifying its lumped parameters. The resulting model will estimate energy consumption and support control and sensing algorithms, with some firmware optimization of a ripple-counting motor driver.

projects.title: Investigation of auxetic meta-structures for intelligent offloading footwear
projects.summary: Investigate synclastic auxetic meta-structures that produce double Gaussian curvature for an intelligent offloading insole intended to reduce high plantar pressure in diabetic patients. The project includes a Python design tool, experimental validation on a test bench, and prototype fabrication.

projects.title: Multilayer Dielectric Elastomer Actuators for Intelligent Pressure Offloading in Diabetic Footwear
projects.summary: Design, fabricate and characterize multilayer dielectric elastomer actuators with around 100 layers to provide displacement and stiffness modulation for plantar pressure offloading in footwear. The student will develop fabrication methods and test mechanical behavior, reliability and failure mechanisms.

projects.title: Soft Fluidic Memory Sensor for Intelligent Offloading Footwear
projects.summary: Experimentally validate an early-stage soft fluidic sensing element combining a flexible polymer structure, conductive fluid and impedance measurement, to detect plantar loading and its history. The student will fabricate prototypes, test design variations under compression, and analyze their transient response.

projects.title: Self-Clearing Carbon Black Electrodes for Durable Soft Cardiac Actuators
projects.summary: Develop ultra-thin self-clearing carbon black electrodes for dielectric elastomer actuators used in soft heart assist devices. The student will prepare electrode formulations and characterize their conductivity, adhesion, stretchability and cyclic stability, including behavior under electrical breakdown.

projects.title: Bidirectional Flyback converter for high voltage applications
projects.summary: Add and implement bidirectionality in a high-voltage flyback DC-DC converter that drives a dielectric elastomer actuator, so that charge can be recovered from the load. The project includes simulation, PCB implementation and validation of the kilovolt-range converter.

projects.title: Self-sensing for artificial muscles
projects.summary: Investigate using the capacitance of dielectric elastomer actuators as a self-sensing signal to monitor their deformation in real time. The project explores parallel DEA configurations to increase sensitivity and correlates electrical measurements with mechanical deformation on fabricated prototypes.

projects.title: Origami\Kirigami as Negative Biasing Mechanism for Dielectric Elastomer Actuators
projects.summary: Investigate whether Kresling origami or kirigami structures can provide the optimal pre-stretch for stacked dielectric elastomer actuators to achieve high strains. The student will fabricate these structures, integrate them with DEA prototypes and characterize the achievable strain.

projects.title: Dielectric Elastomer Actuators characterization
projects.summary: Characterize tubular dielectric elastomer actuators as distributed transmission-line structures, extracting their RLCG parameters from impedance measurements. The project also aims to map capacitance against mechanical deformation with a custom setup to enable self-sensing.

projects.title: Bearings
projects.summary: A master or semester project on bearings, a core machine element in mechanical design.

projects.title: Turbomachinery
projects.summary: A master or semester project on turbomachinery, the design and analysis of machines that exchange energy with a fluid.

projects.title: Design
projects.summary: A master or semester project in mechanical design at the Laboratory for Applied Mechanical Design.

projects.title: Finite Element solution of the Reynolds equation for compressible fluids
projects.summary: Develop a Finite Element Method (FEM) solver for the Reynolds equation governing compressible gas-lubricated bearings, and compare it with the Finite Difference solution currently used in the lab in terms of accuracy, mesh requirements and numerical stability near fluid-film boundaries.

projects.title: Identification of strong non-linear behavior in gas bearings: comparison with experimental data
projects.summary: Assess whether discrepancies previously observed between linearized predictions and experimental data for gas-lubricated bearings can be resolved by re-evaluating the speed instability threshold with newly developed tools that capture non-linear behavior.

projects.title: Simulating Kite Surfing: From Real-World Data to a Virtual Training Environment for RL Agents
projects.summary: Build data-driven and physics-based models of kite surfing from real sensor data collected from kite surfers, and create a flexible virtual simulation environment in which reinforcement learning agents are trained to find efficient kite surfing strategies.

projects.title: Surrogate Modelling and Transfer Learning for IPM Electric Machines
projects.summary: Build a validated FEA (FEMAG) dataset covering the design space of interior permanent-magnet (IPM) machines, then develop and compare machine-learning surrogate models for their electromagnetic fields and derived quantities such as torque and flux linkage. Transfer learning from an existing SPM-trained surrogate is explored to reduce the IPM data requirement.

projects.title: Adaptive Multimodal AI for CAD Generation
projects.summary: Investigate multimodal generative AI methods that turn different forms of design information (text, images, sketches, geometry) into executable and editable parametric CAD models, with a focus on robustness, flexibility and geometric accuracy. The exact research direction is defined with the selected student.

projects.title: Synthetic Benchmark Development for Multi-Fidelity Optimization with Heterogeneous Input Spaces
projects.summary: Design and implement a modular Python library of synthetic benchmark problems for multi-fidelity optimization where fidelity levels use different input representations. The student will build a configurable generator of paired design representations with native simulator functions and evaluate baseline representation learning methods on it.

projects.title: Development of an Automated Load Application System for Aerodynamic Bearing Testing
projects.summary: Develop the control system and PXI/LabVIEW software to automatically apply controlled loads to aerodynamic bearings using three electric cylinders, enabling automated load-capacity characterization. The work covers force distribution for arbitrary load directions, closed-loop force control, and automated test sequences.

projects.title: Parametric Modelling and Surrogate Modelling of Scroll Compressors
projects.summary: Build a validated, parametrised GT-Suite model of a scroll compressor and use it to generate a simulation dataset over its geometric and operating design space. Develop and compare machine-learning surrogate models that predict compressor performance, with a Master thesis extending them to crank-angle-resolved outputs and a design optimisation task.

projects.title: Open-Source Work on Dynamic High-level Synthesis Compiler Targeting FPGAs
projects.summary: Contribute to Dynamatic, an open-source dynamic high-level synthesis compiler built on MLIR that generates RTL for FPGAs from C/C++. Possible work includes compiler passes at different lowering stages, and debugging, visualisation or benchmarking tools, with contributions meant to become part of the codebase.

projects.title: Accelerate FPGA Implementation Time
projects.summary: Reduce the long FPGA implementation time, from several minutes to a few seconds, needed to generate the bitstream from high-level synthesis designs.

projects.title: Postquantum Cryptography Core Using High-Level Synthesis
projects.summary: Explore and improve the quality of results of post-quantum cryptography hardware cores generated with high-level synthesis from C/C++, compared with RTL-based designs.

projects.title: Low-Level Optimization of Dynamically Scheduled Circuits
projects.summary: Improve performance of dynamically scheduled circuits by optimising the RTL-to-FPGA implementation stage, including logic synthesis and place-and-route in Vivado, to account for physical constraints such as routing delays and congestion.

projects.title: Toward Coarse-Grained Field Programmable Gate Arrays
projects.summary: Study a coarser-grained version of FPGAs and evaluate its performance as a word-level reconfigurable computing fabric, including new compiler optimisations, architectural ideas, and physical implementation and modelling.

projects.title: Optimizing place and route for high frequency task parallel FPGA accelerators
projects.summary: Analyse the frequency of circuits generated by the open-source HardCilk task-parallel scheduler on FPGAs using Vivado place and route, and test whether adding elastic buffers to ready-valid interfaces increases the design frequency.

projects.title: SOC-graphical configurator as VS-code plug-in
projects.summary: Build a VS Code plugin that provides a graphical tool for designing System-on-Chip architectures from OpenRisc-based softcore modules, for use in the CS-473 and CS-476 courses, with export of designs as TikZ pictures and PDF.

projects.title: Hardware coherence on various wishbone bus-architectures
projects.summary: Investigate hardware cache coherence protocols (such as MSI and MESI) for Wishbone shared, crossbar and ring bus architectures, and propose and implement software-configurable coherence protocols on a Hazard3 RISC-V CPU system.

projects.title: Two-photon endoscopic imaging using a multi-mode fiber
projects.summary: Develop two-photon fluorescence endoscopic imaging through a multi-mode fiber using an ultrashort pulsed laser. The work must address pulse broadening from group velocity dispersion in the fiber to enable nonlinear imaging.

projects.title: Uncovering and Solving O2-Gradient Induced Artifacts in TVAM
projects.summary: Systematically test the achievable resolution of tomographic volumetric additive manufacturing (TVAM) prints under various resins, vial geometries and illumination settings. The project combines a diffusion-aware optimization model, the open-source Dr.TVAM framework, simulations and experimental validation to map resolution limits.

projects.title: Design and Application of Organ-on-chip Platforms via Tomographic Printing
projects.summary: Use tomographic volumetric additive manufacturing to directly print high-complexity, perfusable models inside preassembled, leak-proof TVAM-compatible chips with integrated fluidics. The goal is to create organ-on-chip platforms for drug discovery and safety testing.

projects.title: Control Plane Design for Optical Switch
projects.summary: Develop the control plane software that manages the state of an optical switch, translating high-level network requests into commands for the optical engine and reporting telemetry to a central SDN controller. The student will build a switch management daemon and an abstraction of optical components as logical network resources.

projects.title: Optimization of Fiber Probes and Imaging Conditions for Biological Samples
projects.summary: Optimize the FLIMME fluorescence lifetime endomicroscope, which combines wavefront shaping through a single multimode fiber with frequency-domain FLIM, for imaging organoids, transwell cultures and excised tissue. The goal is to adapt the probe and imaging conditions to these biological samples.

projects.title: Printing in situ using an ultra-thin MMF probe
projects.summary: Explore light-based microfabrication delivered through an ultra-thin multimode optical fiber probe, using wavefront shaping to generate a focused spot at the fiber tip. The aim is in-situ fabrication in confined or inaccessible environments, including adapter design for the printing probe.

projects.title: Engineering strategies to perfuse bioprinted 3D models of pancreatic cancer
projects.summary: Develop strategies to perfuse bioprinted 3D models of pancreatic tissue in order to study the molecular interactions between pancreatic cancer cells and stromal cells. The models aim to better understand the stiffening tumor microenvironment.

projects.title: Opto-Mechanical Design of Optical Switches for AI
projects.summary: Design the mechanical architecture of a compact multi-layer optical switching unit housing optical engines, mirrors, SLMs and fibers while keeping micron-level alignment stable under thermal load. The work includes CAD design, thermal and vibration analysis, and prototyping of the unit.

projects.title: Printing in situ using an ultra-thin MMF probe
projects.summary: Develop and characterize an ultra-thin multimode fiber probe for in-situ 3D printing by photopolymerization, using wavefront shaping on the FLIMME setup. The work covers improving the trapped-air probe design, measuring the printing dose response, and building Python-based pattern generation for complex structures.

projects.title: Master Project Proposal: AI-Based Identification of Cloud Hydrometeors from In Situ Holographic and Fluorescence Measurements at Jungfraujoch
projects.summary: Develop a machine learning framework to classify individual cloud particles measured by a multisensor airflow cytometer (holography, fluorescence, polarised light scattering) at the Jungfraujoch station into liquid droplets and primary and secondary ice crystals. The classified data will be used to derive quasi-real-time cloud microphysical properties.

projects.title: Masters or SIE project – Assessment of low cost sensor technologies for spatially-resolved air quality indices in the City of Lausanne
projects.summary: Evaluate low-cost sensors for measuring particulate and gas-phase pollutants in Lausanne, model their environment-dependent response, and derive air quality indices comparable to those from reference stations.

projects.title: Masters project – Molecular Structure Reconstruction
projects.summary: Implement and improve algorithms that reconstruct molecular structures from mass spectrometry fragments, testing them on tandem chromatogram-mass spectrometer measurements of halogenated compounds at Jungfraujoch.

projects.title: Dust in the Wind: Analyzing Mineral Dust Acidification and Its Effects
projects.summary: Prepare and analyse samples from an experimental facility that acidifies mineral dust particles, quantifying the physico-chemical changes such as soluble iron and copper, and developing new analytical methods for these components.

projects.title: From Air to Earth: Tracing Atmospheric Reactive Nitrogen's Impact on Swiss Ecosystems
projects.summary: Take part in field measurements of reactive nitrogen deposition at an agricultural site and a forest in Switzerland as part of the ReCLEAN project, including sample collection, data curation and operation of atmospheric instruments.

projects.title: Soft Tactile Sensor Simulation & Sim-to-Real Engineering
projects.summary: Develop simulation models of soft tactile sensors and transfer them to real hardware (sim-to-real).

projects.title: Robust Stable Manipulation with Dexterous Hands under Changing External Forces
projects.summary: Study stable manipulation with dexterous robotic hands when external forces change over time.

projects.title: Objective Evaluation of Surgical Skills Training Tools
projects.summary: Build objective methods to evaluate the effectiveness of tools used to train surgical skills.

projects.title: Defying Newton's third law: designing a vibrotactile stimulator without recoil
projects.summary: Design a vibrotactile stimulator that produces vibration without generating reaction forces or recoil.

projects.title: Surgical Robotics Competitivity Report
projects.summary: Produce a report analysing the competitive landscape of surgical robotics.

projects.title: Quantitative Assessment of Microsurgical Skills
projects.summary: Quantitatively assess microsurgical skills from measured data.

projects.title: Multi-Arm Manipulation of Deformable Objects in Contact-Rich Environments
projects.summary: Coordinate multiple robotic arms to manipulate deformable objects in environments with many contacts.

projects.title: A Modular Simulation and Analysis Platform for Multi-Limb Coordination
projects.summary: Build a modular platform to simulate and analyse coordination among multiple limbs.

projects.title: Force-Aware Sequential Multi-Object Grasping with Coupled Contact
projects.summary: Grasp multiple objects in sequence while taking contact forces into account.

projects.title: Human-Robot Collaborative Manipulation
projects.summary: Develop manipulation tasks in which a robot and a human collaborate on the same object.

projects.title: Open Source Cloud Robotic Manipulation
projects.summary: Build an open-source cloud-based system for robotic manipulation.

projects.title: Robust Stable Manipulation with Dexterous Hands under Changing External Forces
projects.summary: Extends a previous bimanual gripper planning approach to multi-finger dexterous hands, aiming to keep manipulation stable under time-varying external wrenches. The work combines an online stability margin estimator, a constrained controller respecting contact, friction and actuation limits, and optimization-based strategy reconfiguration with minimal switching.

projects.title: A Modular Simulation and Analysis Platform for Multi-Limb Coordination
projects.summary: Build a lightweight, modular Python platform that combines motion data processing with simulation-based evaluation of existing dynamical system controllers. The student does not design new control or learning algorithms; the focus is on infrastructure for testing, visualizing and comparing models in multi-limb scenarios.

projects.title: Defying Newton's third law: designing a vibrotactile stimulator without recoil
projects.summary: Design and prototype a handheld, wireless vibrotactile stimulator that delivers precise vibrations for self-testing of touch sensitivity, paired with a smartphone app. The central challenge is making the tip vibrate without transmitting off-target vibration and acoustic noise to the handle.

projects.title: The World as a Canvas: Multimodal Realignment of Historical Map Archives
projects.summary: Develop a multimodal method that combines textual cues and latent image representations from a domain-specific vision foundation model to georeference historical maps against contemporary geodata using keypoints and graph neural networks.

projects.title: The Origins of Venice
projects.summary: Create a digital urban atlas of Venice for 1100 and 1350 from OCR-processed historiographical sources, then build an interactive cartography and analyse ownership, land use and family names.

projects.title: The space of Victorian London
projects.summary: Study how 19th and 20th century urban interventions shaped the social-spatial structure of London by enriching a dataset of building footprints and text segments from the 1890s Ordnance Survey map with infrastructure and economic data and linking it to social class information from Booth's map.

projects.title: Beyond Cheese and Chocolate: The Economic Landscape of Historical Switzerland
projects.summary: Realign addresses from Swiss commercial registers (1883 onwards) to geographic coordinates using modern and historical place-name databases, then analyse and visualise the resulting historical economic geography of Switzerland.

projects.title: Enlumina
projects.summary: Index the visual elements of illustrated medieval manuscripts by segmenting depictions, annotating them against an iconographic database, and building a search engine for textual and visual similarity, with the aim of studying authorship through visual similarities.

projects.title: Door-to-door
projects.summary: Conduct analyses of city directories for Lausanne over a 10-year sample, extracted through OCR, and compare trades with Paris and New York in 1880 to identify each city's economic signature.

projects.title: The Hidden Grammar of Art History
projects.summary: Work with OCR extracted from 300,000 digitised art-object cardboards of the Replica project to realign artist-name entities and derive heuristics on the grammar of artist attribution.

projects.title: Lausanne 1722
projects.summary: Enrich the georeferenced and vectorised Melotte cadastre of Lausanne (1721-1722) with socio-economic information on land use, function and ownership, to serve as a historical geodata source on the city's 18th-century landscape.

projects.title: European Postcards
projects.summary: Geolocate historical postcards of Europe from Europeana using AI-based semantic identification and prompting, then publish the repositioned images in the Time Machine Atlas interface.

projects.title: Cartonomics / Visual semiotics
projects.summary: Identify and extract the symbolic and representational visual elements of cartography using deep learning and statistical methods, to study how map conventions for relief, water, buildings and natural landscape evolved over time.

projects.title: The Cultural Microscope
projects.summary: Design and build a prototype interface for exploring cultural memes, i.e. replicated visual elements tracked across tens of thousands of digitised historical maps, using embeddings and IIIF images with metadata filtering.

projects.title: Automatic georeferencing of historical cadastres
projects.summary: Develop automatic computer vision and graph neural network methods to georeference sheets of the 19th-century Napoleonic and renovated European cadastres.

projects.title: Automatic transcription of Polier notebooks
projects.summary: Automatically transcribe the handwritten Polier notebooks (1754-1791) with handwriting recognition, then use NLP-based distant reading to study environmental, social or economic history.

projects.title: Haussmannian transformations in Paris during the XIXth century
projects.summary: Convert the 19th-century maps of the Bibliothèque historique de la Ville de Paris into vector geometries using CNN pixelwise classification and computer vision, then quantitatively analyse the transformation of the urban fabric.

projects.title: Automatic vectorization of the renovated cadastre of Lausanne
projects.summary: Transform the 1888 renovated cadastre of Lausanne into vector maps using CNN-based semantic segmentation, and possibly apply handwritten text recognition to its legend.

projects.title: Icono Lausanne – Reorientation of the photographic archives of the Historical Museum
projects.summary: Match the Historical Museum of Lausanne's digitised photographs to the city using photogrammetry and neural networks, estimating each shot's camera angle and position to reproject them onto 4D models.

projects.title: 3D density map embedding for cryoEM
projects.summary: Build density map embeddings that capture the information in the cryoEM voxel grid using an autoencoder, and evaluate how biologically meaningful these embeddings are. The project is a collaboration between the Laboratory for Biomolecular Modeling and the Computer Vision Laboratory.

projects.title: Master thesis position: High-throughput in vitro screening of hybridoma libraries for the identification of HER2-targeting agonistic antibodies
projects.summary: Screen the lab's existing hybridoma libraries in vitro to find antibodies that bind HER2+ breast cancer cells, then test binders in functional cell-based assays to identify at least one validated agonistic antibody to serve as a positive control. The work combines flow cytometry and ELISA with receptor activation and signaling assays.

projects.title: Master thesis position: Integration of a signature matching algorithm into a scRNAseq bioinformatic pipeline for agonistic antibody discovery
projects.summary: Integrate a newly developed signature matching package into the lab's R-based scRNAseq pipeline so that individual cell profiles are matched directly to pathways in public databases, without prior clustering. The project includes code refactoring, computational optimisation, and benchmarking against clustering-based methods for identifying agonistic antibodies.

projects.title: Microfluidics-guided personalized cancer immunotherapy
projects.summary: Establish light-sheet imaging-based fluorescence assays on microfluidic tumor biopsy platforms to measure killing of cancer cells by T-cells, with the goal of predicting outcomes of immune therapies. The work includes optimising fluorescent antibody staining of different cell types.

projects.title: Integration of sharp tips for high resolution AFM imaging
projects.summary: Develop a microfabrication process that adds sharp silicon tips to AFM cantilevers directly during fabrication, instead of adding them manually one by one. This is a proof-of-concept fabrication project for self-sensing cantilevers.

projects.title: Integration of shielded tip-connection for electrical AFM measurements
projects.summary: Modify the cantilever process flow to add a grounded metal connection between the two signal lines, reducing cross-talk between embedded electronics and the tip connection. The goal is to use the fabricated cantilevers for electrical AFM measurements such as piezoresponse force microscopy.

projects.title: Optimisation of cantilever sensors to increase signal-to-noise ratio
projects.summary: Replace the current polysilicon piezoresistive sensing element of the cantilevers with single crystal silicon, which has a much higher gauge factor, to improve the signal-to-noise ratio. This requires modifying the current process flow.

projects.title: Contact Resonance Measurements with AFM in vacuum
projects.summary: Enable contact resonance AFM (CR-AFM) measurements inside the SEM chamber by sending a signal to the sample and tracking the contact resonance frequency with a lock-in amplifier. The aim is to map sample mechanical properties and complement SEM chemical contrast.

projects.title: AFM image processing plugin for converting high-speed AFM data to video (Gwyddion)
projects.summary: Design and test a Gwyddion plugin that automatically processes series of high-speed AFM images from the same experiment and converts them into video format. The goal is to replace slow one-by-one image processing.

projects.title: Long- and short- range structure in electrolyte solutions
projects.summary: PhD project using home-built nonlinear optical scattering and imaging methods (second harmonic imaging, angle-resolved second harmonic scattering, correlated vibrational spectroscopy) to study the multi-scale structure of concentrated electrolyte solutions in water and at aqueous interfaces.

projects.title: Interfacial Imaging of Membrane Water
projects.summary: PhD project developing second harmonic water imaging to image interfacial water and electrostatic field lines on lipid membrane models, and to image membrane fusion and osmosis in real time, linking molecular information to membrane electrostatics and mechanics.

projects.title: When is a good predictor a good model?
projects.summary: Investigates which model-brain comparison metrics (linear predictivity, representational similarity analysis, CKA) can identify artificial networks that truly share the brain's mechanisms rather than merely predicting neural activity. The student records from networks with known shared or different mechanisms and tests whether lesion effects transfer between candidate model and target system.

projects.title: Training spiking networks to generate fast time-varying patterns
projects.summary: Aims to train networks of spiking SRM0 neurons with escape noise, using FORCE-style online learning and exact population rate equations, to produce fast and complex time-varying activity patterns. The project examines how far the approach extends as the speed of network dynamics is no longer constrained.

projects.title: A Digital Twin for collective decision making
projects.summary: Build and extend a Digital Twin that replicates zebrafish behaviour in response to virtual conspecifics, starting with an auto-regressive generative model baseline and then using interpretable approaches to explain decision making. The aim is to make predictions that could be tested in real animals.

projects.title: Implementing and extending a biologically inspired computational model of spatial navigation in rodents
projects.summary: Implement a computational model of a virtual rat navigating environments, combining a taxon pathway (visual input to motor actions) and a locale pathway (grid and place cells). The model is to be validated in reorientation and water-maze paradigms and then extended.

projects.title: Modeling perceptual rules of social interactions in single animal virtual reality
projects.summary: Use computational modelling and machine learning to test whether zebrafish visual preference for virtual fish-like motion stems from hard-wired tuning to average motion statistics or from an idiosyncratic coupling to the fish's own swim cycle. Models will be fitted to existing behavioural recordings and possibly extended to predict neural signals.

projects.title: Machine Learning for the Parametric Optimization of Metasurface Photonic Devices
projects.summary: Apply machine learning to the parametric optimization of metasurface-based photonic devices. The page gives no further detail.

projects.title: Machine Learning for the Parametric Optimization of Metasurface Photonic Devices
projects.summary: The student develops a physics-informed machine learning model to find the metasurface parameters that achieve target optical responses, such as vortex light, asymmetric angular scattering or pseudochiral effects. The work also covers inverse design of scattering particles by interfacing Python or MATLAB with COMSOL, with electromagnetic simulation and optimization of metasurfaces based on the GSTC framework.

projects.title: Drosophila innate immunity
projects.summary: Bachelor and master projects on how Drosophila detects and neutralizes microbial infection. Students generate CRISPR-based mutations in potential immunity-related genes and analyse their function to decipher recognition, signalling and effector mechanisms of the insect immune system.

projects.title: Psychology of Science
projects.summary: Bachelor and master projects studying psychological and sociological factors that influence career success in academia, including how romantic relationships (homogamy), personality traits and thinking styles shape the scientific community. Students use quantitative tools, validated personality and cognitive measures, surveys and interviews, and may develop their own project in personality and evolutionary psychology.

projects.title: Calibration and Utilization of a Novel Biaxial Shear Deformation Apparatus for Rock Discontinuity Analysis
projects.summary: Students calibrate a newly designed biaxial shear apparatus using synthetic rock samples with known properties, then use it to measure shear strength, stress distribution and fracture propagation along rock discontinuities in real samples.

projects.title: Exploring the Effects of Normal Stress Oscillations on Rupture Dynamics using Analog Samples in a Biaxial Shear Apparatus
projects.summary: Students run stick-slip experiments on an analog sample in a biaxial shear apparatus, varying the magnitude and amplitude of normal stress oscillations at a fixed load point velocity to study how they affect earthquake-like rupture cycles.

projects.title: Exploring Effects of Fault Aspect Ratio on Rupture Dynamics through Analog Samples in a Biaxial Shear Apparatus
projects.summary: Students conduct biaxial shear experiments on analog samples of different sizes to determine how fault aspect ratio affects rupture mode and failure response, comparing rate-and-state and slip-weakening friction laws.

projects.title: Investigating the physical properties of continental lower crust
projects.summary: Students prepare samples of deep continental crustal rocks from the Ivrea-Verbano region and measure ultrasonic wave velocity, permeability and electrical conductivity under high pressure and temperature (up to 200 MPa and 150°C) in a triaxial machine.

projects.title: High-Pressure High-Temperature Permeability Analysis of Geothermal Reservoir Rocks from Iceland and Canada using Advanced Triaxial Equipment
projects.summary: Students measure the permeability of geothermal reservoir rock samples from Iceland and Canada using the Paterson apparatus at up to 100 MPa and temperatures up to 700°C, to improve understanding of geothermal resource potential.

projects.title: Deformation and Failure Properties of Synthetic Sedimentary Rock
projects.summary: Students fabricate synthetic sandstone by hot sintering and synthetic limestone by cold sintering (pressure solution), then characterise their petrophysical and mechanical properties to understand deformation and failure of sedimentary rock.

projects.title: Analysis of atmospheric aerosol composition and sources with a new automated infrared spectrometer
projects.summary: Study atmospheric aerosols measured with a new online infrared spectrometer conceptualized at EPFL and developed by the spinoff Aerospec SA. Students can choose a data science focus (analysis of aerosols, sources and meteorological conditions from measurement campaigns in Switzerland, Europe, Japan and the Arctic) or an experimental focus (characterization of particle chemical signatures).

projects.title: Analysis of air pollution sources in global monitoring networks
projects.summary: Contextualize particle chemical composition measurements from global monitoring networks using meteorological analyses and emission inventories, in order to identify atmospheric particle pollution sources. The project is part of the APPLS collaboration with the Swiss Data Science Center and international partners.

projects.title: How to transform existing buildings towards shared spaces?
projects.summary: Identify successful and unsuccessful space-sharing models in existing buildings (shared kitchens, guest rooms, reception and activity spaces) based on literature, then propose new models that reduce m2 per person and support shared activities.

projects.title: Back to the Future: The World Energy Outlook forecasts in the rear-view mirror
projects.summary: Statistically analyse historical IEA World Energy Outlook projections (2000 onwards) to identify possible biases, focusing on energy prices, energy balances, electricity generation and CO2 emissions.

projects.title: Cheap clothes, high costs: the hidden costs of fast fashion
projects.summary: Assess and analyse the hidden environmental, social, economic and health costs of the fast fashion value chain using the True Cost Accounting approach, contributing to an SNSF research project.

projects.title: Reframing Living Wages through the lens of Decent Living Standards
projects.summary: Estimate living wages based on Decent Living Standards thresholds rather than minimum consumption baskets, by modelling household needs in energy, food, housing and mobility and identifying gaps with existing living wage benchmarks.

projects.title: Making CCUS governance accessible through interactive scenario tools
projects.summary: Design and run a stakeholder workshop using interactive scenario tools to make CCUS governance questions accessible to policymakers and stakeholders, and evaluate which formats best support understanding and deliberation.

projects.title: Estimating the sustainability impacts of the Swiss agrifood system: a system modelling assessment of the Swiss 2030 Agricultural Policy
projects.summary: Model and quantify the GHG mitigation potential and broader sustainability impacts of the key measures of the Swiss 2030 Agricultural Policy (AP30+) using a sector-coupled system modelling approach, in collaboration with the Negawatt association.

projects.title: Designing Swiss fair and sustainable futures: a system modelling assessment of the planetary boundaries and social foundations
projects.summary: Model and quantify current and future environmental impacts of Switzerland through the Doughnut economics framework, combining planetary boundaries and social foundations, and identify gaps with sustainability targets.

projects.title: Developing sustainable deployment strategies for data centres in Switzerland: comprehensive spatial mapping combined with a systems modelling assessment
projects.summary: Build a territorial mapping of suitable locations for sustainable data centre deployment in Switzerland, assessing energy, network, water and waste-heat reuse impacts in urban and peri-urban areas.

projects.title: Comment une coopérative d'habitation peut-elle renforcer la durabilité dans son parc de logements ?
projects.summary: Develop a practical guide for housing cooperatives on concrete measures to strengthen social and environmental sustainability in their housing stock, testing some interventions such as encouraging flat-sharing in large apartments, in collaboration with a Lausanne housing cooperative.

projects.title: Proof of Concept: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Assistant for the GEMINI-E3 Model
projects.summary: Develop a proof-of-concept RAG assistant that answers natural-language questions about the GEMINI-E3 computable general equilibrium model, with answers grounded in and cited from its documentation and code.

projects.title: Limitations of domestic project-based approaches in Swiss climate policy
projects.summary: Investigate the potential and limitations of domestic project-based climate policy approaches in Switzerland, including additionality frictions between instruments, with stakeholder interviews to draw lessons for the 2030 target and the CO2 Act revision.

projects.title: Wave interactions in Faraday instability
projects.summary: Project on wave interactions in the Faraday instability, the surface-wave pattern that forms on a fluid layer under vertical vibration.

projects.title: Model reduction for bouncing drops
projects.summary: Project on building reduced-order models of drops bouncing on a vibrating liquid bath.

projects.title: Tears of rain – fingering instability without a contact line
projects.summary: Project on the fingering instability of a liquid film flowing down a surface without a contact line, inspired by the formation of tears of rain.

projects.title: Wave interactions in Faraday instability
projects.summary: The project studies how waves interact in the Faraday instability, a pattern-forming instability of fluid surfaces under vertical vibration.

projects.title: Model reduction for bouncing drops
projects.summary: The project develops a reduced-order model of drops bouncing on a surface.

projects.title: Tears of rain – fingering instability without a contact line
projects.summary: The project investigates the fingering instability of a liquid film that forms on a surface without a contact line, inspired by tears of rain.

projects.title: Effet du niveau de la nappe phréatique sur le charriage
projects.summary: Studies how the level of the groundwater table affects bedload (sediment) transport in rivers. The page links to a PDF with the full project description.

projects.title: Effet du niveau de la nappe phréatique sur les crues
projects.summary: Investigates how the level of the groundwater table influences floods. The page links to a PDF with the full project description.

projects.title: Comparaison de codes numériques d'avalanche
projects.summary: Compares numerical codes used to simulate snow avalanches. The page links to a PDF with the full project description.

projects.title: Paramétrisation des modèles de vagues de rupture de barrage avec transport sédimentaire
projects.summary: Master thesis on parameterising dam-break wave models that include sediment transport. The page gives only the title and contacts, so the summary is based on the title.

projects.title: Effet du niveau de la nappe phréatique sur les crues
projects.summary: Master thesis on how the groundwater table level affects flood behaviour. Based on the title only.

projects.title: Effet du niveau de la nappe phréatique sur le charriage
projects.summary: Master thesis on how the groundwater table level affects bedload transport. Based on the title only.

projects.title: Étude des crues des 21 et 29 juin 2024 de la Navisence (Zinal, VS)
projects.summary: Master thesis studying the floods of 21 and 29 June 2024 on the Navisence river at Zinal (Valais, Switzerland). Based on the title only.

projects.title: Simulation des apports d'un bassin versant pour l'hydroélectricité : prévisions à long et court termes
projects.summary: Master thesis on simulating catchment inflows for hydropower, with long-term and short-term forecasts. Based on the title only.

projects.title: The use of images in health textbooks: how images and scientific discourse on gender interact between 1870 and 1940
projects.summary: The project examines illustrations in about eighty French-language health manuals published in Switzerland and France between 1870 and 1940, to see how images depict the body and the roles of men and women in medical discourse. It is part of the SNSF-funded MEDIF project on the first women doctors in French-speaking medicine.

projects.title: The ecology of eucalyptus: Tracing the acclimatization and exploitation of eucalyptus in Europe through 19th-century French publications
projects.summary: The project uses text mining on about 3,660 nineteenth-century French books from Gallica that mention eucalyptus, to study how knowledge about the tree's acclimatization and uses (medicinal, forestry, agricultural) evolved. The student would harvest the corpus through the Gallica API and apply analyses such as co-occurrence networks and topic modelling.

projects.title: The Global Footprint of the Swiss Economy and Society: A Data-Driven Analysis of Trading Patterns in the 20th Century
projects.summary: The project aims to extract data from digitized Swiss trade statistics from 1890 to 2000 to build a database of imports and exports, and then to analyse the environmental footprint of Switzerland over the twentieth century. The student would first build an extraction pipeline from scanned tables.

projects.title: Mapping Open Science Platform
projects.summary: The project aims to crawl the web to identify the links between open science platforms such as repositories, digital libraries and journals, characterise the nature of these links, and produce an interactive map of the open science network.

projects.title: The 'ecosystem' of open science: Tracing the Evolution of Ecological Metaphors in Discourses on the Digital Transition of Research
projects.summary: The project assembles a heterogeneous corpus of scientific, policy and oral texts on the digital transition of research, then uses NLP and network analysis to trace how ecological metaphors such as 'ecosystem' emerged and circulated in these discourses over time.

projects.title: How Was the Climate of the French Colonies Taught? A Study of Geography Textbooks from the Late 19th Century to the Mid-20th Century
projects.summary: The project uses text mining on dozens of French geography textbooks from Gallica to study how the climate and meteorology of the French colonies were taught to pupils from the late Second Empire to the Third Republic, and whether a hierarchy among colonial climates appears. The student would harvest the corpus through the Gallica API and apply analyses such as topic modelling.

projects.title: Risk-Aware Selective Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Language Modeling
projects.summary: Master thesis project on a risk-aware selective mixture-of-experts approach for efficient language modeling. It is proposed by the Learning and Dynamical Systems Group at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, which collaborates with LIONS.

projects.title: Rethinking Diffusion Modeling from the Ground Up: Building a Diffusion-LLM
projects.summary: Build a diffusion-based large language model as part of the Swiss AI Initiative, exploring new diffusion formulations for discrete and structured data. Students compare diffusion LLM architectures with autoregressive transformers in terms of sample efficiency, controllability and robustness, with theoretical and large-scale implementation directions.

projects.title: Emerging Optimizers for Large-Batch Training (SCION, MuON, Spectral Methods)
projects.summary: Study geometry-aware optimizers such as SCION, MuON and Stochastic Spectral Descent for stable large-batch training of deep networks. The goal is to characterize their memory footprint, preconditioning, critical batch size behavior and stability, and to evaluate them on large-batch transformer and MoE pipelines.

projects.title: Online Adaptation and Dynamic Geometry in Modern Optimizers
projects.summary: Design online adaptation mechanisms for geometry-aware optimizers, dynamically adjusting preconditioners, spectral norms, constraint radii and learning rates during training. The aim is algorithms that adapt to curvature and distributional drift while keeping the low-memory advantages of SCION/MuON-type methods.

projects.title: Applications of Spectral/Conditional-Gradient Optimizers in FL, RL, and Reasoning
projects.summary: Benchmark SCION/MuON-style spectral and conditional-gradient optimizers against conventional baselines in federated learning, reinforcement learning and LLM-based reasoning. The project aims to identify where spectral geometry yields practical benefits.

projects.title: Low-power analog-to-digital conversion for multichannel neural recording
projects.summary: Design and evaluation of low-power SAR and VCO-based analog-to-digital converters for multichannel neural recording implants. The work covers architecture survey, high-level modelling, transistor-level design and post-layout evaluation.

projects.title: Hardware-friendly selective feature extractors for neural classification tasks
projects.summary: Develop dimensionality-reduced feature extractors for neural signal classification that can run on implantable hardware, reducing data transfer. The student makes the classification network select features near the optimal complexity/performance tradeoff.

projects.title: Ultra-wideband (UWB) wireless data transfer for neural recording implants
projects.summary: Demonstrate the feasibility of a learning-based neural data compression algorithm for power-efficient ultra-wideband wireless transmission from neural implants. The work involves controlling and testing UWB transmitter and receiver boards based on a Decawave IC.

projects.title: Neural network-based hardware decoder design
projects.summary: Design of digital hardware implementing neural-network-based decoders for wireless implantable devices that monitor brain activity, aimed at restoring locomotion after spinal cord injury. The student surveys recent trends, develops a Matlab algorithm, and performs semi-custom digital design of the decoder.

projects.title: Data Processing for a Filter based Miniature Photo-Spectrometer
projects.summary: Estimate the spectrum of an unknown light source from a miniature photo-spectrometer built from N transmissive filters on a photo-sensor array. The work characterises the filter/detector system with a monochromator and then processes the resulting filter matrix and the sensor measurements to reconstruct the spectrum.

projects.title: Deep Generative Models for Conditional Sampling
projects.summary: The project aims to build on recent work on learning conditional distributions p(x_unobserved | x_observed) with deep generative models such as VAEs, GANs, normalizing flows and score-based models. It targets open questions such as integrating prior information more naturally into generative models and understanding trade-offs between generative approaches.

projects.title: Sampling, Reconstruction and Uncertainty Quantification for MRI
projects.summary: Study how deep learning methods can jointly or alternatively optimise MRI sampling (which data points to acquire) and reconstruction, using reconstruction uncertainty as a quantity to minimise. The student may explore non-Cartesian MRI or reinforcement-learning approaches.

projects.title: Optimal Pick and Place Strategy for an Isochronic Robot
projects.summary: Find optimal control strategies for a pick-and-place robot that transports multiple parts simultaneously on a common gantry, deciding which rail picks which product and in what order. The goal is to use reinforcement learning to minimise total transport time across application scenarios, within a generic framework that can accommodate new customer applications.

projects.title: Risk-Aware Selective Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Language Modeling
projects.summary: Extend the risk-aware selective language modeling framework (ESLM) to Mixture-of-Experts architectures by designing a risk-aware routing mechanism that routes inputs to experts based on confidence and risk estimates. The goal is more efficient training and inference with robustness to distribution shifts and adversarial inputs.

projects.title: Decoding the spectral diet of humans: Development of new analysis methods for spectral light exposure timeseries data
projects.summary: Develop new analysis methods for spectral light exposure timeseries recorded by a wearable 14-band spectral sensor (Spectrace) in field studies of personal light exposure. The focus is on unsupervised methods for clustering and classification.

projects.title: Decoding the spectral diet of humans: Development of new analysis methods for spectral light exposure timeseries data
projects.summary: Develop and validate new analysis methods for wearable spectral light exposure timeseries data from the Spectrace sensor, focusing on unsupervised clustering, classification of spectral types, and decomposition of spectra into source spectra. The expected outcome is a working implementation (ideally in R) and a written report.

projects.title: Accelerating Geophysical Flow Simulation Using Machine Learning
projects.summary: Develop machine learning surrogate models, purely data-driven or physics-informed, that approximate physics-based simulations of geophysical flows such as landslides, rockfalls and snow avalanches on complex 3D terrains at a much lower computational cost. The project is supervised jointly with the Chair of Alpine Mass Movements at ETHZ.

projects.title: Digital Twin Simulation of Rockfall Hazards
projects.summary: Build a digital twin of real Alpine slopes and protection barriers from terrain reconstruction and rock geometry, simulate rockfall trajectories with the lab's Discrete Element Method code, and use uncertainty quantification and machine learning surrogates for risk mapping.

projects.title: AI-Enhanced Characterization of Internal Material Properties from Surface Observations
projects.summary: Develop a generalized inverse modeling framework based on deep learning that infers internal material property distributions from observable surface responses, for applications such as structural diagnostics and non-destructive evaluation.

projects.title: Experimental Investigation of Architected Granular Materials
projects.summary: Design and 3D-print custom particle geometries, assemble granular packings with controlled structure, and run static and dynamic mechanical tests with digital image correlation to link particle-scale design to macroscopic stiffness and energy absorption.

projects.title: Segregation in Granular Flows
projects.summary: Use numerical simulations to study how particle shape and size control segregation under shear and gravity-driven granular flows, by analysing inter-particle forces, with the aim of informing continuum models of segregation.

projects.title: Graph Neural Networks for Granular Mechanics
projects.summary: Use Graph Neural Networks trained on discrete element simulations and grain-scale experimental data to study how force-chain networks evolve as granular materials approach unjamming and failure.

projects.title: Physics-informed Neural Operators for Solid Mechanics
projects.summary: Apply physics-informed neural operators to simulate the behaviour of materials under various loadings in geotechnical or structural engineering problems, and compare their accuracy and generalization with conventional numerical solutions.

projects.title: Frictional Instabilities in Topologically Interlocked Structures
projects.summary: Investigate how stick-slip frictional instabilities and interfacial heterogeneity drive sudden failures and load drops in topologically interlocked structures, using the level-set discrete element modeling framework.

projects.title: Phase-field Modeling of Fracture of Architected Structural Materials
projects.summary: Develop and apply phase-field fracture models to simulate crack initiation and propagation in architected materials such as truss lattices and bioinspired composites, and study how microstructure affects fracture toughness and energy dissipation, possibly with machine learning surrogates.

projects.title: Multiphysics Modeling of Fault Gouge
projects.summary: Combine discrete and continuum simulations to study fault gouge rheology, including the effects of grain-scale heterogeneity, particle fracture, and hydromechanical and thermomechanical coupling, to better understand earthquake mechanics.

projects.title: Frictional instabilities in topologically interlocked structures
projects.summary: The project studies how stick-slip frictional instabilities and interfacial heterogeneity affect the failure mechanisms of topologically interlocked structures. The student will use the level-set discrete element modeling framework to investigate their dynamic behaviour under various conditions.

projects.title: Graph Neural Networks for Granular Mechanics
projects.summary: Use graph neural networks to study how force-chain networks in granular materials evolve under shear as they approach unjamming and failure. Models are to be trained on discrete element simulations and grain-scale experimental measurements.

projects.title: Multiphysics modeling of fault gouge
projects.summary: The project uses combined discrete and continuum simulations to study fault gouge rheology, including the effects of material heterogeneity, grain-scale characteristics, particle fracture, and hydromechanical and thermomechanical coupling. The goal is to better understand earthquake mechanics.

projects.title: Physics-informed Deep Neural Operators for Solid Mechanics
projects.summary: The student explores physics-informed deep neural operators (PINOs) for solid mechanics problems, aiming to simulate material behaviour under various loading conditions in geotechnical or structural engineering. The generalization of the method is evaluated and its accuracy is compared with conventional numerical solutions.

projects.title: Segregation in Granular Flows
projects.summary: The project studies how particle shape influences segregation in granular flows, using numerical simulations of particles of varying shapes and sizes under shear and gravity. The goal is to analyse the inter-particle forces involved and to provide insights for continuum modelling of segregation.

projects.title: Accelerating geophysical flow simulation using machine learning
projects.summary: Develop machine learning surrogate models, purely data-driven or physics-informed, that approximate high-fidelity physics-based geophysical flow simulations (e.g. MPM or DEM on 3D terrains) such as landslides, rockfalls and snow avalanches at a fraction of the computational cost. The work covers compiling and preprocessing a simulation dataset, training the model, and evaluating it on unseen terrains.

projects.title: AI-Enhanced Characterization of Internal Material Properties from Surface Observations
projects.summary: Develop a generalized AI-based inverse modeling framework that uses deep learning to infer internal material property distributions from surface responses such as displacement fields, using high-fidelity simulations, robust feature extraction and regularization to handle the ill-posedness of the inverse problem.

projects.title: Digital twin simulation of rockfall hazards
projects.summary: Develop a digital twin framework for simulating and assessing rockfall hazards in real-world terrains, using terrain reconstruction from drone or LiDAR data and the lab's in-house DEM code. The project also explores uncertainty quantification and machine learning surrogate models for risk mapping.

projects.title: Experimental Investigation of Architected Granular Materials
projects.summary: Study architected granular materials, whose particle shapes, surface properties and packing are designed to control macroscopic mechanical behavior. The work involves 3D-printing custom particles, assembling controlled granular packings, running static and dynamic mechanical tests with digital image correlation, and linking microscale interactions to macroscale stiffness and energy absorption.

projects.title: Phase-field modeling of fracture in architected structural materials
projects.summary: The project develops and applies phase-field fracture models to simulate crack initiation and propagation in architected structural materials such as truss lattices and bioinspired composites. It aims to understand how microstructural features influence fracture toughness, fracture modes and energy dissipation, and to explore machine-learning surrogate models for phase-field evolution.

projects.title: Accelerating Geophysical Flow Simulation Using Machine Learning
projects.summary: Develop and train a fast machine learning-based emulator of geophysical flows (landslides, rockfalls, snow avalanches) using data from material point simulations and remote sensing. The goal is to replace costly physics-based simulations with a faster predictive model.

projects.title: Digital Twin Simulation of Rockfall Hazards
projects.summary: Build a Discrete Element Method computational framework that predicts rockfall runout, taking boulder shape from drone imagery and boulder fragmentation into account.

projects.title: Discovering Internal Material Properties from Surface Observations
projects.summary: Use physics-informed neural operators to infer internal material properties from data available on the boundary of a body, with applications such as subsurface engineering and material testing.

projects.title: Segregation in granular flows
projects.summary: Study segregation mechanisms in granular flows and how particle shape affects them, using the Discrete Element Method.

projects.title: Multiphysics Modeling of Fault Gouge
projects.summary: Study the contact mechanics and multiphysics (thermal and fluid) behaviour of fault gouge from both discrete and continuum modeling perspectives, to better understand earthquake processes.

projects.title: Experimental Investigation of Architected Granular Materials
projects.summary: Explore architected granular materials, such as granular crystals and quasicrystals, for penetration applications through experiments.

projects.title: Phase-field Modeling of Fracture of Architected Structural Materials
projects.summary: Develop a micromechanics-informed phase-field computational model, potentially combined with deep learning, to capture fracture in architected structural materials and compare it against ongoing experiments.

projects.title: Characterization of TiN layers deposited with Plasma Enhanced Atomic Layer Deposition (PEALD) for 3D Superconducting nanostructures
projects.summary: Characterize titanium nitride (TiN) layers deposited by plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD), for use in 3D superconducting nanostructures.

projects.title: Fabrication and characterization of ferromagnetic Josephson junctions for superspintronics
projects.summary: Fabricate and characterize ferromagnetic Josephson junctions for superspintronics, combining superconducting and spintronic functionality.

projects.title: Investigation of vortex dynamics in 3D superconducting nano-structures using Time-Dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory with COMSOL Multiphysics
projects.summary: Study vortex dynamics in 3D superconducting nanostructures by simulation with Time-Dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory in COMSOL Multiphysics.

projects.title: Spectroscopy on spin waves in ferromagnet/ferrimagnet hybrid nanostructures
projects.summary: Perform spectroscopy measurements of spin waves in hybrid nanostructures combining a ferromagnet and a ferrimagnet.

projects.title: Amplification of greyscale nanopatterning via thermal scanning probe lithography and dry etching techniques
projects.summary: Combine thermal scanning probe lithography (t-SPL) with plasma dry etching to amplify nanoscale greyscale resist topographies into dielectric substrates while keeping pattern fidelity and reproducibility. The work includes AFM and SEM characterization of the resulting surface topography. Applications mentioned are photonics and nanoelectronics.

projects.title: Optimization of Ion Beam Etching for IGZO Thin-Film Transistors on Biodegradable Substrates
projects.summary: Optimize ion beam etching parameters for IGZO films patterned by stencil lithography, aiming for steep edges and controllable etch rate. The project may extend the process to biodegradable substrates and to closed-loop IGZO structures made with bridge stencils.

projects.title: Characterization of Ultrasound-Activated Piezoelectric Microbeads for Bioelectronic Applications
projects.summary: Experimentally characterize the piezoelectric response of ultrasound-activated composite microbeads made by microfluidics, to measure how effectively they convert ultrasound into electrical signals. The goal is a step toward wireless neural stimulation and minimally invasive biomedical devices.

projects.title: Designing MR Guidance for Microfabrication via Real-World Interaction
projects.summary: Develop and test mixed-reality guidance for microfabrication learning using Unity 3D, with real-world object interaction and sensor events. The project also includes a small usability study and iterative design based on the feedback.

projects.title: Microchannel characterization of liquid sample for Dynamic Nuclear Polarization (DNP) measurements
projects.summary: Develop methods for filling, sealing and characterizing microchannels so that liquid samples can be measured on an in-house miniaturized DNP chip at nanoliter scale. A new device concept, possibly with clean-room fabrication, may also be investigated.

projects.title: Optimization of Ion Beam Etching for IGZO Thin-Film Transistors on Biodegradable Substrates
projects.summary: The project aims to optimize ion beam etching parameters for IGZO films patterned by stencil lithography, targeting the steepest possible edge with a controllable etching rate. It may extend to biodegradable substrates and to closed-loop IGZO structures made with bridge stencils.

projects.title: Designing MR Guidance for Microfabrication via Real-World Interaction
projects.summary: Develop and evaluate a mixed reality system for microfabrication learning, using Unity 3D and HoloLens, with real-world object interaction, sensor data via Azure IoT Hub, and a small usability study to drive iterative design.

projects.title: Amplification of greyscale nanopatterning via thermal scanning probe lithography and dry etching techniques
projects.summary: The project aims to combine thermal scanning probe lithography (t-SPL) with plasma dry etching to amplify nanoscale resist topographies into dielectric substrates while keeping pattern fidelity and reproducibility. Surface topography will be characterised by AFM and SEM to assess pattern transfer and amplification.

projects.title: Characterization of Ultrasound-Activated Piezoelectric Microbeads for Bioelectronic Applications
projects.summary: Experimental characterization of the piezoelectric response of ultrasound-activated composite microbeads (BaTiO₃ and Fe₃O₄ particles) made by microfluidics, to quantify how they convert ultrasound into electrical signals for wireless neural stimulation and minimally invasive biomedical devices.

projects.title: Microchannel characterization of liquid sample for Dynamic Nuclear Polarization (DNP) measurements
projects.summary: Develop and validate methods for filling, sealing, and characterizing microchannels for liquid samples on an in-house miniaturized DNP chip. If needed, the project also explores a new microchannel device concept, possibly involving clean-room fabrication.

projects.title: Parametric study of induction sintering iron
projects.summary: Study of induction sintering of iron, an advanced powder metallurgy technique in which electromagnetic induction heats conductive material directly. The induced eddy currents heat the material by Joule effect and hysteresis and help break down oxide barriers between particles through local discharges. The project is a parametric study of this process.

projects.title: Harnessing Melt Pool Dynamics in Additive Manufacturing
projects.summary: Studies how the melt pool formed by a high-energy source (laser, electron beam or plasma) solidifies metal in additive manufacturing, and how its dynamics can be exploited. The page text is truncated, so the full objectives are not visible.

projects.title: Titanium matrix composites produced by electro-sinter-forging
projects.summary: Explores the electro-sinter-forging (ESF) field-assisted sintering process for producing titanium matrix composites, in collaboration with EPoS Technologies SA. The page text is truncated, so the full objectives are not visible.

projects.title: Structure and micromechanics of oxide inclusions in ferrous alloys
projects.summary: Investigates the mechanical properties of oxide inclusions within an iron-based matrix and the characteristics of the inclusion-matrix interface. The page text is truncated, so the full objectives are not visible.

projects.title: Parametric study of induction sintering iron
projects.summary: A parametric study of induction sintering of iron powder. Induction sintering uses electromagnetic induction to heat conductive materials directly, with eddy currents that also help break down oxide barriers between touching particles, and is compared with conventional furnace sintering.

projects.title: Lexicon of geological CO₂ storage (GCS)
projects.summary: Revise and document the fundamental principles of geological CO₂ storage and implement them on an EPFL-designed online website. The project also aims to update data on existing GCS projects and storage capacity in Europe and worldwide, and prepare open data sharing.

projects.title: Experimental investigation of soil water retention mechanisms in compacted soils
projects.summary: Experimentally investigate how adsorption and capillarity contribute to water retention in compacted soils, and quantify their respective contributions to the retention behaviour. The work includes a literature review, laboratory testing on prepared soil samples, and collaboration with the University of Genoa and ENTPE Lyon.

projects.title: In Situ Stress at Mont Terri
projects.summary: Reconstruct and interpret in situ stress components from multi-borehole stress-measurement data of the IS-E experiment at the Mont Terri Rock Laboratory. The project aims to validate the EPFL-LMS methodology for full stress-state reconstruction in borehole environments.

projects.title: AI-Based Subsurface Characterisation
projects.summary: Develop AI and machine learning workflows for automated stratigraphic characterisation from cone penetration test (CPT) and borehole data. The project also aims to quantify uncertainty in layer boundary identification and support scalable 3D subsurface modelling.

projects.title: Pore Pressure in Underground Storage
projects.summary: Develop a poromechanical model to simulate pore-pressure build-up and depletion in deep underground storage, such as H₂ and CO₂ storage. The project also translates predicted pore-pressure changes into effective stress evolution and compares injection and withdrawal scenarios.
