projects.title: Consideration of Soil-Structure Interaction for Advanced Seismic Behavior Analysis of Existing Buildings
projects.summary: Investigates how soil-structure interaction should be included in seismic analyses of existing buildings to improve the reliability of seismic vulnerability assessments and inform retrofit strategies. The work combines a review of research and regulations, numerical modelling with soil-structure interaction, and a case study.

projects.title: Development of a machine learning approach to support the design and performance analysis of borehole heat exchangers
projects.summary: Aims to predict the heat transfer performance of borehole heat exchangers (BHEs) with machine learning techniques, supporting their design and performance analysis. The student will work with numerical models of BHEs built in COMSOL Multiphysics.

projects.title: Development of a machine learning approach for sustainable operation of geothermal borehole fields
projects.summary: Aims to develop machine learning models that predict heat transfer performance of geothermal borehole heat exchangers, using data collected from instrumented pilot installations. The work includes installing temperature sensors on hydraulic loops and checking measurement quality.

projects.title: Evaluating sealing capacity of damaged caprock zones in geological CO₂ storage
projects.summary: Studies the sealing capacity of fissured and crushed caprock, the layer that keeps injected CO₂ from escaping in geological storage. The work uses 3D micro-structural characterisation by x-ray tomography and digital volume correlation to quantify volumetric changes.

projects.title: Machine learning approaches for improving real-time monitoring in geological CO₂ storage
projects.summary: Develops data-driven machine learning models that predict hydromechanical response in geological CO₂ storage, trained on a large synthetic dataset generated with the FEM code CodeBRIGHT.

projects.title: In Situ Stress at Mont Terri
projects.summary: Reconstructs and interprets in situ stress components from multi-borehole stress measurements of the IS-E experiment at the Mont Terri Rock Laboratory, and validates the EPFL-LMS methodology for full stress-state reconstruction. The work covers data quality checks, post-processing and uncertainty assessment.

projects.title: Soil Water Retention
projects.summary: Experimentally investigates the water retention mechanisms of compacted soils, quantifying the contributions of adsorbed and capillary water to retention behaviour. The work includes a literature review, laboratory testing, and collaboration with the University of Genoa and ENTPE Lyon.

projects.title: AI-Based Subsurface Characterisation
projects.summary: Develops AI-based workflows for automated stratigraphic characterisation from cone penetration test (CPT) and borehole data, with quantified uncertainty in layer boundaries to support 3D subsurface modelling for infrastructure projects.

projects.title: Pore Pressure in Underground Storage
projects.summary: Develops a poromechanical framework to model pore-pressure evolution in deep underground storage such as H₂ and CO₂ storage, and derives the resulting effective stress paths. The student implements the model in MATLAB or Python and compares injection and withdrawal scenarios.

projects.title: Projet de Master: Intégration de fibres optiques dans des alliages haute résistance par impression laser sur lit de poudre
projects.summary: Master project on integrating optical fibres into high-strength alloys during laser powder bed fusion additive manufacturing. The page gives no further details.

projects.title: Projet de Master: Étude de la relation microstructure–propriétés d’un alliage de métaux précieux dédié à la fabrication additive
projects.summary: Master project studying the relationship between microstructure and properties of a precious metal alloy designed for additive manufacturing. The page gives no further details.

projects.title: Projet de Master en Entreprise: Mise en forme de produits en alliages de Titane
projects.summary: Industry-based master project on forming products from titanium alloys. The page gives no further details.

projects.title: Laser Powder Bed Fusion manufacturing of ferromagnetic materials
projects.summary: Master (PDM) project on laser powder bed fusion manufacturing of ferromagnetic materials, carried out in collaboration with CSEM in Neuchâtel. The page gives no further details.

projects.title: Master thesis project Fall 2025: Study of the microstructure-properties relationship of a precious metal alloy dedicated to additive manufacturing
projects.summary: Studies how the microstructure of a precious metal alloy relates to its properties, with the alloy intended for additive manufacturing.

projects.title: Master project in industry: Titanium alloy product forming
projects.summary: Master project in an industrial setting on forming products made from titanium alloys.

projects.title: Laser Powder Bed Fusion manufacturing of ferromagnetic materials
projects.summary: Explores laser powder bed fusion manufacturing of ferromagnetic materials, as a collaboration between CSEM and EPFL.

projects.title: Laser Powder Bed Fusion manufacturing of ferromagnetic materials
projects.summary: Investigates Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) processing of ferromagnetic materials to produce complex-geometry magnetic parts, studying how process parameters affect magnetic properties and microstructure. The final goal is a miniaturized high-performance magnetic demonstrator.

projects.title: Projet de Master en Entreprise – PX Group (Printemps ou automne 2025)
projects.summary: Characterise the chemical nature and thickness of the layer formed during the initial annealing of titanium alloys before forming, using heat treatments at PX Group and analyses such as XPS and electron microscopy. Then study the tribological behaviour of this layer and its role in lubrication during the drawing process, including its friction properties and failure limits.

projects.title: Microstructure-properties relationships in a precious metallic alloy dedicated to additive manufacturing
projects.summary: Study the relationship between microstructure and mechanical properties of a precious metallic alloy produced by additive manufacturing, covering sample preparation, microscopy, hardness measurements and in situ acoustic emission monitoring of the process. The work is done in collaboration with a major watchmaker.

projects.title: Development of a mechanical fluidic guide wire for intravascular procedures
projects.summary: Develop a manually operated, fluidically untethered, steerable guide wire for vascular intervention, in parallel with an electrofluidic version. The project includes interfacing with clinical collaborators to turn their feedback into product development benchmarks.

projects.title: Numerical simulation and optimization of electrohydrodynamic pumps
projects.summary: Continue developing a COMSOL Multiphysics numerical model of electrohydrodynamic (EHD) pumps, validate it against experimental data, and then pursue topological optimization of the pump. Optimized designs may be prototyped and tested on a high-voltage bench.

projects.title: Decoding the Propagation of Tactile Waves
projects.summary: Study how elastic waves generated by touch propagate through skin by mapping them in vivo with skin-conformal wearable haptic devices. The work also includes multilayer skin phantoms and a finite element model with a fast surrogate model validated against experiments.

projects.title: Automated Winding Machine for Meter-long Fiber Motors
projects.summary: Design, build and test an improved winding machine able to produce fiber motors up to 5 m long, compared with the current 50 cm. The project also includes characterizing fiber quality such as pitch uniformity, electrode continuity and insulation integrity.

projects.title: FiberMotor at company Elecsyor
projects.summary: Develop advanced manufacturing methods and automated test benches for a flexible fiber-format electrostatic linear motor, working with the start-up Elecyor near Lyon, France. The project is a master project carried out in a company.

projects.title: Eco-friendly Disposable Wireless Biochemical Sensor for Point of Care Diagnostics
projects.summary: Design, fabricate and characterize biodegradable zinc-based wireless LC sensing labels with microfluidic channels for detecting ionic solutions. As a master project, the platform can be biofunctionalized to detect specific analytes in body fluids such as sweat.

projects.title: Zinc Electroplating on Laser Induced Graphene for Transient Eco-Friendly Electronics
projects.summary: Develop transient zinc metallization by electroplating zinc onto laser-induced graphene patterned on biodegradable substrates such as wood or paper. The work covers process optimization, device demonstrators, and, for master projects, reliability and end-of-life studies.

projects.title: Eco-friendly Degradable and Recyclable Wireless RFID Sensing Tags for Logistics
projects.summary: Develop biodegradable RFID and NFC sensing tags printed on paper substrates for item identification and monitoring of perishable goods. Master projects focus on temperature threshold sensors, tag design and fabrication, and biodegradation; semester projects cover one or more of these aspects.

projects.title: Time temperature indicator microfluidic module with integrated capacitive sensor
projects.summary: Design, fabricate and characterize a battery-free microfluidic module with embedded phase-change material and a capacitive transducer, for cold-chain temperature monitoring. The goal is to discriminate between a few and several hours spent above 8°C.

projects.title: Embedding Sensors into Microfluidics using Vat photopolymerization (VPP) 3D printing
projects.summary: Fabricate electrodes and embed them as sensors into 3D-printed microfluidic channels using a print-pause-print process, then characterize and biofunctionalize them for saliva biomarker analysis in a smart denture.

projects.title: Transient Electrode Biointerfaces: Functionalization of Zn/Carbon for Multi-Analyte Recognition
projects.summary: Develop biodegradable biointerfaces on zinc and carbon electrodes that can be functionalized with receptors for a range of analytes while preserving transience. Work includes surface analysis and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, with optional sensing and stability tests.

projects.title: Neural correlates of memory, navigation, and bodily self
projects.summary: Open student project in the lab's area of neural correlates of memory, navigation, and bodily self. The page gives no further detail beyond this topic.

projects.title: Investigating bodily self-conciousness using virtual reality
projects.summary: Student project investigating bodily self-consciousness using virtual reality. The page gives no further detail beyond this topic.

projects.title: Vestibular contributions to bodily self-consciousness (motion platform)
projects.summary: Student project studying vestibular contributions to bodily self-consciousness, using a motion platform. The page gives no further detail beyond this topic.

projects.title: Investigating hallucinations in Parkinson's Disease
projects.summary: Student project investigating hallucinations in Parkinson's disease. The page gives no further detail beyond this topic.

projects.title: Membrane Less Electrolyser Stack Characterization
projects.summary: Characterize the performance of a membrane-less electrolyser stack. The page gives no further detail.

projects.title: Energy Storage In The Form Of Hydrogen Using Membrane Less Electrolyzers
projects.summary: Study the use of membrane-less electrolyzers to store energy as hydrogen. The page gives no further detail.

projects.title: Dissolved Gas Separation From Liquid Electrolyte For Membrane Less Electrolyzers
projects.summary: Separate dissolved gas from the liquid electrolyte of membrane-less electrolyzers. The page gives no further detail.

projects.title: Effect Of Different Catalysts On The Performance Of Membrane Less Water Electrolyzers
projects.summary: Investigate how different catalysts affect the performance of membrane-less water electrolyzers.

projects.title: Multimode Fiber Based High Speed Optical Computing Modelling and Control with Neural Networks
projects.summary: Model and control a high-speed optical computing system based on multimode fibers, using neural networks.

projects.title: Multimode Fiber Based Optical Computing Unit for Large Scale Neural Networks
projects.summary: Develop an optical computing unit based on multimode fibers for large-scale neural networks.

projects.title: Dynamic wetting measurement with image analysis on synchrotron x-ray tomography data
projects.summary: Measurement of dynamic wetting using image analysis applied to synchrotron X-ray tomography data.

projects.title: Life Cycle Assessment and Circularity Strategy for On-Campus 3D Printing Waste Recycling
projects.summary: Life cycle assessment and circularity strategy for recycling 3D printing waste generated on the EPFL campus.

projects.title: Upcycling discarded glass fiber waste into short fiber reinforced thermoplastic composites
projects.summary: Upcycling of discarded glass fiber waste into short-fiber reinforced thermoplastic composites.

projects.title: Effect of temperature on fluid properties and flow patterns in LCM
projects.summary: Study of how temperature affects fluid properties and flow patterns in liquid composite molding.

projects.title: Characterization and optimization of a UV cured composite coating for biodegradable substrates
projects.summary: Characterization and optimization of a UV-cured composite coating applied to biodegradable substrates.

projects.title: Upcycling of recycled carbon fibers for the new generation FRP composites
projects.summary: Upcycling of recycled carbon fibers for use in next-generation fiber-reinforced polymer composites.

projects.title: Vitrimer formulations for circular composite industry
projects.summary: Development of vitrimer formulations to support a circular economy for composite materials.

projects.title: Wear Resistant Superhydrophobic Surfaces
projects.summary: Design of superhydrophobic surfaces with improved wear resistance.

projects.title: Optical detection of matrix cracking in glass-fibre composites using fluorescent mechanophores
projects.summary: Optical detection of matrix cracking in glass-fibre composites using fluorescent mechanophores.

projects.title: Closed-Loop Recycling of Photocured Glass-Fiber Reinforced Composites Based on Transesterification
projects.summary: Closed-loop recycling of photocured glass-fiber reinforced composites based on transesterification chemistry.

projects.title: Assessment of the residual stresses of composites produced by frontal polymerisation
projects.summary: Assessment of residual stresses in composites produced by frontal polymerisation.

projects.title: Effect of Aligned and Offset fiber Placement on Flow behavior and Permeability
projects.summary: Study of how aligned and offset fiber placement affects flow behavior and permeability.

projects.title: Design of a Heated Mold System to Study Flow-Front Dynamics in Liquid Composite Molding
projects.summary: Design of a heated mold system for studying flow-front dynamics in liquid composite molding.

projects.title: Optimization of a carbon fiber pyrolysis recycling chain
projects.summary: Optimization of a recycling chain based on pyrolysis of carbon fiber waste.

projects.title: Monte Carlo modelling of NetZero scenarios for the carbon fiber industry – dynamic mass and CAPEX flows
projects.summary: Monte Carlo modelling of NetZero scenarios for the carbon fiber industry, covering dynamic mass and CAPEX flows.

projects.title: NetPositive modelling of an automotive front seat in SimaPro (life cycle analysis) with shadow pricing
projects.summary: Life cycle analysis in SimaPro of an automotive front seat using NetPositive modelling with shadow pricing.

projects.title: Design Optimisation and Experimental Testing of Composite T-joints
projects.summary: Design optimisation and experimental testing of composite T-joints.

projects.title: Upcycling the recycled carbon fibers by tailoring the interface
projects.summary: Upcycling of recycled carbon fibers by tailoring the fiber-matrix interface.

projects.title: Fast processing of epoxide polymers and composites by Radical Induced Frontal Polymerisation
projects.summary: The project studies radical induced frontal polymerisation as a fast, energy-efficient way to process epoxide polymers and fibre-reinforced composites. The work focuses on composite processing, process modelling, or additive manufacturing, with the exact topic to be defined with the student and controlling the local heat balance of the polymerisation front.

projects.title: Optical detection of matrix cracking in glass-fibre composites using fluorescent mechanophores
projects.summary: The student prepares epoxy formulations containing force-responsive mechanophores as the matrix of glass-fibre composites. The goal is to check whether matrix microcracks can be reported by a local fluorescence response, using optical and fluorescence microscopy on mechanically tested samples.

projects.title: Upcycling of recycled carbon fibers for the new generation FRP composites
projects.summary: Design sizing coatings for thermally recycled carbon fibers, targeted at epoxy and Elium matrices, to restore surface functionality and interfacial strength lost during thermal recycling. Interfacial strength will be characterized with IFSS tests and bulk properties with ILSS tests. The project is an industrial collaboration with Composite Recycling, which supplies the fibers and requires a non-disclosure agreement.

projects.title: Wear Resistant Superhydrophobic Surfaces
projects.summary: Develop wear-resistant superhydrophobic coatings using a UV-curable silicone acrylate binder and surface-methacrylated fumed silica nanoparticles. The covalent bonds formed during UV photopolymerization between the nanoparticles and the binder are expected to improve abrasion resistance.

projects.title: Vitrimer formulations for circular composite industry
projects.summary: Develop new vitrimer resin formulations for fiber reinforced polymer composites that can be recycled, repaired, or reprocessed at end-of-life while keeping thermoset-like performance. The work covers resin formulation and optimization, rheological and curing tests, thermo-mechanical characterization, and composite manufacturing and reprocessing, as part of an Innosuisse project with Huntsman.

projects.title: Design Optimisation and Experimental Testing of Composite T-joints
projects.summary: The thesis develops a parametric finite-element optimisation pipeline for T-joint geometries representative of composite blade-to-disk interfaces in high-speed thermoplastic impellers. The student will also test existing T-joint specimens under quasi-static loading with full-field DIC, and possibly fabricate and test optimised geometries.

projects.title: Monte Carlo modelling of NetZero scenarios for the carbon fiber industry – dynamic mass and CAPEX flows
projects.summary: Extend an existing Python–Excel Monte Carlo model of the carbon fiber market to 2050 by generating dynamic mass flow analyses by market sector, tracking virgin and reused carbon fiber grades. The project also models the CAPEX flows needed to re-route mass flows in the economy, and includes sensitivity and statistical analyses of key variables.

projects.title: NetPositive modelling of an automotive front seat in SimaPro (life cycle analysis) with shadow pricing
projects.summary: Develop a case study applying the NetPositive methodology to an automotive front seat structure, comparing a steel incumbent with a lightweight polyamide alternative. The work combines SimaPro/ecoinvent life cycle assessment across scope 1, 2 and 3 with shadow-priced externalities and Excel-based NetPositive calculations, including sensitivity analyses of decarbonisation and circular end-of-life levers.

projects.title: Optimization of a carbon fiber pyrolysis recycling chain
projects.summary: The project aims to validate a process window for recovering carbon fibers from aerospace composite waste by pyrolysis and oxidation, for reuse in second-life applications. It compares lab-scale (OST) and industrial-scale (Composites Recycling S.A.) trials, characterises recovered fibers against virgin carbon fiber, and builds a techno-economic and environmental (SimaPro life-cycle) decision framework.

projects.title: Assessment of the residual stresses of composites produced by frontal polymerisation
projects.summary: The project aims to assess residual stresses in carbon fibre reinforced polymer composites produced by frontal polymerisation, comparing them with oven-cured composites. The student will manufacture laminates, measure strains via warpage or slitting techniques, and back-calculate the stresses.

projects.title: Closed-Loop Recycling of Photocured Glass-Fiber Reinforced Composites Based on Transesterification
projects.summary: Develop a dual-cure vitrimer resin based on Aza-Michael addition followed by UV photopolymerization, with transesterification chemistry enabling recyclability. The student will manufacture glass-fiber composites by vacuum infusion, test their thermo-mechanical and vitrimeric properties, and assess closed-loop depolymerization and reuse of recovered fibers and resin.

projects.title: Upcycling the recycled carbon fibers by tailoring the interface
projects.summary: Design and synthesis of a sizing coating for thermally recycled carbon fibers to restore interfacial strength with an Elium matrix, followed by IFSS, ILSS and flexural characterization of the resulting composites. The project is an industrial collaboration with Composite Recycling and requires signing a non-disclosure agreement.

projects.title: Effect of temperature on fluid properties and flow patterns in LCM
projects.summary: Investigate how elevated temperature affects flow-front dynamics and impregnation patterns in fibrous preforms during liquid composite molding, using a heated mold and a PEG / zinc iodide model liquid. The project characterises the temperature-dependent surface tension, viscosity, density, thermal conductivity and specific heat of the model liquid.

projects.title: Life Cycle Assessment and Circularity Strategy for On-Campus 3D Printing Waste Recycling
projects.summary: Perform a Life Cycle Assessment of ReSpool's PETG filament recycling system and use the results to develop a long-term circularity strategy. The work covers material flows from waste collection to new filament production and compares centralized and decentralized recycling scenarios, including transportation, energy and geographic expansion.

projects.title: Upcycling discarded glass fiber waste into short fiber reinforced thermoplastic composites
projects.summary: Develop an industrial pathway to reintegrate short recycled glass fibers as reinforcement in thermoplastic composites, combining surface restoration, morphology control and compounding validation. The student compares processability and mechanical performance of virgin versus recycled fibers in short fiber reinforced composites (SFRC), using twin-screw compounding, compression molding, optical analysis and mechanical characterization.

projects.title: Dynamic wetting measurement with image analysis on synchrotron x-ray tomography data
projects.summary: The project evaluates whether wetting dynamics can be studied from 4D synchrotron X-ray CT images of fabric impregnation. It involves segmenting large 3D+t datasets into fibers, liquid, air and other phases, then modelling the dynamic contact angle as a function of contact-line velocity.

projects.title: Modeling and Characterization of the Natural-Convection Oil-Based Insulation for Medium Frequency Transformers
projects.summary: Model and experimentally characterize natural-convection oil-based insulation for medium frequency transformers. Detailed project descriptions are available on request.

projects.title: Modeling and optimizing of the air flow and the heat transfer in a robust and affordable infant incubator
projects.summary: Model and optimize the air flow and heat transfer in a robust and affordable infant incubator. Detailed project descriptions are available on request.

projects.title: Development of a setup for ethanol quantification under CO2 electrochemical reduction at electrode/solid electrolyte interface
projects.summary: Develop an experimental setup to quantify ethanol produced by CO2 electrochemical reduction at the electrode/solid electrolyte interface. Detailed project descriptions are available on request.

projects.title: Design, simulation and experimental validation of a high solar flux calorimeter
projects.summary: Design and simulate a calorimeter for high solar flux, then validate it experimentally. Detailed project descriptions are available on request.

projects.title: Development of a quasi 2D multi-physical transport model of a PEC device made of a morphologically complex photoelectrode
projects.summary: Build a quasi-2D multi-physics transport model of a photoelectrochemical (PEC) device with a morphologically complex photoelectrode.

projects.title: Process simulation of a concentrated solar hydrogen, heat and power production facility for optimal demand matching
projects.summary: Simulate the process of a concentrated solar facility producing hydrogen, heat and power, to optimize matching with demand.

projects.title: Modeling light absorption, electron-transfer kinetics and species transport in particle based photocatalytic reactor for water splitting
projects.summary: Model light absorption, electron-transfer kinetics and species transport in a particle-based photocatalytic reactor for water splitting.

projects.title: Optimization of hydrophilic/phobic zones in fuel cell gas diffusion layers for enhanced evaporative cooling
projects.summary: Optimize the arrangement of hydrophilic and hydrophobic zones in fuel cell gas diffusion layers to enhance evaporative cooling.

projects.title: Design and optimization of volume of fluid simulations in newly designed porous media for fuel cells
projects.summary: Design and optimize volume of fluid simulations in newly designed porous media for fuel cells.

projects.title: Numerical characterization of transport properties for artificially generated 3D macro-porous ceria in solar-assisted water splitting application
projects.summary: Numerically characterize the transport properties of artificially generated 3D macro-porous ceria for solar-assisted water splitting.

projects.title: Development of a catalytic hydrogen stove
projects.summary: Develop a catalytic stove that runs on hydrogen as a cooking fuel.

projects.title: Environmental, social and health impact of hydrogen as cooking fuel in the Global South
projects.summary: Assess the environmental, social and health impacts of using hydrogen as a cooking fuel in the Global South. Project carried out in collaboration with HOBEL.

projects.title: Smart and scalable control scheme for hydrogen production site
projects.summary: Design a smart and scalable control scheme for a hydrogen production site. Project carried out in collaboration with DECODE.

projects.title: Modeling of gas-fed test electrolyzers
projects.summary: Model gas-fed test electrolyzers. Project carried out in collaboration with LNCE.

projects.title: Degradation investigation in photoelectrochemical devices for hydrogen production
projects.summary: Investigate degradation mechanisms in photoelectrochemical devices used for hydrogen production.

projects.title: Uncoupling conduction and radiation heat transfer in high-temperature porous media
projects.summary: Separate conduction and radiation heat transfer in high-temperature porous media.

projects.title: Fabrication of micro-patterned water-splitting photoelectrodes and their experimental characterization
projects.summary: Fabricate micro-patterned photoelectrodes for water splitting and characterize them experimentally.

projects.title: Design of optical flux homogenizer for a parabolic dish based concentrated PV system
projects.summary: Design an optical flux homogenizer for a concentrated photovoltaic system based on a parabolic dish.

projects.title: Thermal design and behavior of integrated photoelectrochemical devices in a parabolic dish concentrator
projects.summary: Study the thermal design and behavior of integrated photoelectrochemical devices placed in a parabolic dish concentrator.

projects.title: High-flux solar simulator: Testing of an experimental chamber for experiments under controlled conditions
projects.summary: Test an experimental chamber for experiments under controlled conditions in a high-flux solar simulator.

projects.title: Radiative transfer in nano-structure media for solar energy conversion applications
projects.summary: Study radiative transfer in nano-structured media for solar energy conversion applications. A separate project description is available on the page.

projects.title: Modeling, designing, and optimizing devices performing artificial photosynthesis
projects.summary: Model, design and optimize devices that perform artificial photosynthesis.

projects.title: Optimizing Microperforated Polymer Membranes for 3D Brain Organoid Mechanobiology
projects.summary: Investigate how perforation size, geometry, thickness and material of polymer membranes (PI, PDMS) affect brain organoid integration and mechanobiological response under active strain. The student would fabricate membranes, seed organoids, apply mechanical stretching and perform fluorescence imaging.

projects.title: Thermal Modelling and Management in Soft Flexible microLED Arrays
projects.summary: Develop thermal and optical models of soft microLED arrays for optogenetic stimulation, and build an optimization pipeline that maps target irradiance to device and stimulation parameters while limiting tissue heating.

projects.title: 3D Bioprinting of Sacrificial Stiffening Layers for Self-Inserting Needles on Peripheral Nerve Interfaces
projects.summary: Develop an extrusion bioprinting process to deposit a water-soluble sacrificial stiffening layer that protects high-aspect-ratio microneedles on a peripheral nerve cuff during implantation and then dissolves to let the needles self-insert.

projects.title: Electrochemical Aging of PEDOT-Coated Neural Interfaces: Characterizing Long-Term Stimulation Stability
projects.summary: Evaluate the electrochemical stability of PEDOT coatings on active sites of a peripheral nerve interface under prolonged stimulation, chemical aging and mechanical stress, to identify safe stimulation currents and delamination failure modes.

projects.title: Towards the Thinnest Fully Implantable, Wireless Bidirectional Neural Interface
projects.summary: Integrate ultra-thin polyimide neural electrodes, flip-chip silicon chips, wireless power coils and Bluetooth Low Energy antennas into a single fully implantable bidirectional neural interface, and validate it electrically and in small-animal experiments.

projects.title: Designing the Future of Wireless Neural Interfaces: Microfabrication of Coils and Antennas for Soft Bioelectronics
projects.summary: Microfabricate and characterize flexible polyimide thin-film coils for wireless power at about 13.56 MHz and antennas for the Bluetooth band, aiming at a fully implantable ECoG platform for small animals.

projects.title: Development of Flexible Field Effect Transistor (FET)-Based Sensors for Neural Biosensing Applications
projects.summary: Develop flexible FET-based biosensors to detect neurotransmitters such as dopamine and glutamate and other neural biomarkers, complementing neural signal recordings with biochemical information.

projects.title: Study the consequences of the break-up of the geostationary satellite Luch/Olymp
projects.summary: Study the consequences of the break-up of the geostationary satellite Luch/Olymp, a space debris scenario.

projects.title: Finite-Element Design of Thermal Buffering Units
projects.summary: Design of thermal buffering units using finite-element simulations.

projects.title: Soft lubrication of solid impacts
projects.summary: Study of how a soft lubrication layer affects impacts between solid bodies.

projects.title: How microcracks interactions influence macroscale fracture advance
projects.summary: Investigation of how interactions between microcracks shape the advance of fracture at the macroscale.

projects.title: Emergence of complexity in a frictional system: reproducing earthquake statistics
projects.summary: Study of how complex behaviour emerges in a frictional system, with the aim of reproducing earthquake statistics.

projects.title: Neural networks meet finite elements
projects.summary: Combining neural networks with finite-element methods for mechanics problems.

projects.title: Wave propagation in layered media
projects.summary: Study of wave propagation through layered media.

projects.title: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for friction
projects.summary: Use of physics-informed neural networks to model friction.

projects.title: Finite-Element Design of Thermal Buffering Units
projects.summary: Develop a finite-element model of heat transfer in a salt-hydrate latent heat storage unit and use simulations to compare geometries and operating conditions to maximise power density without losing storage capacity. An optional second part involves building a prototype with experimentalists and calibrating the model against measurements.

projects.title: Soft lubrication of solid impacts
projects.summary: Investigate how soft solids impacting rigid surfaces behave, with a focus on the effect of surface topography on contact region formation and air trapping under quasi-static conditions. The student implements a 2D finite-difference simulation in Python.

projects.title: How microcracks interactions influence macroscale fracture advance
projects.summary: Reproduce the microcrack nucleation, growth and coalescence ahead of a main crack in dynamic mode I fracture, using rate-dependent cohesive laws in the open-source cRacklet spectral boundary interface model. The aim is to understand the mechanics behind comet patterns observed on PMMA fracture surfaces.

projects.title: Emergence of complexity in a frictional system: reproducing earthquake statistics
projects.summary: Study how adding disorder to a simple frictional slip system affects the transition between power-law and log-normal distributions of slip event sizes, as a way to understand the origin of earthquake statistics. The student uses the Akantu finite element software developed in the lab.

projects.title: Neural networks meet finite elements
projects.summary: Combine the finite element method with machine-learning tools by analysing recent methods from the literature, such as the Deep Ritz Method, and adapting them to large-deformation problems in simple geometries.

projects.title: Wave propagation in layered media (theoretical)
projects.summary: Theoretical project exploring how abstract algebra can help unravel the complexity of wave propagation through layered media, where repeated reflection, transmission and superposition create intricate wave patterns.

projects.title: Wave propagation in layered media (numerical)
projects.summary: Numerical project implementing and testing new methods to simulate wave propagation in structured, layered materials, where complex wave behaviour arises from repeated reflection, transmission and superposition.

projects.title: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for friction
projects.summary: Survey efficient ways to train physics-informed neural networks and apply them to solve stick-slip friction problems. An optional mathematical direction analyses the convergence and error estimates of PINNs.

projects.title: Study the consequences of the break-up of the geostationary satellite Luch/Olymp
projects.summary: Study how fragments from the 2026 break-up of the decommissioned geostationary satellite Luch/Olymp disperse in orbit and whether the debris cloud threatens operational and decommissioned satellites in GEO. The work includes processing astronomical images to obtain fragment data and performing long-term orbit propagation.

projects.title: Aerial Aquatic Multirotor Project
projects.summary: Student project on a multirotor robot able to operate in both air and water. The page gives only the title and a downloadable proposal.

projects.title: LSR Student Project AAM MPC
projects.summary: Student project on model predictive control for the aerial aquatic multirotor (AAM) platform. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: LSR Student Project AAM Impinging
projects.summary: Student project on impinging flow or impact studies related to the aerial aquatic multirotor (AAM) platform. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: SPINE V2
projects.summary: Student project titled SPINE V2 (version 2), described in a downloadable proposal document.

projects.title: SailMAV Student Proposal
projects.summary: Student project proposal on a sailing micro air vehicle (SailMAV) concept. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: EPFL Student Project Proposal AM
projects.summary: Student project proposal on an aerial multirotor (AM) topic. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: Aerial Underwater Module Quagga Mussel
projects.summary: Student project on an aerial-underwater module, with a quagga mussel theme. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: Biodegradable Motor
projects.summary: Student project on developing a biodegradable motor for robotic applications. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: Mushroom Drone
projects.summary: Student project on a drone built around or incorporating mushroom-based materials. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: Plant Robot
projects.summary: Student project on a robot that integrates living plants. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: Biodegradable Communication Device
projects.summary: Student project on a biodegradable communication device for robotic or environmental use. Details are in the downloadable proposal.

projects.title: Cephalopod-inspired aerial manipulator for sampling fragile ecological specimens
projects.summary: The project aims to break down the tentacular strike of cephalopods and use it to design, manufacture and characterise a fast, compliant, bio-inspired aerial manipulator. The manipulator is intended to retrieve fragile ecological samples from forest canopies, and could later serve as a basis for controller and trajectory planning work.

projects.title: Biodegradable rotary motors for eco-friendly transient drones
projects.summary: The project aims to develop a fully biodegradable DC motor for transient drones, including biodegradable conductive wire coatings, biodegradable magnetic materials, and motor design. The goal is to integrate the biodegradable motor with a biodegradable drone frame into an aerial robotic platform.

projects.title: Mushroom drones for environmental exploration
projects.summary: Develop mycelium-woodchip bio-hybrid composites and optimise their mechanical properties and biodegradability. The work aims to build a transient drone platform for environmental monitoring, with electrode-integrated composites for sensing external stimuli.
skills: laboratory work with fungi and composites

projects.title: Plant grippers for non-invasive environmental exploration robotics
projects.summary: The project develops plant-based hybrid grippers using carnivorous plant structures such as the Venus flytrap and sundew, studying their structure, stimulus-response and adhesion properties. The goal is to integrate these grippers with drone platforms for low-damage collection of insects and micro-organisms.

projects.title: Biodegradable wireless communication device for environmental monitoring
projects.summary: Develop a chipless wireless environmental monitoring platform that combines biodegradable sensors, batteries, antennas and oscillators. The goal is to generate electromagnetic signals with a Colpitts oscillator whose frequency encodes sensor readings, and to progressively replace conventional components with biodegradable materials.

projects.title: Design of a Aerial-Deployed Fin-Powered Underwater Module for Quagga Mussel Monitoring
projects.summary: Design of a biomimetic, fin-powered underwater sensing module deployed by drone, intended for monitoring invasive quagga and zebra mussels in freshwater systems. The work covers system development, hydrodynamic optimisation, camera-based mussel detection and field testing.

projects.title: A Modular Snap-Fit Electromagnetic Hinge for Undulatory / Jellyfish Robots
projects.summary: Develop bio-inspired underwater robots that combine a low-frequency electromagnetic flapping fin with undulatory (fish-like) swimming and jellyfish-like pulsing locomotion, targeting multi-modal locomotion for confined and extreme environments. The work covers literature review, mechanical design and simulation, prototyping, water-tank testing and efficiency analysis.

projects.title: Design and Autonomous Control of a Flying-Sailing Robot (SailMAV)
projects.summary: Improve the SailMAV hybrid micro aerial vehicle, which can fly, land on water, sail autonomously and take off again, through aerodynamic and mechanical design optimisation, autopilot development with PX4 or ArduPilot, simulation, and outdoor validation.

projects.title: Learning-Based Control of a Hybrid Aerial-Aquatic Multirotor
projects.summary: Replace the cascaded flight controller of a quadrotor with a deep reinforcement learning controller that tracks waypoints both in air and underwater. The work includes building a waterproof drone, extending a GPU-accelerated simulator with aquatic dynamics, and transferring the learned policy to hardware in a pool-equipped arena, compared against PID and model-reference adaptive controllers.

projects.title: Design and Characterisation of a Lightweight Air-Assisted Impinging Nozzle for Aerial Polyurethane Foam Deposition
projects.summary: Design, build and characterise a lightweight impinging-jet mixing nozzle for two-component polyurethane foam deposition from aerial robots. The work covers analytical sizing, manufacturing of nozzle variants, bench mixing-quality tests and vertical thin-layer deposition trials.

projects.title: Model Predictive Control for Tooltip Stabilisation of a Coaxial Tricopter with a 6 DoF Stewart Parallel Manipulator
projects.summary: Develop a model predictive controller that stabilises the tool tip of a coaxial tricopter carrying a six-degree-of-freedom Stewart platform end effector, predicting the airframe's disturbance motion over the control loop latency and respecting platform joint limits and singularities. The work includes extending the Gazebo/PX4 simulation, validating in simulation and on hardware, and comparing against the existing kinematic baseline.

projects.title: Hydrometeor classification with lidars and ceilometers
projects.summary: Master project on classifying hydrometeors from lidar and ceilometer observations, in collaboration with MeteoSwiss in Payerne.

projects.title: Stratus detection over the Swiss plateau
projects.summary: Master project on detecting stratus clouds over the Swiss plateau, in collaboration with MeteoSwiss in Payerne.

projects.title: Damages related to extreme precipitation in urban environment
projects.summary: Semester project on damages caused by extreme precipitation in urban environments.

projects.title: Evaluation of the global LMDZ model for the simulation of clouds and precipitation microphysics in Antarctica
projects.summary: Semester project evaluating the global LMDZ model's simulation of clouds and precipitation microphysics in Antarctica. The page notes it could be modified into a master project.

projects.title: Hands4Health
projects.summary: A semester project proposal from LTQE titled Hands4Health, with health as its apparent focus. The page gives no further detail.

projects.title: Hands4Health – Reaction kinetics between chlorine and amides in reused handwashing water
projects.summary: Study the reaction kinetics between chlorine and amides at different pH values and temperatures to support chlorine dosing in reused handwashing water for stand-alone handwashing systems used in low- and middle-income countries.
supervisors: the postdoc working on this topic

projects.title: Concept-Based Representations in Pretrained Vision Models: Concept Bottlenecks vs. Sparse Autoencoders
projects.summary: Compares concept bottleneck models, sparse autoencoders and hybrids of the two for learning concept-oriented representations in pretrained vision models. The project assesses interpretability, disentanglement, information leakage and downstream usefulness.

projects.title: Reading Inner Experience through Art Brut
projects.summary: Applies deep learning and computer vision to digitised Art Brut collections to extract and cluster recurrent visual patterns across diagnoses and artists. The aim is to find cognitive signatures linked to mental disorders, in collaboration with experts in art history and symbolism.

projects.title: Generative Models for Molecular Structure Identification from Mass Spectra
projects.summary: Develops machine learning methods to link tandem mass spectra to molecular structures, using self-supervised spectrum models and generative models of molecular graphs. Possible directions include conditional graph generation, foundation models for spectra, combinatorial optimization over molecules and uncertainty quantification.

projects.title: Mechanistic Analysis of Looped Diffusion Language Models
projects.summary: Studies and compares the internal dynamics of standard masked diffusion language models and looped/recursive variants using logit lens, tuned lens and Jacobian lens interpretability tools. The goal is to understand how predictions form across layers, loops and denoising steps.

projects.title: Graph Diffusion with Joint Node-Edge Constraints
projects.summary: Aims to develop a graph diffusion method that enforces joint node and edge constraints during generation, for example validity constraints in molecular design. The project targets improved state-of-the-art performance on real-world graph generation tasks.

projects.title: Low-Rank Edge Representations for Scalable Graph Transformers
projects.summary: Proposes replacing dense edge-state matrices in graph diffusion transformers with low-rank representations to reduce memory cost. The project quantifies the expressivity of low-rank edges and tests their implementation on benchmarks, including large graphs.

projects.title: Optimal Transport-Based Construction of Challenging Train/Test Splits
projects.summary: Develops optimisation-based methods that build train/test splits maximising the optimal transport discrepancy between training and test sets, to reveal distribution shifts. The project involves designing scalable algorithms that accommodate different transport costs and experiments on real datasets.

projects.title: Neural ODE Learning of Latent Graph Trajectories for Temporal Data
projects.summary: Investigates how a Neural ODE formulation can learn latent graph trajectories for temporal graph data, separating spatial and temporal updates. The aim is interpretable flow fields and learning in data-scarce settings.

projects.title: Topoformer: A Spatial-Informed Foundation Model for Spatial-Biology
projects.summary: Builds a foundation model for spatial biology that turns tissue imaging data into spatial tokens using topological data analysis, then trains transformers with self-supervised pretraining on large public cohorts. Target tasks include patient stratification, survival prediction and biomarker discovery.

projects.title: Robust Automatic Pathological Speech Detection
projects.summary: Develops robust deep learning approaches for automatic pathological speech detection that withstand recording artifacts and spurious correlations in training data. The goal is to support clinical auditory-perceptual assessment of speech disorders.

projects.title: Physics-Informed Graph Neural Networks for High-Resolution Mesh-Based Simulations
projects.summary: Explores physics-informed graph neural networks that learn coarser-mesh surrogate dynamics and hierarchical multi-scale models for high-resolution mesh-based simulations. The initial testbed is wind-tunnel dynamics.

projects.title: Graph Latent Diffusion Models
projects.summary: Aims to develop graph-specific latent diffusion models that run the diffusion process in a smaller latent space, so that large graphs can be generated efficiently. The approach is inspired by latent diffusion for image generation.

projects.title: Scalable Graph Generation via Link Prediction
projects.summary: Aims to make graph generation scalable by replacing quadratic edge prediction with message-passing and link prediction modules, reproducing SparseDiff results and matching transformer performance. Exploring other scalable methods such as latent diffusion is also encouraged.

projects.title: Synthetic Stroke Lesion Simulation and Deep Learning Segmentation Using HCP Data
projects.summary: Develop a simulation framework that creates synthetic acute ischemic stroke lesions on high-quality HCP diffusion and structural MRI, then train a deep segmentation network on this simulated data. The trained model is to be evaluated on real stroke images from open clinical datasets such as ISLES and on CHUV prototypes.

projects.title: Deep Neural Network uncertainty quantification: beyond Deep Ensemble
projects.summary: Survey whether the reconstruction quality and uncertainty estimates of a deep ensemble can be obtained at lower cost with a single network or modified architecture. Three directions are compared: input perturbation, weight perturbation (e.g. Laplace-style approximation), and Bayesian neural network architectures.

projects.title: Physics-Informed Learning for Sparse Measurement Selection in Diffusion MRI Protocol Design
projects.summary: Learn a compact subset of diffusion MRI measurements from a larger candidate set that remains informative for estimating white matter model parameters. Selection is guided by physics-informed criteria such as Fisher information, and the learned protocol is compared with baseline strategies using simulations.

projects.title: Development of a pre-processing pipeline for diffusion-weighted MRI data followed by the implementation of a deep-learning-based automatic lymph-node segmentation tool
projects.summary: Consolidate and extend a body DW-MRI preprocessing pipeline with quality control and noise estimation, add non-rigid co-registration across shells and protocols, and build a deep-learning tool that automatically segments lymph nodes. The work includes a comparison of supervised, transfer-learning and self-/unsupervised strategies given limited ground truth.

projects.title: Wavefield Extrapolation in Polar Coordinates for Ultrasound Imaging in Heterogeneous Media
projects.summary: Derive and implement a paraxial approximation of the 2D Helmholtz equation in polar coordinates to extrapolate acoustic wavefields for smoothly varying sound-speed media, as needed for curved ultrasound arrays. The solver is to be validated on simulated ultrasound data and benchmarked for accuracy, stability and speed.

projects.title: Data-driven wave propagation modeling for ultrasound imaging
projects.summary: Build a data-driven proxy for the wave propagation operator directly from recorded ultrasound signals, bypassing full-wave simulations. The resulting low-dimensional model is to be compared with model-based wavefields across media of varying complexity.

projects.title: Project at CHUV – Mapping functional connectivity in callosal dysgenesis
projects.summary: Analyse ADC-fMRI data from a cohort of children with callosal dysgenesis, from diffusion MRI time-series preprocessing to group comparisons of brain activity and functional connectivity. The project is carried out in the Radiology Research Unit of CHUV with a start in Fall 2026.

projects.title: Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning with History-dependent Rewards for Cooperative Multi-UAV Traffic Monitoring
projects.summary: A drone fleet must coordinate its trajectories over a road network to prioritise important roads, under a history-dependent reward. The project investigates decentralised recurrent policies that use each drone's local observation history.

projects.title: Can Vehicle Composition Predict Urban Congestion? Analysis of traffic dynamics using large-scale vehicle trajectories collected from a swarm of drones
projects.summary: The project studies how the mix of vehicle types (cars, motorcycles, buses, trucks) affects the formation and recovery of urban congestion, using drone-extracted vehicle trajectories.

projects.title: A Macroscopic Approach to Managing Prioritized Low-Altitude Aircraft Transport Systems
projects.summary: The project models low-altitude aircraft transport systems within the macroscopic fundamental diagram framework and designs boundary control and departure management strategies that prioritise certain aircraft and separate airspace.

projects.title: Adaptive Drone Sensing for Max-Pressure Traffic Signal Control
projects.summary: The project develops strategies for a limited drone fleet to dynamically choose which intersections to observe for Max-Pressure signal control, comparing them with fixed sensing configurations.

projects.title: Estimating Macroscopic Traffic Conditions from Sparse Drone Observations
projects.summary: The project investigates whether sparse drone observations can estimate regional traffic states, such as vehicle counts and flows for perimeter control, using simple estimation and machine learning methods.

projects.title: Coordination and Efficiency in Persistent Multi-UAV Monitoring
projects.summary: The project studies how multiple UAVs in a grid environment should coordinate to keep information fresh across an area, using control, heuristic or reinforcement learning approaches compared in simulation.

projects.title: Probabilistic Traffic Data Learning with Diffusion Models
projects.summary: The project applies denoising diffusion models to traffic forecasting to produce probabilistic predictions, starting from related work and transferring it to METR-LA and PEMS-Bay, with possible extension to missing-data imputation.

projects.title: Pretraining Traffic Forecasting Models
projects.summary: The project explores masked-autoencoder-style pretraining of traffic prediction models to improve generalisation across cities, then fine-tunes the pretrained model on a new urban traffic dataset.

projects.title: Low-Altitude Air City Transport (LAAT) systems
projects.summary: The project evaluates the artificial potential field collision avoidance used in a multi-drone simulator and develops and compares provably safe collision avoidance methods, to improve the accuracy of the LAAT macroscopic fundamental diagram.

projects.title: Parking Availability Monitoring Using Drone Video Analytics
projects.summary: The project builds a parking occupancy estimation pipeline from drone-captured aerial videos, with a dashboard for real-time and predictive parking indicators and a demand case study.

projects.title: Coordinated UAV Planning for Urban Delivery and Surveillance
projects.summary: The project designs a decision-making algorithm for UAVs that balances parcel delivery with road surveillance on a graph-based road network where road importance evolves with visits.

projects.title: On Gaussian Process Dual Control for Multi-Agent Patrolling
projects.summary: The project explores modelling the temporal evolution of congestion with a Gaussian process and formulating a dual control problem to drive adaptive patrolling by a drone fleet.

projects.title: Deep Recurrent Q-Learning for Multi-Agent Patrolling
projects.summary: The project investigates deep recurrent Q-learning to train a fleet of patrolling agents that monitor congestion in a simplified 2D grid city environment.

projects.title: Road and occlusion segmentation from drone video
projects.summary: The project segments roads and occlusions (buildings, trees) in drone videos, using a segmentation model such as SAM, to support occlusion-aware vehicle detection.

projects.title: On-demand Service Integration and Coordination with Bus Schedule Operation
projects.summary: The project develops an optimisation framework that improves on-demand vehicle-to-passenger assignment using historical bus data, so that on-demand micro-transit supports fixed-schedule bus operations.

projects.title: Multispecies Traffic as Directed Percolation
projects.summary: The project uses simulation to study multispecies traffic, where two-wheelers percolate through car traffic, as a directed percolation phase transition and its critical exponents.

projects.title: On Dual Control For Traffic Monitoring With a Fleet of Drones
projects.summary: The project designs and tests a multi-agent probabilistic optimal search framework based on dual control for exploration and exploitation, to localise congestion epicentres with a drone fleet using Bayesian inference.

projects.title: Optimizing Fleet Operation using Potential Field-Based Algorithm
projects.summary: The project develops a potential-field algorithm that rebalances empty vehicles in autonomous mobility-on-demand systems, using attractive potentials towards demand and repulsive potentials to avoid clustering.

projects.title: Optimizing drone delivery using bus networks
projects.summary: The project develops an optimisation framework in which drones ride buses with set stops and schedules to reduce total flying distance, and compares service levels with a no-bus scenario.

projects.title: Estimating the impact of pick-up and drop-off behaviors of ride-hailing vehicles on bus services
projects.summary: The project models the interaction between ride-hailing pick-up and drop-off at curbsides and bus services, using microscopic traffic simulation or an analytical approach.

projects.title: Operation of ride-sourcing as a first-mile feeder for public transit
projects.summary: The project models ride-pooling as a first-mile service complementing public transit in a simplified network with spatial restrictions on ride-sourcing access, and evaluates performance across operational scenarios.

projects.title: Auditory distance perception with hearing aids
projects.summary: Evaluate how hearing-aid processing affects the ability of hearing-impaired listeners to perceive sound source distance. The project includes building a listening-test facility with a motorised rail-mounted loudspeaker, then running listening tests with normal-hearing and hearing-impaired participants.

projects.title: Active wind instrument with electroacoustic absorbers
projects.summary: Develop a scaled prototype of an active wind instrument: a cylindrical duct surrounded by a ring of active electroacoustic absorbers that alter its acoustic impedance and timbre. The work includes FEM simulations, prototype fabrication and acoustic assessment.

projects.title: Micro-particle design for acoustically driven propulsion
projects.summary: Design and fabricate micro-particles of varying geometry by two-photon lithography, actuate them on a surface acoustic wave platform, and track their motion to understand how shape governs acoustically driven propulsion toward micro-robots.

projects.title: Omnidirectional corona discharge loudspeaker (pulsating sphere)
projects.summary: Identify and implement a purely omnidirectional corona discharge loudspeaker configuration approximating the ideal pulsating sphere. The project combines COMSOL or analytical modelling for geometry optimisation with prototype construction and anechoic tests.

projects.title: Electrodynamic matched source with active control
projects.summary: Realise an acoustic matched source by active feedback control of a closed-box loudspeaker so that its impedance is matched to the incident field, then extend it to broadband matching with a corona discharge actuator. The work combines numerical simulation and impedance-tube measurements.

projects.title: Self-adjustable electroacoustic absorber
projects.summary: Make a fixed electroacoustic absorber adaptive by developing signal-processing techniques that self-adjust its control parameters to unknown or time-varying environmental conditions, and validate it in an impedance tube.

projects.title: Stand-alone real-time controller for electroacoustic resonators
projects.summary: Develop a light, mobile, stand-alone real-time controller that replaces the laboratory-grade Speedgoat hardware for electroacoustic resonators, and apply it to damping ventilation noise in a cooktop hood.

projects.title: Educational acoustic metacrystal interface
projects.summary: Replicate the existing acoustic metacrystal prototype and develop a user-friendly interface that changes its control parameters on the fly and performs acoustic measurements, as an educational tool to teach quantum physics concepts.

projects.title: Dual corona discharge transducer for controllable directivity
projects.summary: Investigate achievable directivities of a dual corona discharge transducer made of two independently driven units, first by COMSOL simulation and then with an experimental prototype tested in anechoic conditions.

projects.title: Band-pass corona discharge loudspeaker for sound radiation
projects.summary: Identify corona discharge loudspeaker configurations with a band-pass response over a wide audible band and improved radiated sound power, using COMSOL or analytical modelling followed by prototype measurements in anechoic conditions.

projects.title: Corona discharge based active acoustic metasurface in reflection
projects.summary: Develop a unit cell of a plasmacoustic metalayer in reflection and assess how sound reflection amplitude and phase can be controlled, with the aim of building an active metasurface that steers reflected wavefronts in anomalous directions.

projects.title: Silicon photonics and TFLN neural-network building blocks with ML-driven design
projects.summary: Design and simulate photonic neural-network building blocks in silicon photonics and thin-film lithium niobate using Flexcompute workflows, developing an ML-driven agent that optimises components such as waveguides, couplers, and Mach-Zehnder interferometers for a photonic AI accelerator.

projects.title: Plasmacoustic metalayer for subwoofer enclosures
projects.summary: Use a plasmacoustic metalayer, a thin ionised-air layer controlled by electric fields, to absorb low-frequency sound in loudspeaker cabinets, with COMSOL design, a small Speedgoat-controlled prototype, impedance-tube tests and subwoofer tests.

projects.title: Fully open corona discharge headphone
projects.summary: Simulate and implement a fully open, membrane-free corona discharge headphone to avoid the occlusion effect, then test it on an artificial ear facility while managing sound leakage.

projects.title: Acoustic levitation and micromanipulation
projects.summary: Explore acoustic levitation with a 20 kHz ultrasonic source by characterising the field, analysing radiation forces with nonlinear acoustics, adding side transducers to trap particles, and applying wavefront shaping in scattering environments.

projects.title: Quantum gate implementation with classical waves
projects.summary: Implement basic quantum computing gates, such as CNOT and Hadamard, using classical acoustic or electronic signals on a prototype analog electronic platform.

projects.title: Composition and function of crysphere microbiomes
projects.summary: Bioinformatic project analysing in-house and publicly available metagenomes to determine the taxonomic composition and functions of cryosphere microbiomes and identify global genomic features. It is followed by a meta-analysis to find trends and patterns across different cryosphere environments.

projects.title: Molecular adaptation strategies of alpine snow microorganisms to warming
projects.summary: Laboratory-based project in which alpine snow microbes are isolated and characterised genomically for their metabolic potential in cold and warming adaptation. Isolates are cultivated at a range of temperatures and their RNA/proteins analysed to identify molecular changes and assess the thermal tolerance of cryospheric microorganisms. A bioinformatic component is included, and optional fieldwork is possible.

projects.title: Composition and function of crysphere microbiomes
projects.summary: Analysis of in-house and publicly available metagenomes to determine the taxonomic composition and functions of cryosphere microbiomes and identify global genomic features. A meta-analysis would then look for trends and emergent patterns across different cryosphere environments.

projects.title: Molecular adaptation strategies of alpine snow microorganisms to warming
projects.summary: Isolation of alpine snow microorganisms followed by genomic analysis of their metabolic potential for cold and warming adaptation. Cultivation at a range of temperatures and RNA/protein analysis would reveal molecular changes triggered by temperature and assess the thermal tolerance of cryospheric microorganisms; optional field work is possible.

projects.title: Alpine microbiome under pressure: Investigating the microbial community and its response to climate change.
projects.summary: Combined dry- and wet-lab project studying the microbial community of barren alpine mountain tops with seasonal snow cover at almost 3000 m, using metagenomics and proteomics. The work couples microbial community data with greenhouse gas emission monitoring at a field site in Crans-Montana, with periodic field visits and laboratory work in Sion.

projects.title: Electromagnetic Evaluations
projects.summary: Electromagnetic evaluation of antenna or microwave structures.

projects.title: Field-reconstruction Circuit (FRC)
projects.summary: Work on a field-reconstruction circuit (FRC) for microwave field measurements.

projects.title: Loss study of the directive implanted antenna
projects.summary: Study of losses in a directive antenna intended for implantation in the body.

projects.title: Metasurface based biosensor
projects.summary: Design of a biosensor based on metasurfaces.

projects.title: Patch Antennas for body-area Networks
projects.summary: Patch antenna design for wireless body-area networks.

projects.title: Understanding When Radiation Occurs: The Role of Discontinuities
projects.summary: Study of how electromagnetic radiation arises from discontinuities in structures.

projects.title: Design of an implantable Huygens source antenna
projects.summary: Design of an implantable Huygens source antenna.

projects.title: Electromagnetic Evaluations
projects.summary: Electromagnetic evaluation of antenna or microwave structures.

projects.title: RFID tags for Living Cell Identification
projects.summary: RFID tags designed to identify living cells.

projects.title: Electromagnetic Evaluations
projects.summary: Electromagnetic evaluation of antenna or microwave structures.

projects.title: RFID tags for Living Cell Identification
projects.summary: RFID tags designed to identify living cells.

projects.title: USB 3.2 Push-pull connector
projects.summary: Study of a USB 3.2 push-pull connector design.

projects.title: Open stop band suppression technique benchmarking
projects.summary: Benchmarking of techniques for suppressing open stop bands.

projects.title: 8-blade EM-field sensor
projects.summary: Design of an eight-blade electromagnetic field sensor.

projects.title: USB 3.2 Push-Pull Connector
projects.summary: Design a new push-pull connector that can carry USB 3.2 signals, integrated in a 9 mm or 11 mm diameter push-pull system and withstanding 100 W. The student reviews the frequency limits of existing connectors, proposes a new design by numerical simulation, and may build and characterize prototypes at LEMO if time permits.

projects.title: Open stop band suppression technique benchmarking
projects.summary: Benchmark and categorize the available open stopband mitigation strategies for one-dimensional leaky-wave antennas, comparing their advantages and drawbacks through study, simulation, analytical modelling and, if time permits, fabrication and measurement.

projects.title: Design of an implanted Huygens source antenna
projects.summary: Design an implanted Huygens source antenna combining the TE10 and TM10 spherical modes to maximise power radiated from a deep implant into free space. The work includes simulation, and fabrication and measurement if time permits.

projects.title: Loss study of the directive implanted antenna
projects.summary: Study the losses of a practical directive implanted antenna (e.g. a patch embedded in biological tissue) by simulation and measurements, examining how encapsulation size, implant depth and frequency affect gain, and optimise the gain.

projects.title: Electromagnetic evaluations
projects.summary: Visualise and evaluate electromagnetic quantities of electromagnetic sources using multipole field expansions, with a focus on sources below an electrical size of 0.3. The student implements the multipole expressions in MATLAB, studies power densities, loss mechanisms and stored energies, and compares the analytical results with HFSS and FEKO simulations of explicit antennas.

projects.title: Pathway toward optimized life-cycle management of glass in the construction sector
projects.summary: Investigates glass products, framing systems, flat glass and glass wool used in buildings, reviewing current production, material selection, use and end-of-life practices. The goal is to identify circular economy and material recovery strategies and develop alternative variants, assessed with a bottom-up life-cycle assessment. The project is part of a collaboration with the Canton of Zurich.

projects.title: Bio-inspired construction materials
projects.summary: Explores how biological structures and mechanisms can inspire next-generation natural materials and interfaces for sustainable construction. The student will experiment with material formulations, digital fabrication, re-assembly and characterisation to obtain materials with tailored functional properties.

projects.title: Assessment and adaptation of building components for extended service lifetimes
projects.summary: Extends a digital method for assessing the environmental reclamation potential of building elements to support reuse and recycling. Possible directions include disassembly sequencing with interface inventories and knowledge graphs, impact analysis of material value chains, deterioration mechanisms of building envelopes, and non-destructive test protocols.

projects.title: Reversible interfaces for sustainable construction
projects.summary: Researches reversible adhesion for multi-material building components to enable reuse, covering bi-material compatibility, joint geometry optimisation, fabrication and disassembly on demand. The student may study separation of existing composite elements or develop new connection methods.

projects.title: Type VII Secretion Systems in Mycobacteria
projects.summary: Master's research and thesis projects on the mechanisms of Type VII Secretion Systems in Mycobacteria. The page indicates both computational/bioinformatics and wet-lab options.

projects.title: Macrophage killing by mycobacteria
projects.summary: Master's research and thesis projects on macrophage killing, offered as both computational/bioinformatics and wet-lab projects. The work is linked to the mechanisms of Type VII Secretion Systems in Mycobacteria.

projects.title: Mechanics of Disordered Network Structures
projects.summary: Investigate structure-property relationships in disordered two-dimensional networks by building a numerical simulation framework that analyses linear and non-linear responses across network topology, pre-stress levels and bond properties. The student contributes to in-house simulation code.

projects.title: Non-equilibrium Dynamics in Biological Tissues
projects.summary: Study the emergent non-equilibrium dynamics of biological tissues under different types and magnitudes of active fluctuations, such as junctional tension and cell crawling. The student implements active processes in the Active Foam Model and focuses on phenomena such as cell sorting, wound healing or collective cell dynamics.

projects.title: Twitching Motility of Bacterial Locomotion
projects.summary: Understand how the dynamics of pili in a single bacterial cell (Pseudomonas aeruginosa) produce distinct locomotion patterns. The student develops a numerical framework covering pili extrusion rate, attachment rate and pulling force, which may be extended to pattern formation in bacterial aggregates.

projects.title: Searching for Ground States of Disordered Particle Packings
projects.summary: Develop annealing algorithms to find low-energy, ideally ground-state, configurations of disordered particle packings, combining a physics-based structure-energy approach with a machine-learning approach. The student runs particle packing simulations to build datasets and trains an in-house AI model to guide the search.

projects.title: Engineering environmental microbiomes via selective ion transport
projects.summary: Project on engineering environmental microbial communities by controlling selective ion transport. The page gives no further detail.

projects.title: Exploring Predictive Models and Machine Learning for Microbial Communities in Anaerobic Digesters
projects.summary: Project on using predictive models and machine learning to study microbial communities in anaerobic digesters. The page gives no further detail.

projects.title: Enrichment and isolation of fermenter bacteria from anaerobic digestion
projects.summary: Project on enriching and isolating fermentative bacteria from anaerobic digestion processes. The page gives no further detail.

projects.title: Investigating the physiology of CO2-reducing microbes for carbon-neutral, renewable chemical synthesis
projects.summary: Project on the physiology of CO2-reducing microbes with the aim of carbon-neutral, renewable chemical synthesis. The page gives no further detail.

projects.title: Isolation of methane-oxidizing bacteria for greenhouse gas removal
projects.summary: Project on isolating methane-oxidizing bacteria for use in removing greenhouse gases. The page gives no further detail.

projects.title: Endovascular neural probes for minimally invasive brain recording
projects.summary: Development and experimental validation of ultra-flexible endovascular neural probes that record neural signals from deep brain regions through blood vessels, mainly targeting epilepsy. Work can cover microfabrication, device assembly, phantom testing, computer vision tracking, and signal processing.

projects.title: Development of a Fluid-jet-based Gripper
projects.summary: Design, manufacture, and experimental characterisation of a miniaturised fluid-jet gripper that uses high-speed airflow through a nozzle or funnel to generate controllable gripping forces for delicate objects. The project studies how nozzle geometry and operating conditions affect gripping performance.

projects.title: Design improvements and characterisation of an Omnidirectional Magnetic Actuation System
projects.summary: Improve the hardware design of the rotating permanent-magnet end effector of the OmniMag magnetic actuation system, then characterise the improved system in terms of magnetic field control, precision, and responsiveness.

projects.title: Design and developpment of an in vitro phantom for local biomarker sampling
projects.summary: Design, build, and test a laboratory setup mimicking blood flow through a network of small branching veins, to study how flow, mixing, catheter position, and sampling speed affect locating a local source of hormone production (adrenal venous sampling).

projects.title: Design Optimization of Acoustic Actuators
projects.summary: Develop a design and manufacturing framework for acoustic actuators, combining theoretical analysis and computational simulations of coupled mechanical vibrations, fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, and acoustics.

projects.title: 3D Printing of Flexible Microstructures for Acoustic Microrobots
projects.summary: Cleanroom fabrication of acoustically responsive flexible microstructures, followed by testing them on the lab's acoustic actuation platform to study how fabrication parameters and geometry affect their dynamic response.

projects.title: Optimization of MEMS Pressure Sensors for Endovascular Applications
projects.summary: Optimise the design of MEMS pressure sensors integrated in endovascular guidewires to improve sensitivity and reliability for coronary artery disease diagnosis, using cleanroom fabrication and rigorous characterisation.

projects.title: Microfabrication of endovascular microcatheters
projects.summary: Design and fabricate ultra-miniaturised, highly flexible microcatheters able to navigate microscopic brain vessels, followed by mechanical and functional characterisation and in vitro testing.

projects.title: Development of an In-vitro Fluidic Test Platform for Endovascular Instruments
projects.summary: Hands-on assembly and calibration of an in-vitro fluidic test platform that simulates coronary artery conditions, including phantom fabrication, flow and pressure control systems, and sensor integration, for evaluating endovascular sensors.

projects.title: Contrastive latent alignment for multimodal reasoning
projects.summary: Explore a contrastive latent alignment process that enforces cross-modal and preference alignment within continuous latent reasoning paths, so that conflicting multimodal inputs (e.g. visual hallucinations contradicting audio or text) produce consistent hidden representations. The approach may combine cross-modal contrastive trajectory optimization with direct preference alignment over continuous latent manifolds.

projects.title: Locating and ablating circuit-level private attribute sub-networks
projects.summary: Use activation-space dictionary learning to map the circuits of AI models that encode specific private attributes (PII), then ablate or orthogonalize those latent directions. The goal is to remove PII from models without retraining or fine-tuning, while preserving zero-shot task performance.

projects.title: Continuous latent flow matching for multimodal spatial reasoning
projects.summary: Develop a single-step continuous latent flow architecture that replaces iterative chain-of-thought generation in Vision-Language-Action models with a vector-field mapping from video, audio and language instructions to latent action-reasoning representations. The aim is accurate spatial problem-solving in a single forward pass.

projects.title: Alignment-based conformance checking
