projects.summary: Build a neuro-symbolic conformance checking framework that translates natural-language regulatory articles (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR) into linear temporal logic specifications and evaluates them on execution traces of multi-agent workflows. The framework should detect and explain compliance risks or failures in a transparent way.

projects.title: Visual stream parsing for compliance auditing
projects.summary: Design a dynamic legal-visual concept engine that extends static concept probing to real-time video streams. The project fuses vision-language or audio-visual-language streaming transformers with ontology graph mapping to track entities, infer sensitive personal attributes and map scene semantics to legal frameworks.

projects.title: Voice anonymization with preservation of emotional prosody in multilingual settings
projects.summary: Design, implement and evaluate an AI-based acoustic transformation framework that masks speaker identity while preserving emotional prosody, semantic meaning and intelligibility. The focus is French, Italian or German (including Swiss German), with evaluation on real-world data and human participants in collaboration with RTS.

projects.title: Linguistic and stylometric style transfer for long-form speech anonymization
projects.summary: Use sequence-to-sequence style-transfer models to translate or obfuscate individual speaking styles, syntax, dialectal markers and phrasing habits in long-form recordings, so that speakers cannot be re-identified from linguistic cues. The focus is French, Italian or German (including Swiss German), with evaluation in collaboration with RTS.

projects.title: Privacy guarantees for speech anonymization
projects.summary: Build a framework that explicitly bounds and minimizes mutual information across acoustic, emotional and linguistic characteristics of speech, providing information-theoretic privacy guarantees against adaptive adversaries. Evaluation with human participants and real-world datasets is planned in collaboration with RTS.

projects.title: Analysing the Effect of Assistant Post-Training on Diversity and Sycophancy in Pedagogical LLMs
projects.summary: Studies how output diversity, sycophancy and safety change across the post-training stages (base, SFT, DPO, RLVR) of the Olmo 3 7B model when generating feedback on student work. The project aims to find internal features behind these behaviours and to test lightweight interventions, such as weight interpolation, feature steering or short LoRA fine-tuning, that yield diverse and honest feedback without losing safety.

projects.title: Robustness of LLM Reasoning Strategies for Educational Applications
projects.summary: Compares how different LLM reasoning strategies (e.g. linear, symbolic, reflective, iterative chain-of-thought) hold up under controlled perturbations in educational tasks such as misconception detection and educational content generation. The project measures accuracy, explanation consistency, error propagation and recovery, and the trade-off with computational cost.

projects.title: Mapping Failures of AI Agents on Educational Tasks
projects.summary: Analyses agent trajectories from dozens of interactions across six learning contexts, where agents understood educational contexts and modelled learner data. The goal is to map failures to generic agent-failure taxonomies, develop an education-specific coding scheme, and identify where these taxonomies need refinement.

projects.title: Do Questions Trigger Misconceptions? Measuring When Student Misconceptions Show Up
projects.summary: Uses existing Eedi diagnostic maths responses to measure the trigger strength of each question-misconception pair and tests whether high-trigger questions make students re-show a misconception more often. The project also compares the misconception rates of a persona-prompted open LLM simulator (e.g. Qwen3-8B) with those of real students.

projects.title: Data curation and curriculum learning for pre-training, theory and practice
projects.summary: Project within the Apertus LLM line on data curation and curriculum learning for LLM pre-training, combining theory and practice. Apply via the application form.

projects.title: Scaling to longer context windows through modifications of attention
projects.summary: Project on scaling LLMs to longer context windows by modifying the attention mechanism. Apply via the application form.

projects.title: Efficiency engineering for LLM pretraining and specifically MoE architectures
projects.summary: Project on improving the efficiency of LLM pre-training, with a focus on mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures. Apply via the application form.

projects.title: Tools-usage during pretraining & finetuning
projects.summary: Project on enabling LLMs to use tools during pre-training and fine-tuning. Apply via the application form.

projects.title: Safety and alignment during pretraining
projects.summary: Project on incorporating safety and alignment considerations into LLM pre-training. Apply via the application form.

projects.title: Novel architectures (including efficient long context or MoE related mechanisms)
projects.summary: Project on new LLM architectures, including efficient long-context and mixture-of-experts mechanisms. Apply via the application form.

projects.title: Optimization dynamics for LLMs (e.g. Muon and AdEMAmix variants, and interactions with architecture)
projects.summary: Project studying optimization dynamics of LLM training, such as Muon and AdEMAmix variants and their interaction with architecture. Apply via the application form.

projects.title: LLM inference on old V100 GPUs
projects.summary: Make recent large open-weight MoE models run efficiently on the EPFL cluster of V100 GPUs, using quantization, communication-efficient parallelism and inference frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang, and compare with newer GPUs. Apply via the application form.

projects.title: Communication-efficient gossip methods for replacing all-reduce in distributed LLM training
projects.summary: Replace all-to-all communication with decentralized pairwise weight averaging in distributed LLM pre-training, studying model and data parallelism settings and communication compression. Apply via the application form.

projects.title: AI safety evaluations feeding back into Apertus Posttraining
projects.summary: Incorporate findings from red-teaming studies, in collaboration with UN agencies such as UNICC, into the safety SFT and RL post-training recipes of the next Apertus generation. Apply via the application form.

projects.title: LLM Pretraining Data Curation
projects.summary: Advance pre-training data curation beyond baselines such as FineWeb-2 HQ using new signal extraction, semantic filtering and synthetic rephrasing, in English or multilingual settings, possibly studying data quality and the curse of multilinguality. Apply via the application form.

projects.title: Learning to sample on the fly for SGD / curriculum learning
projects.summary: Train an auxiliary network that scores training data points so that an improved subset can be selected during SGD training, as a form of curriculum learning. Contact via the application form.

projects.title: Improving factuality understanding for LLM training
projects.summary: Add a per-document factuality tag or masking to guide LLM training toward distinguishing factual from non-factual content, with the goal of reducing hallucinations; post-training techniques may also be explored. Apply via the application form.

projects.title: Build decentralized LLMs in the browser
projects.summary: Practical project within the larger DISCO team effort to build decentralized, federated training software in which many clients, such as phones or hospitals, collaboratively train models such as smaller LLMs while preserving data privacy. Students familiar with Rust (or willing to learn) are sought to integrate Burn within DISCO.

projects.title: Image compression for DNA based storage
projects.summary: Study state-of-the-art approaches for storing information in DNA and build an end-to-end image compression simulator for DNA storage based on publicly available implementations. The work includes analysing the simulator's performance.
skills: Basic knowledge of signal and image processing

projects.title: Deep learning for deepfake detection
projects.summary: Train convolutional neural networks in a supervised way to detect deepfake images and videos, using publicly available or generated deepfake datasets. The project also studies ensembling of the trained networks and assesses performance across several datasets.

projects.title: Mobile App for Privacy Protection on iOS or Android Platform
projects.summary: Develop a smartphone app that obfuscates personal visual information in images in a secure, recoverable way (e.g. scrambling), with multi-region selection by touch and a simple key management system. The app should also allow sharing images on online social networks securely.

projects.title: Reverse image search for media-context verification in multimodal fact-checking
projects.summary: Build a component that searches the Web for earlier appearances of a submitted image and recovers their date, location and event, to improve detection of out-of-context misinformation. The module will be connected to an existing fact-checking pipeline and evaluated on multimodal misinformation datasets.

projects.title: Representation and interpretation of a Factuality Trust Indicator in JPEG Trust
projects.summary: Define a prototype way to represent content-based factuality information in a JPEG Trust compatible manner, and implement tools to generate and read it. The work also builds Trust Profile examples combining factuality with provenance, authenticity or metadata.

projects.title: AI TOOLS – Understanding Learning Through Pipeline Transparency
projects.summary: Educational AI-tools project on how transparency of the machine learning pipeline helps people understand learning. Details are given in a downloadable project document.

projects.title: AI tools – Impact of glass-boxing the Machine Learning pipeline on learning
projects.summary: Study of how making the steps of the machine learning pipeline transparent (glass-boxing) affects learning. Details are given in a downloadable project document.

projects.title: Development of grading tool with GPT: Enhancing Efficiency and Consistency in Education
projects.summary: Develop an AI-driven grading tool that uses GPT models to grade student solutions, such as coding assignments and text-based responses, and compare GPT grading with existing human grading data to improve consistency and efficiency in education assessment.

projects.title: Enhancing Debugging Skills in Education: From Task Design to Learning Analytics
projects.summary: The project aims to design effective debugging tasks and assess debugging skills using tools such as Karel programming environments and paper-based assessments. The student would test tasks with the PISA network, design and run a study comparing them with interactive debugging tasks, and analyse users' action sequences with learning analytics and statistical methods.

projects.title: Unplugged AI Tools: Activities to Teach AI Concepts in School
projects.summary: Design, prototype and pilot unplugged (computer-free) activities that introduce foundational AI concepts to primary and middle school students. The work includes a literature review, activity design, teacher guides, and optional pilot testing with Swiss schools followed by iterative refinement.

projects.title: Weatherproof data logging system for honeybee colony metabolic investigation
projects.summary: Design and build a weatherproof data logging system that interfaces with robotic frames, an array of CO2 sensors and a local weather station, to study thermal and metabolic behaviour of honeybee colonies in box hives. A weather station and a bio-accepted CO2 sensor array will be developed and installed in a real setting.

projects.title: Robotic Sculptures for Education - Sthymuli: User experience programming and validation
projects.summary: Complete the development of the Sthymuli educational robot prototype by documenting it, redesigning its graphic interface and user experience, and evaluating it with the EPFL community and volunteer teachers. The result should be a functional upgraded robot, a set of modules, a web-based programming interface and a user guide.

projects.title: AI TOOLS | Impact of glass-boxing the Machine Learning pipeline on learning
projects.summary: Develop a custom web-based platform that teaches users to predict a dinosaur's diet from field notes using decision trees, and use it in a study comparing three transparency levels (glass box, gray box, black box). The study tests whether exposing data preparation steps or model logic improves understanding of machine learning.

projects.title: Understanding Learning Through Pipeline Transparency: A Thinking-Aloud Study of the Decision-Tree Transparency Platform
projects.summary: A qualitative thinking-aloud study on an existing web platform that compares three ML transparency conditions (glass box, gray box, black box) in a decision-tree task. The student designs the protocol, runs about 12 sessions, and performs thematic analysis of students' reasoning and misconceptions about the ML pipeline.

projects.title: Deep Learning Analysis of Human Histology Images
projects.summary: Semester project applying deep learning to analyse images of human histology tissue. Details are only given in the title on the listing.

projects.title: Latent space models for cyclic biomolecular processes and application to live microscopy imaging
projects.summary: Semester project developing latent space models for cyclic biomolecular processes, applied to live microscopy imaging data.

projects.title: Machine learning multiomics data to identify gene regulatory networks across time, sex and tissues
projects.summary: Semester project using machine learning on multiomics data to identify gene regulatory networks across time, sex and tissues.

projects.title: Circadian clocks in disease states and cancer
projects.summary: Semester project studying circadian clocks in disease states and cancer.

projects.title: Using math to infer network behavior
projects.summary: Infer network device behavior, such as consistent de-prioritization of certain traffic, using only external observations. The student would reconstruct the queuing delay process seen by a flow from the flow's own irregular observations.

projects.title: Testing a neutrality-detection tool
projects.summary: Final pre-deployment testing of a tool that localizes where Internet service providers throttle, block, or de-prioritize traffic. The student would run experiments on various networks, analyze the tool's accuracy and robustness, and suggest improvements.

projects.title: Quantum Emitters Coupled to Subwavelength Hyperbolic Phonon Polaritons
projects.summary: Simulate hyperbolic phonon polaritons in anisotropic nanophotonic structures and use the simulated fields to calculate how they modify a nearby quantum emitter, starting with the Purcell effect and possibly extending to coherent energy exchange and multi-emitter collective states.

projects.title: Self-Consistent Modeling of Coupled Maxwell Bloch Equations with the Finite Difference Time Domain Method
projects.summary: Extend the open-source FDTD software MEEP so that it integrates the Maxwell-Bloch equations, letting light and quantum emitters influence each other self-consistently, to study single and collective emitter dynamics in complex photonic environments.

projects.title: Monocrystalline silver flakes for applications in plasmonics
projects.summary: Develop a colloidal synthesis recipe for monocrystalline silver flakes, nanopattern them, and characterise them by SEM, optical microscopy and spectroscopy, combined with numerical simulations to optimise their dimensions for low-loss plasmonic systems.

projects.title: 3D visualization of the boundaries of the dielectrophoretic trapping volume
projects.summary: Explore the strength of dielectrophoretic forces and visualise in 3D the boundaries of the volume in which particles are trapped by dielectrophoresis, a technique used for micro-scale manipulation of particles.

projects.title: Monocrystalline silver flakes for applications in plasmonics
projects.summary: The project aims to develop a chemical synthesis procedure for large-aspect-ratio monocrystalline silver flakes and their nanopatterning, to build a low-loss plasmonic material platform. The student would characterise the nanostructures and compare them with numerical electromagnetic simulations.

projects.title: 3D visualization of the boundaries of the dielectrophoretic trapping volume
projects.summary: The project aims to visualize in 3D (tomography-like image stacks along z) the boundary where dielectrophoretic force falls below thermal Brownian randomization, to quantitatively estimate DEP force and particle polarizability. It uses microelectrode arrays with functionalized surfaces and dielectric layers of varying thickness, and compares results with numerical simulations.

projects.title: Self-Consistent Modeling of Coupled Maxwell-Bloch Equations with the Finite-Difference Time-Domain Method
projects.summary: Develop a self-consistent framework that extends the open-source MEEP FDTD software to integrate the Bloch equations with electromagnetic field evolution, enabling simulation of light-emitter interaction in nanophotonic environments. The work covers single and collective emitter dynamics, plasmonic resonances, and coherence phenomena.

projects.title: Quantum Emitters Coupled to Subwavelength Hyperbolic Phonon Polaritons
projects.summary: Investigate how quantum emitters interact with hyperbolic phonon polaritons in anisotropic nanophotonic structures such as hBN, using COMSOL simulations of polariton confinement combined with quantum-optical modelling of Purcell enhancement and collective emitter dynamics.

projects.title: Functionalized Graphene-Based Sensor Platform for Cortisol Detection
projects.summary: Develop an aptamer-functionalized graphene sensing platform for real-time cortisol detection, covering functionalization optimization, characterization (Raman, XPS, SPR, QCM, electrical measurements), and integration with hardware and software for monitoring. The page offers one master thesis and two semester projects, one on antibody functionalization and characterization, one on electrical evaluation and system integration.

projects.title: Electrically characterizing a 2D-based biosensor for health monitoring purposes
projects.summary: Electrically characterize a 2D-material-based biosensor for health monitoring, with a work split of about 10% theory, 20% fabrication and 70% characterization.

projects.title: Microfabrication of VO2 Microcantilevers/clamped-clamped beams
projects.summary: Microfabricate vanadium dioxide (VO2) MEMS microcantilevers and clamped-clamped beams with piezoelectric actuation to dynamically control the metal-insulator transition through strain, for strain-engineered sensors and adaptive electronic devices.

projects.title: Unlocking next-generation wearable protein biosensors
projects.summary: Improve the understanding and detection mechanisms of non-faradaic electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) biosensors for wearable protein sensing, combining literature review, equivalent-circuit modelling, cleanroom electrode fabrication and measurements with proteins.

projects.title: Development and Validation of an Optical Sensor for Non-Invasive In Vivo Biomarker Quantification
projects.summary: Develop and experimentally characterize an optical measurement system for non-invasive in vivo detection and quantification of a biomarker in biological tissues, in collaboration with Xsensio SA. The position is financially compensated.

projects.title: De Novo Computational Design of a Cardiac Troponin I–C Binder for Real-Time Label-Free Biosensing
projects.summary: Design de novo protein binders targeting the cardiac troponin I–C complex, then produce, validate (SPR) and immobilize them on electrodes for lock-in capacitive biosensing of this myocardial infarction biomarker.

projects.title: Piezoelectric MEMS for vibrations sensing
projects.summary: Develop a MEMS-based piezoelectric vibration sensor (vibrometer) as a miniaturized next-generation alternative to current aerospace sensors. The work covers analysis of transduction options, design, and fabrication in the EPFL CMi cleanroom.

projects.title: Micro-optomechanical systems for harsh environments
projects.summary: Design and fabricate micro-optomechanical resonators to be integrated into optical fibers as sensors that operate in harsh industrial conditions, with optical readout. The project is carried out with the startup Miraex and the master project is sponsored.

projects.title: Novel AFM Cantilever Design for Cell Growth measurements
projects.summary: Design, simulate, fabricate and characterize a new AFM cantilever compatible with Nanosurf equipment, to provide more stable measurements of cell growth. The project is done in collaboration with Nanosurf.

projects.title: Aluminum Scandium Nitride on Quartz piezoelectric resonators
projects.summary: Develop a reactive sputtering protocol to deposit high-quality aluminum nitride thin films on quartz, combining quartz's stability with the larger piezoelectric coefficient of the thin film. The project includes film characterization by SEM, XRD and stress measurements, in collaboration with Micro Crystal AG.

projects.title: PMUTs for acoustic spectroscopy
projects.summary: Design and fabricate piezoelectric micromachined ultrasound transducers (PMUTs) with integrated microfluidic channels to perform acoustic spectroscopy of biological samples flowing through the channels.

projects.title: Fabrication of glass suspended microchannel resonators
projects.summary: Fabricate suspended microchannel resonators (SMRs) in glass (SiO2) instead of silicon nitride, to improve calorimetry sensitivity thanks to glass's lower thermal conductivity. The work includes process adaptation in the cleanroom, electrode fabrication, and characterization.

projects.title: Development of a wafer-level packaging for vacuum encapsulation of microfluidic devices
projects.summary: Investigate and implement a wafer-level method to vacuum-encapsulate suspended microchannel resonators directly after fabrication, while still allowing fluidic delivery. The project includes a literature review, fabrication and characterization of a chosen packaging method, and experiments with packaged devices.

projects.title: Fabrication of microchannels with a two-photon-absorption-based 3D nano-printer
projects.summary: Optimize the fabrication of thin-walled microchannels with the Nanoscribe two-photon 3D nano-printer at CMi, and develop a process flow that releases suspended structures with a fluidic network. The project includes CAD design, SEM inspection and packaging for fluidic operation.

projects.title: Investigation of buried channels profile with respect to etching chemistries and silicon crystal orientation planes
projects.summary: Study the profile of microchannels etched directly into silicon as a function of etching chemistry and silicon crystal orientation. The project includes fabricating the channels and inspecting their cross-sections by SEM.

projects.title: FEM modelling of energy dissipation in Suspended Microchannel Resonators
projects.summary: Use COMSOL finite element modelling and literature review to study the energy dissipation of suspended microchannel resonators, including the effect of fluid viscosity and channel position. The project extends an existing model to high-viscosity fluids.

projects.title: Acoustic resonators for Intracellular tagging
projects.summary: Fabricate miniaturized LAMB wave resonators on thin-film lithium niobate to serve as wireless acoustic tags that can be internalized in cells to probe and track them in real time.

projects.title: SAW-based acoustic spectrometer
projects.summary: Design, simulate and fabricate a miniaturized surface acoustic wave platform with a microchannel for trapping cells and characterizing their elasticity, aiming at detecting cancerous cells.

projects.title: FEM simulations on resonator viscous damping in liquid environment
projects.summary: Use COMSOL simulations to study how viscous damping in liquids affects the quality factor of PAW resonators in biological media, and optimize the design to reduce fluid-induced losses.

projects.title: Angular dependence of Ion Beam etching rates for acoustic resonator fabrication
projects.summary: Characterize the angular dependence of ion beam etching rates for AlScN, LiNbO3 and SiO2 and develop a numerical model of the evolution of the etched profile, to optimize fabrication of piezoelectric resonators.

projects.title: Development of PZT Deposited by Pulsed Laser Deposition for NEMS
projects.summary: Study pulsed laser deposition of piezoelectric PZT thin films and contribute to their deposition and dry etching in the CMi cleanroom, to obtain high-quality layers for NEMS.

projects.title: Optimisation of III/V semiconductors Reactive-Ion Etching
projects.summary: Investigate etch rate, selectivity and sidewall verticality of AlN and AlScN on a more aggressive inductively coupled plasma etcher, to enable etching of scandium-alloyed aluminum nitride for RF filters.

projects.title: Ferroelectric properties of III-V semiconductors
projects.summary: Investigate the ferroelectric properties of high scandium-content AlScN thin films, including polarization and displacement curves, coercive field, and the effect of high-voltage poling on electrical and crystalline properties.

projects.title: Piezoelectric materials on superconductors for quantum acoustics
projects.summary: Explore sputtering of superconducting electrodes and piezoelectric thin films adapted to cryogenic conditions, for acoustic resonators coupled to superconducting qubits in quantum acoustics.

projects.title: PCB and circuit design for NEMS characterization
projects.summary: Design a circuit with background cancellation and/or impedance matching, and a PCB built with the Electronics Workshop, to measure NEMS devices. The project includes equivalent-circuit modelling of the matching and amplification stages.

projects.title: Study of linear coupling in NEMS
projects.summary: Analyze how the strength of linear mechanical coupling between adjacent NEMS resonators depends on the physical constraints acting on them, using simulations, fabrication of a set of devices, and characterization of frequencies, quality factors and coupling rates.

projects.title: Design of photonic integrated circuits with phase change materials
projects.summary: Contribute to the design of a multi-layer DUV stepper reticle for prototype photonic integrated circuits with phase change materials, and model thermal and optical behaviour of the components with COMSOL.

projects.title: A Cross-Species Meta-Analysis of Astrocyte Transcriptional Diversity in Development and Disease (Dry)
projects.summary: Systematic meta-analysis of astrocyte transcriptional states by integrating public single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq and multiomics datasets from mouse and human, covering development and neurological disease. The goal is a curated cross-species astrocyte atlas and insights into the determinants of astrocyte identity.

projects.title: Linking Neuronal Function to Molecular Identity in Mouse Barrel Cortex (Dry and Wet)
projects.summary: Combines in vivo two-photon calcium imaging with spatial transcriptomics (Direct HybISS) to relate the activity of neurons during behaviour to their molecular identity in adult mouse barrel cortex. The student contributes to a pipeline that registers the same neurons across functional imaging and post-mortem transcriptomics.

projects.title: Ex utero metabolic perturbation of the developing mouse brain
projects.summary: Uses ex utero mouse embryo culture to acutely perturb lipid metabolism during brain formation, then examines the effects with MALDI imaging mass spectrometry, spatial transcriptomics and confocal microscopy. The aim is to understand how lipid patterns shape neural identity.

projects.title: Biochemical Characterization of the Her1 Interactome via ScFv Pull-down
projects.summary: Develop a protocol to pull down Her1 proteins from zebrafish embryo lysates using three new ScFv antibody clones, with the aim of identifying Her1 protein partners, possibly followed by mass spectrometry.

projects.title: Combining Expansion Microscopy and In-situ Reverse Transcription in Zebrafish Embryos
projects.summary: Develop a hybrid protocol combining expansion microscopy with in-situ reverse transcription in zebrafish embryos to link super-resolution imaging with bulk sequencing data, and quantify nuclear protein distribution by FISH.

projects.title: Computational Analysis of Cell Morphology During Zebrafish Body Axis Segmentation
projects.summary: Use image analysis and machine learning on fixed zebrafish embryo microscopy data to extract single-cell morphological descriptors and predict developmental progression and cell types.

projects.title: Fabricating a Fiber Optic System for Localized Heat Shock in Light-Sheet Microscopy
projects.summary: Design and fabricate a fiber optic localized-heating system for a light-sheet microscope to deliver thermal stimuli to specific regions of zebrafish embryos and study how localized stress affects somitogenesis timing.

projects.title: Morphogen Gradients and Oscillatory Signaling in Zebrafish Development
projects.summary: Quantify signaling dynamics in zebrafish embryos and primary stem cell cultures using light-sheet microscopy to understand how morphogen gradients regulate oscillatory signaling and muscle cell differentiation.

projects.title: Validation of Novel ScFv Antibodies for Her1 Immunostaining in Zebrafish
projects.summary: Test three newly generated ScFv antibody clones for whole-mount immunostaining of Her1 in zebrafish embryos, adapting in-situ hybridization protocols, and then compare Her1 behaviour in wild-type and Her1-YFP reporter embryos by light-sheet microscopy.

projects.title: Define the functional role of frequently altered genes in lymphoma
projects.summary: Study the role in tumor pathogenesis of genes frequently altered in Non-Hodgkin lymphoma patients, by mimicking these alterations in vitro and in vivo with genome-editing technologies. The project combines genomic data analysis with molecular and cellular biology techniques.

projects.title: Genetic screenings to identify novel therapeutic targets
projects.summary: Use CRISPR/Cas9 libraries combined with targeted inhibitors to identify new therapeutic targets in lymphoma, and find genes that act synergistically or induce resistance. The project involves library preparation, cell infection, sequencing analysis and cloning.

projects.title: Metabolic characterization of Primitive Neuro-Ectodermal tumors
projects.summary: Define metabolic and epigenetic changes associated with the development of Primitive Neuro-Ectodermal tumors (PNET), a rare pediatric brain tumor, using a mouse model built from human iPS cells. The student would differentiate iPS cells into neural precursors, genetically modify them and test the effect of altered genes on tumor development.

projects.title: Soil-plant interactions: Influence of iron dynamics on plant physiology in saline soils
projects.summary: Studies how salinity, flooding and oxygen availability change iron chemistry in soils and how this affects iron availability and plant physiology. The student would build an artificial saline soil system with iron-containing minerals, assess iron geochemistry under different salinity and moisture levels, develop an imaging system to monitor plant growth, and model how salinity, moisture and iron mineralogy affect plant growth.
skills: Interest in plants and environmental processes

projects.title: Optical Characterization of Periodically-Poled Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Waveguides
projects.summary: The project focuses on second-harmonic generation and difference-frequency generation in periodically-poled thin-film lithium niobate (PPLN) waveguides, aiming for broadband operation and/or high conversion efficiency. The student would perform optical measurements at different pump/signal wavelengths and temperatures, and post-process them to extract waveguide intrinsic properties.

projects.title: Linear and nonlinear characterization of gallium nitride optical devices
projects.summary: The semester project covers the characterization of gallium nitride (GaN) optical waveguides, ring resonators and modulators fabricated by Hexisense. The student would first verify linear behaviour through coupling and propagation loss tests, then explore nonlinear response under continuous and pulsed regimes and electro-optic modulation of the resonators.

projects.title: Development of Intrinsically Stable Wide Bandgap Perovskite Compositions
projects.summary: Develop wide bandgap perovskite compositions that are intrinsically stable. The page gives only the title and section listing.

projects.title: Development of durable perovskite solar cells through encapsulation, stress-testing, and post-mortem analysis
projects.summary: Develop durable perovskite solar cells by working on encapsulation, stress testing and post-mortem analysis of degraded devices.

projects.title: Advancing Fully Inorganic Evaporated Perovskite Solar Cells through Interface Engineering
projects.summary: Improve fully inorganic evaporated perovskite solar cells through interface engineering.

projects.title: Understanding the degradation of coloured solutions for BIPV applications
projects.summary: Study the degradation of coloured solutions used in building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) applications.

projects.title: Fabrication, measurement, and thermomechanical modelling of 3D-shaped PV module for electric-vehicle application
projects.summary: Fabricate and measure a 3D-shaped photovoltaic module for electric vehicles and model its thermomechanical behaviour.

projects.title: Implementation of electronics and solar cells in Stöckli racing skis
projects.summary: Integrate electronics and solar cells into Stöckli racing skis.

projects.title: Colorimetry and reliability of colored PV modules
projects.summary: Study the colorimetry and reliability of coloured photovoltaic modules.

projects.title: Accelerated Perovskite Solar Cell Development through Machine Learning
projects.summary: Use machine learning to accelerate the development of perovskite solar cells.

projects.title: Development and Optimization of Capping Layers for Temperature-Stable Passivating Contact Solar Cells
projects.summary: Develop and optimise capping layers for temperature-stable passivating contact silicon solar cells.

projects.title: Characterization of electrical and structural properties of innovative contact schemes for Si solar cells
projects.summary: Characterise the electrical and structural properties of innovative contact schemes for silicon solar cells.

projects.title: Doped silicon layers as photocathodes for micro-channel plate detectors
projects.summary: Develop doped silicon layers to serve as photocathodes for micro-channel plate detectors.

projects.title: Building a colorimeter for accurate color-characterization of building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) applications
projects.summary: Build a colorimeter to accurately characterise the colour of building-integrated photovoltaic modules.

projects.title: high-throughput stability measurements of perovskite semiconductors
projects.summary: Perform high-throughput stability measurements on perovskite semiconductors.

projects.title: Understanding the degradation mechanism of the encapsulants in lightweight PV modules
projects.summary: Investigate how encapsulants degrade in lightweight photovoltaic modules.

projects.title: Reliability modelling of composite structures backsheet for lightweight photovoltaic applications
projects.summary: Model the reliability of composite backsheet structures for lightweight photovoltaic applications.

projects.title: Metallization of Si solar cells with passivating contacts
projects.summary: Develop metallization for silicon solar cells with passivating contacts.

projects.title: Characterization of silicon-based layer stacks for passivating contact solar cells
projects.summary: Characterise silicon-based layer stacks used in passivating contact solar cells.

projects.title: Thermal and Airflow Simulation of an Elevated Bifacial Photovoltaic Module
projects.summary: Simulate the thermal behaviour and airflow around an elevated bifacial photovoltaic module.

projects.title: Solar Powered Freight Transport in Eastern Africa
projects.summary: Study solar-powered freight transport in Eastern Africa.

projects.title: Unlocking the value of residential solar-powered EV charging in Europe
projects.summary: Assess the value of residential solar-powered electric vehicle charging in Europe.

projects.title: Electric vehicles as energy carriers for enhanced energy autonomy and universal energy access
projects.summary: Study electric vehicles as energy carriers to improve energy autonomy and universal energy access.

projects.title: Atomic layer deposited thin-films towards stable perovskite-silicon tandems
projects.summary: Develop atomic layer deposited thin films to enable stable perovskite-silicon tandem solar cells.

projects.title: Use computational tools to study neural circuit activity
projects.summary: Use computer vision and machine learning to extract neural activity patterns during behavior and predict relations between behavioral and internal states. The project sits between computer science and neurobiology.

projects.title: Build artificial neural networks to control a simulated fly
projects.summary: Develop biorealistic neural controllers for a physics-based neuromechanical simulation of the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster. The project lies at the interface of robotics, computer science and neuroscience.

projects.title: Use robotic systems to automate biological experimentation
projects.summary: Develop automated vision-guided robotic systems that perform behavioral and/or neural experiments, to make biological experimentation more accessible and less repetitive. The project sits at the interface of robotics and neurobiology.

projects.title: Use computational tools to study animal behavior
projects.summary: Use computational and machine learning approaches to quantify and segment fly behavior into individual actions, and link these behavioral sequences to simultaneously acquired neuroimaging data.

projects.title: Study the full graph (connectome) of the fly nervous system
projects.summary: Improve and explore the connectome graph of the fly nervous system to answer questions about neural circuit motifs underlying complex motor behaviors. The project sits at the interface of computer science, mathematics and biology.

projects.title: Behavioral studies in the laboratory
projects.summary: Hands-on experiments with flies to examine how neural activation or other perturbations modulate animal behavior. The student designs experiments and analyzes their own data.

projects.title: Build a robotic fly
projects.summary: Construct an insect-inspired robot and test bioinspired algorithms of limb control. The project is at the interface of robotics and biology, in collaboration with EPFL robotics groups.

projects.title: AI-Powered Knee Moment Estimation: Mobile-Based Biomechanical Analysis to Predict Knee Injury Risk in Sports
projects.summary: Develop a machine learning pipeline that estimates knee moments during change-of-direction tasks from 2D frontal-view video captured with a single mobile device. The model is trained against laboratory OpenSim ground truth from football players.

projects.title: Validating Athletic Performance: A Reliability and Validity Study of IMU and Video-Based Jump Analysis
projects.summary: Evaluate the reliability and validity of existing algorithms for drop jump, squat jump and velocity-based training analysis using IMU and video data. The work includes laboratory data collection, processing with the existing algorithms, and writing a scientific paper.

projects.title: Elite Performance Analytics: Large-Scale IMU-Based CMJ and DJ Assessment in Professional Football
projects.summary: Pre-process, analyse and statistically evaluate a large IMU dataset from countermovement jump and drop jump assessments of about 320 professional football players across 16 teams. The goal is to identify performance trends across player roles.

projects.title: Real-Time Image-Based Colour Assessment and Camera Calibration for a Scientific Imaging Setup
projects.summary: Improve a prototype software module that detects poor illumination or colour conditions in a medical robotics imaging platform. The module flags, rejects or accepts images based on quality criteria.

projects.title: Generalisation of Tool Segmentation in Medical Robotic Imaging
projects.summary: Extend an existing image segmentation pipeline that detects a medical tool in a robotic experimental setup so that it segments multiple relevant classes. The aim is more robust image understanding for medical robotics.

projects.title: Accuracy Assessment of RGB-Based Shape Reconstruction
projects.summary: Evaluate how accurately shapes reconstructed from RGB images match their real counterparts in an experimental setup. The work involves designing reference shapes, reconstructing them, and measuring reconstruction error to find the algorithm's limitations.

projects.title: Probabilistic Modelling of Arterial Geometries
projects.summary: Develop probabilistic and deep learning methods to model and generate realistic arterial geometries learned from vascular data. The model is intended to support simulation, analysis or data generation in medical robotics and biomedical applications.

projects.title: Design of a typical steel building
projects.summary: Design of a typical industrial or office steel frame building, covering the floor system, lateral load resisting systems, connections and foundation, with conceptual design and verification of members and frame stability under wind and/or seismic loading. Deliverables include connection detailing drawings and a detailed calculation report.
skills: structural design software used in design offices

projects.title: Stability project using interactive tools (MOLA Kit)
projects.summary: Hands-on physical modelling with the MOLA Structural Kit to explore stability phenomena in frame structures, combining structural dynamics, structural stability and structural analysis.

projects.title: Seismic stability of base-isolated steel structures
projects.summary: Shaking table tests on typical steel structural configurations, compared with numerical simulations, to evaluate the influence of base isolation on structural response under earthquake shaking.

projects.title: Dynamic stability of steel structures under seismic excitations
projects.summary: Combines theoretical analysis and numerical modelling of the dynamic stability of steel frames under seismic excitation with shake-table tests of an idealised frame built from the MOLA Structural Kit, exploring torsional effects, soft-storey vulnerability and frame stability criteria.

projects.title: Nonlinear modelling and analysis of steel structures
projects.summary: Development of frame analysis models for steel structures to study their linear and nonlinear response through static or dynamic analysis procedures. The page lists CIVIL 449 (Nonlinear Analysis of Structures) as a prerequisite.

projects.title: Nonlinear static analysis of steel structures
projects.summary: Development of Python numerical models to simulate the nonlinear static (pushover) analysis of steel structures under wind and/or seismic loading, using fibre-based beam-columns or concentrated plasticity models, with results placed in design context (SIA 269/3, Eurocode 8 part 3).

projects.title: Nonlinear dynamic analysis of steel structures
projects.summary: Development of Python numerical models to simulate the dynamic response of steel structures under seismic loading, using fibre-based beam-columns or concentrated plasticity models, with results placed in design context.

projects.title: Conceptual design of a footbridge
projects.summary: As part of a design competition, students draft a project basis, develop several footbridge variants, design the chosen variant, and produce two A1 technical drawing sheets with plan, elevations, sections, details and construction stages.

projects.title: Assessment of an existing bridge
projects.summary: Assessment of an existing bridge using frame finite element analysis, including ULS and fatigue verifications with recent simulation tools and traffic load models (SIA 269 revision), and, if necessary, a proposed intervention such as reinforcement or monitoring.

projects.title: Terrain-Adaptive Robotic Foot Using Negative Stiffness Structure
projects.summary: Develop a legged-robot foot that uses curved-origami structures with programmable positive and negative stiffness to switch between a compact stiff configuration on rigid ground and an expanded, load-distributing configuration on sand. The student would model, fabricate and experimentally compare this adaptive foot with a conventional rigid foot.

projects.title: Does Personalization in Medical Collaborative Learning Learn Site Shortcuts?
projects.summary: Investigates whether standard personalized federated learning methods learn site-specific shortcuts (spurious correlations) when trained on medical data across hospitals. The results are meant to inform a personalization method that keeps useful site-specific features while avoiding shortcuts.

projects.title: Whose bubble is it? Harvesting idle capacity in data-parallel, expert-parallel LLM serving
projects.summary: Characterizes where GPU idle capacity arises in data-parallel, expert-parallel Mixture-of-Experts LLM serving, and determines under what conditions it can be harvested for parameter-efficient fine-tuning without violating service-level objectives through coupling between replicas.

projects.title: Noise or Lies? Distinguishing privacy protection from fairwashing in black-box audits
projects.summary: Studies when an external auditor, querying a black-box ML model through a platform, can distinguish an honest privacy-preserving platform (random, public noise) from a manipulative one that performs fairwashing (targeted alteration of answers to hide discrimination).

projects.title: Privacy Vulnerability Transfer in Model Merging
projects.summary: Investigates how privacy vulnerabilities of independently fine-tuned language models propagate into merged models built with model merging and task arithmetic, using membership inference and extraction attacks. The work analyzes how merging coefficients, number of merged models and task similarity affect vulnerability transfer.

projects.title: Master's Project Opportunity: Metabolic Regulation of Liver Cell Function and Stress Response
projects.summary: Investigate how specific metabolites influence hepatic energy metabolism, oxidative stress resilience, and mitochondrial function in liver cells. The project combines metabolomics, transcriptomics, mitochondrial functional assays, redox biology and advanced liver cell culture.

projects.title: Learning trajectories in models and children
projects.summary: Treats language model training as a developmental trajectory and asks whether the order and timing of language abilities emerging in artificial models match those in children. The work involves training and densely checkpointing models from scratch, probing their representations, and comparing them with developmental and psycholinguistic measures.

projects.title: Characterizing Neuronal Activity in Brain Organoids Across Neurodevelopmental Disorder Mutants
projects.summary: Analyses existing multielectrode array recordings from brain organoids carrying neurodevelopmental disorder-associated mutations and healthy controls. The student quantifies network activity features such as firing rates, bursts and synchrony, and trains interpretable machine learning classifiers to distinguish mutant from wildtype organoids.

projects.title: Permeance of N2O, NH3 and H2O through two-dimensional graphene membranes
projects.summary: Characterise the permeation coefficients of N2O, NH3 and H2O through atomically thin graphene membranes and benchmark them against existing PDMS membranes used in in-situ dissolved gas probes. The work also quantifies the effects of temperature and salinity.

projects.title: Automated selection of spectral windows for gas detection and isotopic ratio retrievals from HITRAN database
projects.summary: Develop a reproducible Python tool that uses the HITRAN spectroscopic database to simulate absorption spectra and rank the best spectral windows for detecting target gases and measuring isotopic ratios. The tool aims to support the design of optical greenhouse gas sensors.

projects.title: Permeance of N2O, NH3 and H2O through two-dimensional graphene membranes
projects.summary: Characterise the permeation of N2O, NH3 and H2O through existing PDMS membranes and newly built two-dimensional graphene membranes, to benchmark them for in-situ dissolved gas measurements. The work includes measuring permeation coefficients using dry gas mixtures and pressurised water tanks, and quantifying the effects of temperature and salinity.

projects.title: Automated selection of spectral windows for gas detection and isotopic ratio retrievals from HITRAN database
projects.summary: Develop a reproducible, documented Python tool that uses the HITRAN spectroscopic database to identify and rank spectral windows suited to detecting target gases and measuring isotopic ratios. The tool simulates synthetic absorption spectra and scores candidate windows on interference, signal-to-noise and temperature/pressure sensitivity.

projects.title: Investigation of chemical devulcanization for improved tire recycling
projects.summary: The project investigates chemical devulcanization of end-of-life tire rubber to controllably break down its network. The student will study how the agent, its concentration and rubber formulation affect the process, characterize the changes, and reprocess the modified rubber into recycled elastomers.

projects.title: Formulation of 3D printable double network granular elastomers
projects.summary: The project aims to understand how particle size, size distribution and shape affect the mechanical properties, microstructure and ink rheology of 3D-printable double network granular elastomers. The student will make elastomer microparticles, formulate direct ink writing inks, print and convert structures, and characterize them.

projects.title: Formulation of 3D printable double network granular elastomers
projects.summary: The project aims to understand how particle size, size distribution and shape affect the mechanical properties, microstructure and ink rheology of 3D-printable double network granular elastomers. The student will make elastomer microparticles, formulate direct ink writing inks, print and convert structures, and characterize them.

projects.title: Dynamic and Reprocessable Elastomers
projects.summary: The project develops dynamic elastomeric materials that keep their mechanical integrity while gaining self-healing, reshaping and reprocessing abilities. The student will design, prepare and characterize polymer networks to see how network design controls mechanical performance, damage recovery and recyclability.

projects.title: Air Moisture Curable, 3D Printable Double Network Granular Elastomers
projects.summary: The project develops moisture-curable prepolymers as an alternative to UV or thermal initiation for the second network in 3D-printable double network granular elastomers. The student will synthesize and characterize prepolymers, prepare swollen microparticles, and study the rheology, printability and mechanical properties after curing.

projects.title: Meta-Stable Particle Synthesis for Low Energy Sintering
projects.summary: The project studies how crystallinity, chemistry, additives and size of synthesized meta-stable calcium carbonate particles affect their consolidation and sintering behavior, as a model for ceramics. The student will synthesize and characterize powders, then perform conventional and flash sintering, starting at EPFL and continuing at Empa.

projects.title: From Acid Amyloids to Functional Films: Role of Neutralization in Whey and Soy Systems
projects.summary: The project studies how pH-shift neutralization of protein amyloid fibrils modifies their morphology and dispersion in whey protein isolate and soy protein isolate matrices. The student will then cast bio-based films and evaluate their mechanical, wetting, moisture and water vapor barrier properties for sustainable packaging.

projects.title: Field and experimental Data visualization and sharing through software application
projects.summary: Develop further a web application that imports, exports and visualises field and experimental soil and ecology data from two Swiss Alpine study sites, adding interactive maps and plots and a user interface for a broad public audience.

projects.title: Characterizing the redox parameters dictating the reactivity of Mn(III)-oxides
projects.summary: Determine the thermodynamic and kinetic redox parameters of Mn(III)-oxides (hausmannite and manganite) using mediated electrochemical analyses, and quantify how carbonate, organic matter and ligands affect their reactivity and electron transfer.

projects.title: Insights into organic carbon mineralization in alpine soils: A soil incubation experiment
projects.summary: Assess how soil moisture influences soil organic carbon mineralisation in Swiss alpine soils through laboratory incubation experiments, measuring respiration, redox conditions and oxygen availability and analysing the results statistically.

projects.title: Effect of organic fertilizer plus additives on GHG emissions and soil properties
projects.summary: Evaluate whether organic fertilizers combined with additives, shown promising in laboratory studies, reduce greenhouse gas emissions and change soil properties under real conditions on two Swiss farms, through field GHG measurements and soil analyses.

projects.title: Soil-plant interactions: Influence of iron dynamics on plant physiology in saline soils
projects.summary: Build an artificial saline soil system of sand and iron-bearing minerals to study how salinity and moisture change iron geochemistry and, in turn, plant growth and physiology, including developing an imaging system and a plant growth model.

projects.title: Détection et analyse des formes du lit des rivières à partir de données de laboratoire
projects.summary: Analyse a laboratory dataset of migrating dunes and ripples to estimate their migration speed and two-dimensional shape, starting with PIV-inspired image-pair comparison. The work supports estimating sediment transport and hydraulic roughness in sandy rivers.

projects.title: Méthodes d'évaluation des ressources énergétiques hydrocinétiques
projects.summary: Develop a robust analytical or data-based methodology to estimate the hydrokinetic energy resource available in rivers and artificial channels. The long-term aim is a full assessment of hydrokinetic potential in rural areas of Switzerland and Europe.

projects.title: Sédimentation dans les réservoirs des barrages : synthèse et extension des ensembles de données existants
projects.summary: Synthesise and extend existing datasets on reservoir sedimentation, with a focus on mitigation strategies in operating dams. The goal is a structured database analysed for trends linking dam characteristics, catchment properties and mitigation efficiency. The project is carried out with Oak Ridge National Laboratory.

projects.title: Outils numériques pour le transport des sédiments et les simulations morphodynamiques
projects.summary: Evaluate the ability of current numerical tools, notably the BASEMENT hydromorphodynamic software, to simulate sediment transport and bed evolution in simplified natural and laboratory settings. Students run controlled numerical experiments and critically interpret the results.

projects.title: Prévision de la morphologie fluviale à l'aide de l'IA
projects.summary: Use deep learning models trained on satellite imagery and open datasets to predict long-term changes in braided river configurations. Possible directions include temporal pattern recognition, new architectures and loss functions, hydrological data integration, and model evaluation.

projects.title: Experiments on fluvial dunes
projects.summary: Controlled laboratory experiments in a narrow recirculating flume to study mobile sand bed dynamics under different flow conditions. High-frequency imaging of the bed and free surface will be processed to characterise bedform evolution, with an optional link to data-driven prediction of bed evolution.

projects.title: River bedforms detection and analysis from laboratory data
projects.summary: Analyse a laboratory dataset of migrating ripples and dunes to estimate their migration speed and two-dimensional shape. The approach applies particle image velocimetry-inspired algorithms that compare consecutive image pairs.

projects.title: Hydrokinetic energy resource assessment methods
projects.summary: Develop an analytical or data-driven methodology to estimate the hydrokinetic energy resource available in rivers and engineered channels. The longer-term aim is an assessment of hydrokinetic potential across rural Switzerland and Europe.

projects.title: Reservoir Sedimentation at Dams: Synthesis and Expansion of Existing Datasets
projects.summary: Synthesise and expand existing datasets on reservoir sedimentation, with a focus on mitigation strategies at operational dams. The goal is a structured database linking dam characteristics, watershed properties and mitigation effectiveness, analysed for patterns. The project is in collaboration with Oak Ridge National Laboratory.

projects.title: Sensitivity of Catchment-Scale Sediment Budget Estimates to Sediment Transport Equations and Model Parameters
projects.summary: Use the D-CASCADE sediment connectivity model on the Romanche catchment to test how sediment transport equations (Rickenmann, Wilcock-Crowe-Mueller) and input parameters such as active width, active layer depth and discharge affect sediment budget estimates. The aim is a reproducible sensitivity analysis and guidance on formula suitability and input-data priorities.

projects.title: Morphodynamic Controls on the Evolution of Reservoir Sediment Trapping Efficiency
projects.summary: Use Delft3D to model how sediment trapping efficiency in a reservoir changes as it fills and delta deposits develop. The work will calculate trapping efficiency from sediment mass balances and relate it to storage loss, deposit distribution and flow conditions.

projects.title: Influence of Dam Idealization on Reservoir Sedimentation Predictions in Delft3D
projects.summary: Compare alternative representations of a dam in Delft3D (such as downstream water level conditions, simplified discharge relationships and explicit hydraulic structures) to quantify how they affect simulated sediment retention and deposition. The study aims to determine the level of model complexity appropriate for different purposes.

projects.title: Numerical tools for sediment transport and morphodynamic simulations
projects.summary: Evaluate the capability of numerical tools, mainly the BASEMENT hydro-morphodynamic software, to simulate sediment transport and bed evolution in simplified natural and laboratory configurations. Students run controlled numerical experiments to identify strengths and limitations of the tools.

projects.title: AI-Driven Prediction of River Morphology
projects.summary: Develop deep-learning models that forecast long-term planform changes of complex river systems, especially braided rivers, using satellite imagery and open-source datasets. Possible directions include new architectures and loss functions, integrating hydrologic data and evaluating model performance.

projects.title: AI for river morphology
projects.summary: Develop and improve deep-learning models that predict the planform morphological evolution of (braided) rivers, using satellite imagery collections and hydrological data. The student defines a research plan, may generate new river datasets, and assesses model performance and limitations.

projects.title: Semester Project Proposal
projects.summary: Evaluate the capability of the BASEMENT hydro-morphodynamic software to simulate sediment transport and bed evolution in simplified natural and laboratory river configurations. The student sets up, runs and interprets 2D hydrodynamic and sediment transport simulations and identifies the challenges of modelling natural rivers.

projects.title: Semester Project Proposal
projects.summary: Experimental study of the temporal evolution of a mobile sand bed in a narrow recirculating flume, using high-frequency imaging to reconstruct bed and free-surface evolution and relate bedform dynamics to hydraulic conditions. Exploring data-driven or machine-learning prediction of bed evolution is an optional extension.

projects.title: Nonspecific adsorption of proteins to surfaces (small molecule modulation)
projects.summary: This master project investigates how small molecules modulate nonspecific protein adsorption to model surfaces, examining whether they change protein-surface encounter kinetics, interfacial residence times, or surface-induced conformational transitions.

projects.title: Glycan-mimicking virucidal antivirals
projects.summary: This master project aims to design glycan-mimicking molecules that block viral attachment and irreversibly disrupt viruses, covering organic synthesis, characterization, and biological evaluation against viruses toward an orally available broad-spectrum antiviral lead.

projects.title: Action Space Reduction for Learning Robotic Manipulation (Semester Project)
projects.summary: The project studies how reducing the action space helps learning dexterous manipulation with a fully actuated robotic hand. Grasping data will be used to extract a low-dimensional eigengrasp basis via PCA, and reinforcement or imitation learning policies will be trained on the reduced space and compared against a baseline.

projects.title: Augmented Robot Reality: Projecting the Virtual into the Real World
projects.summary: Develop real-time visualisation of virtual information overlaid on camera feeds and projected onto the ground to augment a multi-robot testbed. The work involves mapping camera and projector pixel arrays to the robot configuration space, correcting lens and projector distortion, and using a camera-projector feedback loop to reduce mapping errors.

projects.title: Controlling soft robotic arm via MPC and reinforcement learning (Semester Project / Master Thesis)
projects.summary: Develop an accurate controller for soft robotic arms that achieves reliable trajectory tracking across varying spatial poses and payload conditions. The project explores model predictive control based on identified or neural network models, and reinforcement learning with domain randomization or adaptation.

projects.title: Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language-Action Models for Real World Robotic Manipulation Tasks (Semester Project / Master Thesis)
projects.summary: Build an end-to-end pipeline for real-robot manipulation: teleoperate the robot to collect demonstrations, curate a dataset, and fine-tune an open-source Vision-Language-Action model to train imitation policies. The goal is to set up the system for the WBCD manipulation competition (What Bimanuals Can Do) at IROS 2026.

projects.title: Finetuning Policy via Reinforcement Learning from Human Preferences (Semester Project/ Master Thesis)
projects.summary: The project aims to fine-tune robotic manipulation policies using reinforcement learning from human preferences (RLHF). The goal is to improve policies learned by RL in simulation or by behavioral cloning, doing the fine-tuning offline on a pre-collected exploratory dataset from the real robotic system.

projects.title: Information Design in Local Energy Markets (Semester Project)
projects.summary: Apply the theory of signalling in games (Bayesian persuasion) to local energy markets, studying whether a market operator can strategically communicate weather or renewable production forecasts to prosumers to improve market efficiency and fairness. Simulations are run on real-world distribution grids.

projects.title: Learning Robotic Manipulation with Tunable Compliance (Master Thesis)
projects.summary: Build an imitation learning framework for a 20-DoF dexterous hand and a 7-DoF arm, with an admittance controller and demonstrations annotated with stiffness labels. A diffusion transformer policy conditioned on stiffness would make compliance tunable after training and in real time, evaluated on pick-and-place tasks under different stiffness values.

projects.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer for JetBot via Domain Randomization and Adaptation
projects.summary: Develop and evaluate reinforcement learning policies that transfer robustly from simulation to the real NVIDIA JetBot, using domain randomization, domain adaptation, and hybrid sim-real fine-tuning. The work compares these techniques for JetBot navigation in obstacle-rich environments, aiming for zero-shot transfer performance with minimal real-world fine-tuning.

projects.title: Controlling a Multi-drone Fleet for Traffic Monitoring
projects.summary: Coordinate a fleet of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) that complement fixed traffic sensors by collecting data at multiple locations. The project addresses deciding where and when each UAV collects data, based on road importance and the fleet's previous visits.

projects.title: Reinforcement learning to achieve efficient equilibria in repeated games with partial observability
projects.summary: Design online learning algorithms that learn efficient equilibria of a long-horizon repeated game. The focus is on leader-follower games where the follower's actions are partially observable.

projects.title: Multi-Objective Optimization for Automated Theorem Proving
projects.summary: Study automated theorem proving, where large language models trained with reinforcement learning generate formal proofs checked by proof assistants such as Lean or Isabelle. The project targets multi-objective optimization for this setting.

projects.title: Hybrid soft-actor critic benchmark
projects.summary: Benchmark a hybrid soft actor-critic (SAC) variant that handles mixed continuous and discrete actions, used to autonomously build an arch. The benchmark compares it against existing methods such as hybrid PPO.

projects.title: Algorithmic collusion in electricity markets
projects.summary: Investigate collusive outcomes when autonomous learning agents bid in electricity markets. The project relies mainly on numerical simulations combined with game-theoretic analysis.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Traffic Monitoring with Limited Information Sharing
projects.summary: Coordinate a fleet of UAVs that collect traffic data to complement fixed sensors, prioritizing important roads under limited information sharing between agents. The goal is informative traffic data collection as monitoring needs change.

projects.title: Chemical immunoengineering
projects.summary: Development of assays to study how immune cells interact with cancer cells under the influence of smart prodrugs and biomaterials. Students learn mammalian cell culture, lymphocyte and cancer cell isolation, culture assays, sample preparation, labeling and data analysis.

projects.title: Scaffolding for immune cell activation and expansion
projects.summary: Develop a hydrogel-based 3D cell scaffold that supports the survival, growth, expansion and function of immune cells. The work examines how to control and modify the hydrogel's physicochemical properties and then studies activation, expansion and phenotypes of T cells and NK cells in the scaffold.

projects.title: Mechanical immunoengineering
projects.summary: Use biophysical cues to enhance the proliferation of T cells for cell-based therapies, since current activation and expansion protocols are sub-optimal. The student works on activation of mouse primary T cells.

projects.title: Car-T cell engineering
projects.summary: Develop novel chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) with enhanced efficacy against solid tumors. The student generates mouse CAR-T cells, working on molecular cloning, T-cell biology, cell culture and flow cytometry.

projects.title: DPTLSL RISC-V System-On-Chip
projects.summary: Build a very small version of the X-HEEP RISC-V microcontroller (CPU, one memory bank, GPIOs) and synthesize it with a custom standard-cell library using differential logic, producing a verified post-synthesis netlist. Optional post-processing with the open-source Yosys synthesizer.

projects.title: chip2chip serial-link for RISC-V Microcontrollers
projects.summary: Integrate the PULP chip2chip serial-link IP into X-HEEP so that two microcontrollers can exchange memory-mapped read/write data. The work includes extending the Pynq-Z2 FPGA support and running a C test across two FPGAs.

projects.title: Design automation of in-memory computing
projects.summary: Automate the physical design of the BLADE in-memory computing (IMC) architecture in 65nm for arbitrary configurations, covering the memory decoder and local memory controller in Innovus, with later exploration of open-source PnR tools.

projects.title: Characterization of an in-memory computing on Silicon
projects.summary: Characterize two fabricated 65nm configurations of the BLADE in-memory computing chips across voltage and temperature conditions, by writing test programs for the board, measuring memory functionality and metrics, and analysing data.

projects.title: Decoder with Bit-Flipping Post-Processing for 6G wireless
projects.summary: Develop a low-complexity bit-flipping post-processing algorithm to improve a 6G error-correction decoder, then design its hardware architecture, implement it in VHDL and benchmark it against throughput and power targets.

projects.title: High-Throughput Hard-Decision Decoder for Optical Communications
projects.summary: Design a low-complexity iterative bounded-distance hard-decision decoder for two-dimensional parity-check codes targeting 400G-ZR/800G-ZR optical fiber links. The work covers algorithm study, VHDL architecture implementation and benchmarking.

projects.title: Test Platform of Error-Correction Decoders on FPGA SoC
projects.summary: Build a hardware test platform on an FPGA SoC to accelerate and evaluate error-correction decoders (5G, 6G, optical fiber), including I/O, bus and CPU-FPGA communication configuration, implementation, verification and benchmarking.

projects.title: GC-RAM Controller for X-HEEP
projects.summary: Design and implement in VHDL a smart memory controller for dynamic GC-RAM, handling refresh, access multiplexing and error detection/correction, and interfacing it with the X-HEEP system bus.

projects.title: Design of a Wireless Modem for IoT
projects.summary: Design a LoRa physical-layer transmitter for ultra-low-power IoT nodes: build a fixed-point golden model, develop and implement the architecture in VHDL with a bus interface, and test it on an FPGA.

projects.title: Test of the fabricated GC-eDRAM chip
projects.summary: Characterize fabricated GC-eDRAM memory chips in the lab by establishing communication between a computer and the chip, running temperature, voltage and frequency analyses, and comparing results with CAD simulations.

projects.title: Improving blocks of the GC-eDRAM in 28nm FDSOI Process
projects.summary: Design new full-custom analog blocks (such as a charge pump or sense amplifier) for the GC-eDRAM macro in 28nm FDSOI to extend data retention time, including simulation with the macro and layout optimisation.

projects.title: Designing Analog Blocks for the GC-eDRAM at 16nm FINFET
projects.summary: Design well-known analog blocks (ADC and voltage buffers) for characterising the new 16nm GC-eDRAM macro, and explore adaptive self-calibrating macros, including layout and post-layout optimisation.

projects.title: Designing a decoder in 16nm FinFet
projects.summary: Implement a full-custom error-correction decoder for the GRAND algorithm in 16nm FinFET, using dynamic logic and an in-memory computation style, and automate layout generation with Python scripts.

projects.title: Mixed signal compute block
projects.summary: Design analog sorter blocks, including DACs and comparators, that are compatible with standard-cell dimensions, as a mixed-signal approach to accelerating digital sorting bottlenecks in 5G/6G algorithms.

projects.title: Designing a Leakage Suppression SRAM / ROM in 16nm FinFET
projects.summary: Evaluate leakage suppression techniques on a memory macro in 16nm FinFET for always-on low-power circuits, characterise speed and leakage, and design a bitcell array with leakage suppression.

projects.title: Project 1: Localization and User Activity Detection
projects.summary: Detect user activity, room state and location from Wi-Fi signals without cameras or wearables, by collecting and labelling data and developing preprocessing and classification or localization models.

projects.title: Project 2: Vital-Signs Estimation
projects.summary: Estimate breathing and heart-beat rates of one or several people from reflected wireless signals, collecting data at different breathing rates and distances and developing estimation models.

projects.title: Project 3: Hardware and Machine Learning for Enhancing Wi-Fi Radar
projects.summary: Cancel the direct transmit signal in a Wi-Fi radar so that environmental reflections become visible, using a hardware or machine-learning canceller implemented as a quantized neural network and tested in a real system.

projects.title: Project 4: 4G LTE Localization
projects.summary: Adapt an open-source 4G software radio suite to collect channel state information from LTE signals and use it to localize a device or a device-free target.

projects.title: Project 5: UWB Environment and Human Activity Sensing
projects.summary: Sense environments, vital signs and human activities from UWB/Wi-Fi channel estimates by synchronising and preprocessing channel impulse responses and extracting activity information.

projects.title: Project 1: LoRa Transceiver Optimization and Evaluation
projects.summary: Characterize the memory footprint, computational load and performance of an open-source LoRa transceiver, then add features to the public repository to help the research and radio-enthusiast community.

projects.title: Project 2: LoRaWAN for SDR
projects.summary: Add LoRaWAN support to an open-source LoRa physical-layer implementation by interfacing an existing MAC-layer library with the LoRa transceiver in GNU Radio.

projects.title: Project 3: Implementing a Mioty Transceiver
projects.summary: Build the first open-source software-defined radio implementation of the Mioty LPWAN standard, including a simple transceiver that is verified for compatibility with commercial radio chips.

projects.title: Project 4: Characterizing the New WiFi HaLow
projects.summary: Set up a WiFi HaLow test environment at EPFL and characterize the performance and power of the new IoT-oriented Wi-Fi standard through a test plan and measurements in and around EPFL.

projects.title: Chip for Wi-Fi sensing
projects.summary: Transition an existing FPGA-based Wi-Fi sensing system for activity detection, localization and breathing monitoring into a semi-custom ASIC, optimizing area, power and speed. The work uses Cadence tools and a standard-cell flow, with additional VHDL/Verilog exploration.

projects.title: Drone Detection Radar Design
projects.summary: Design an RF radar circuit on a PCB to detect the speed and position of drones, with a model of the RF system for simulation and digital processing on a software-defined radio.

projects.title: Open Reimplementation of the RP2040 PIO (Master Thesis)
projects.summary: Read the specifications of the Raspberry Pi RP2040 programmable I/O block, implement its functionality in RTL and integrate it into the HEEP system, with FPGA prototyping.

projects.title: Integrating High-Speed Test Infrastructure into XHeep (Semester Project)
projects.summary: Integrate the IPbus-based Ethernet high-speed test infrastructure already developed at TCL for custom ASIC testing into the XHeep project.

projects.title: Analog High-Performance Sorters for Telecommunications
projects.summary: Evaluate mixed-signal architectures for high-speed sorters that find the U smallest elements in communication systems, and compare them with purely digital implementations in 16nm FinFET technology.

projects.title: Efficient MVM for Syndrome Computation in Decoders
projects.summary: Design a full-custom matrix-vector multiplication accelerator in 16nm FinFET for GF(2) syndrome computation in channel decoders, and compare it with standard-cell implementations.

projects.title: Multi-Bit Error Correction Code (ECC) for Gain-Cell eDRAM
projects.summary: Explore and implement a multi-bit error correction code that trades off parity storage overhead, latency and power to mitigate retention-time failures in gain-cell eDRAM.

projects.title: Optimize Gain-Cell eDRAM Performance on X-Heep Platform
projects.summary: Add cache-line buffering to a gain-cell eDRAM on the X-Heep platform to reduce read-modify-write and refresh overhead, and optimize the cache line structure using benchmarks.

projects.title: Ultra-low power standard-cells library optimization for AO systems
projects.summary: Optimize, design and characterize a full-custom differential standard-cell library for always-on systems to improve robustness and reduce leakage, and compare it with a standard CMOS library.

projects.title: Design of A Matrix with Multiple Sizes and Its Decoder Implementation
projects.summary: Design an LDPC parity-check matrix with several nested lifting sizes from a given base matrix, and verify it in a configurable LDPC ASIC decoder.

projects.title: Routing Design for Data Coupling in Decoders
projects.summary: Simplify the design of a flexible routing network that supports global coupling among cores in a multi-core LDPC decoder, and implement it in ASIC.

projects.title: Elaboration of an In-Memory Computing Memory Compiler (Master Thesis)
projects.summary: Design an in-memory computing memory compiler in 65nm using open-source tools that generates GDS, LEF, LIB and SPICE files from a memory size and configuration.

projects.title: Mioty Implementation
projects.summary: Improve the synchronization of an existing software-defined-radio implementation of the Mioty LPWAN standard and build a transceiver compatible with commercial devices, validated with real transmissions.

projects.title: Cellular Sensing: Traffic Safety Alert
