projects.summary: Use real-time cellular channel state information to estimate vehicle speed and classify traffic as safe or dangerous, in order to alert distracted pedestrians of fast-approaching vehicles.

projects.title: Improved Belief Propagation Decoding for Short Codes
projects.summary: Improve belief propagation decoding of short codes by using machine learning to refine sparsified parity-check matrices and by constructing short linear codes suited to sparse BP decoding, for 6G uRLLC scenarios.

projects.title: Interconnect-aware routing analysis of belief-propagation decoder architectures
projects.summary: Compare the routing behaviour of different belief-propagation (BP) decoder architectures, including compute-in-memory bit-serial designs, to find interconnect bottlenecks and scaling limits. The goal is to derive guidelines for scalable, interconnect-aware BP decoders by measuring how wire congestion affects area, power and delay.

projects.title: Compact low-leakage CAM bitcell design
projects.summary: Design and simulate a novel compact content-addressable memory (CAM) bitcell with lower static leakage than conventional 10T SRAM-based CAMs and than existing compact (<6T) cells. The bitcell should also support fast match-line evaluation and be validated under PVT variations and mismatch.

projects.title: Cell characterization of the DPTLSL leakage-suppression logic family
projects.summary: Characterize and optimise cells and circuit architectures of DPTLSL, a leakage-suppression logic family developed at TCL, for low-leakage, reliable low-frequency operation, demonstrated on an FIR filter. The work also compares the results against a standard CMOS library.

projects.title: Configurable near-memory computing accelerator (NM-Caesar)
projects.summary: Improve the NM-Caesar near-memory computing RTL so that it is configurable in memory size and number of banks. The project also aims to optimise and quantify energy, area and performance trade-offs.

projects.title: Circuit architectures for morphological filters
projects.summary: Design three hardware architectures (iterative, pipelined and unrolled) for morphological filters (erosion, dilation, opening, closing) starting from an existing Python description. The architectures will be compared through post-synthesis power, performance and area (PPA) extraction.

projects.title: Algorithms that tolerate errors in 3T-1C GC-eDRAM
projects.summary: Explore algorithms, such as neural networks and error-correction codes, that remain accurate despite random data loss in low-power 3T-1C gain-cell eDRAM. The project aims to build a model that estimates algorithm accuracy and system power.

projects.title: LoRa software-defined radio error-rate evaluation
projects.summary: Experimentally evaluate the error-rate performance of an existing open-source software-defined radio (SDR) implementation of LoRa and compare it with commercial LoRa hardware. The results are intended to increase the impact of the open-source implementation.

projects.title: Machine-learning-based drone localization with LoRa
projects.summary: Implement machine-learning models that estimate drone location from noisy LoRa RSSI and SNR signals, using about 75k drone measurements taken around EPFL. The models will be evaluated for performance and robustness in LoRa-based IoT systems.

projects.title: Forward error correction decoding for optical communications
projects.summary: Explore forward error correction (FEC) decoding algorithms that meet optical communication standards for AI data-center networks, with reduced decoding complexity. An optional part is the implementation of a decoder.

projects.title: ENAC Semester Project: Foundation
projects.summary: The project examines how internationally recognized buildings look when foundations and the below-ground structure are considered alongside the above-ground building, using physical models to reveal the material use and embodied carbon hidden beneath expressions of lightness and transparency. The results will contribute to a public exhibition at Archizoom in Fall 2027.

projects.title: Gabarits/Baugespanne/Building Profiles
projects.summary: Examines how building profiles (gabarits) are used, where, and why, how the practice has changed over time, and when it is helpful or misleading.

projects.title: The Life of Grande Dixence as Construction Site
projects.summary: Uses the on-site journal and films of the construction process as primary material to characterize life on the construction sites of the Dixence-Cleuson hydropower complex over the decade of construction.

projects.title: Existing buildings as continued material commitments
projects.summary: Identifies buildings renovated over multiple cycles, such as exposed-concrete examples like St. Antonius Church in Basel and the Goetheanum in Dornach, to understand material expenditure as a continual commitment rather than a one-time act.

projects.title: Contemporary History Tracing: Constructing Architecture: Materials Processes Structures
projects.summary: Traces the influence of the 2005 book Constructing Architecture: Materials Processes Structures, examining where it is used as a textbook and reference, how its use differs from the authors' intention, and what its influence says about architectural practice today.

projects.title: The City, Underground: Lausanne
projects.summary: Characterizes and precisely draws the underground of Lausanne, including parking, metro, and train infrastructure (LEB, TRIDEL), examining how these spaces were imagined, how much remains, and what the future holds for them.

projects.title: Follow the Things: M3 Construction
projects.summary: Studies the history and planning of the M3 project in Lausanne, asking whether it is still defensible and what alternatives exist, and surveys where its construction and excavated materials come from and whether alternatives exist.

projects.title: Lausanne Main Station
projects.summary: Studies the history and planning of the new Lausanne main station, asking whether the project is still defensible and what alternatives exist.

projects.title: Contractors
projects.summary: Examines the history and operating strategy of local contractors such as Orlatti and Implenia.

projects.title: In-context learning as approximated Bayesian inference
projects.summary: Investigates whether transformers performing in-context learning implement more sophisticated mechanisms than gradient descent for complex statistical problems and architectures, challenging the "ICL as GD" hypothesis. The project frames in-context learning as approximated Bayesian inference.

projects.title: Master's Project 1
projects.summary: Investigates whether collateral sensitivity patterns can be identified in clinical E. coli isolates with diverse antibiotic resistance profiles, using MIC measurements and comparison with data from laboratory-evolved resistant strains. Genomic analysis of selected isolates may be included.

projects.title: Master's Project 2
projects.summary: Studies why integrative and conjugative elements (ICEs) transfer efficiently between some gut Bacteroides strains and not others, by separating element-level from host-cell-level effects. It also screens gut-relevant conditions beyond tetracycline (such as bile salts, short-chain fatty acids and oxidative stress) for their ability to trigger ICE excision.

projects.title: Bachelor projects: organoid models of epigenetic control of cell type differentiation
projects.summary: Small 6-credit bachelor projects characterizing and generating organoid models to study the epigenetic control of cell type differentiation. Work includes molecular cloning, PCR and qPCR, immunofluorescence staining, and organoid and iPS cell culture.

projects.title: Master project: epigenetic regulation of cellular stress
projects.summary: Full-time master thesis topic on the epigenetic regulation of cellular stress. The page lists it among the lab's current master topics.

projects.title: Master project: imaging epigenetic transitions within the nucleus
projects.summary: Full-time master thesis topic on imaging epigenetic transitions within the cell nucleus. The page lists it among the lab's current master topics.

projects.title: Master project: role of epigenetics in cellular ageing
projects.summary: Full-time master thesis topic on the role of epigenetics in cellular ageing. The page lists it among the lab's current master topics.

projects.title: Migration in cities of the global south
projects.summary: Studies migration flows and their role in urban growth in cities of the global south.

projects.title: Migration and urbanization in Switzerland
projects.summary: Examines migration and urbanization patterns within Switzerland.

projects.title: Fertility decline in low- and middle-income countries
projects.summary: Analyses the decline of fertility rates in low- and middle-income countries.

projects.title: Modelling urban growth
projects.summary: Review the literature on the space-time evolution of urban areas, study feedbacks between population growth and urban transport networks, and test and adapt an existing urban growth model to explain complex urban dynamics with simple spatial rules.

projects.title: Modelling groundwater pollution & remediation
projects.summary: Simulate flow and transport processes in the subsurface to assess groundwater contamination at a selected site and explore remediation options.

projects.title: Monitoring and modeling urban CO2 fluxes
projects.summary: Test urban climate sensors (such as a flux tower at the UNIL campus, thermal cameras and drones), analyse the collected data, and/or develop an anthropogenic CO2 emissions model to compare observations with theoretical results.

projects.title: Stochastic modelling of urban climate
projects.summary: Develop a stochastic description of urban climate to characterise the space-time variability of urban surface and air temperature fields.

projects.title: Urban wind energy multiscale modeling
projects.summary: Ingest the swissBUILDING3D 3.0 high-resolution building morphology dataset into the PALM-4U CFD model to explore urban wind energy potential across major Swiss conurbations.

projects.title: Modeling traffic flows
projects.summary: Describe traffic flows in cities using theories and approaches from fluid dynamics and porous media, based on existing high-resolution datasets.

projects.title: Machine Learning applications to urban sciences
projects.summary: Apply machine learning to urban climate prediction (temperature, humidity, wind speed), land use change over time, and mobility and urban growth.

projects.title: Predicting population changes in time and space
projects.summary: Develop a gravitational model to describe space-time variations in population density resulting from human mobility, from hourly to seasonal timescales.

projects.title: Investigating commuting patterns in Switzerland using mobility models
projects.summary: Analyse commuting flows in Switzerland using the Communal Matrix dataset, test existing mobility models such as those in the scikit-mobility package to predict flows, and compare results with other datasets such as Spanish mobility data.

projects.title: Impact of extreme heat on transport infrastructures
projects.summary: Assess changes in the frequency of future rail track buckling and other transport-related risks under heat, using the spatial and temporal distribution of transport infrastructure and temperature projections.

projects.title: Computational fluid dynamics for urban cooling
projects.summary: Study urban cooling with computational fluid dynamics. The page marks this topic as coming soon and recommends experience with ENVI-met or similar CFD codes.

projects.title: Modeling visitors–residents competition in overtourism
projects.summary: Model the competition between visitors and residents in overtourism. The page marks this topic as coming soon and gives no further details.

projects.title: Aesthetics of scientific data
projects.summary: Combine algorithmic techniques with state-of-the-art datasets to create critically articulated and aesthetically appealing visualizations of scientific data.

projects.title: Impact of weather on mobility
projects.summary: Assess how weather such as rainfall and heat affects mobility patterns and transport mode choice, using a dataset provided on the page.

projects.title: Climate risk and nature-based solutions in humanitarian settings
projects.summary: Study climate risk and nature-based solutions in humanitarian settings, possibly in collaboration with MEDAIR using a geospatial inventory for Lebanon. The specific topic is still to be defined.

projects.title: Investigation of flow development in thermally-stratified turbulent boundary layers
projects.summary: Experimental study of how thermally stratified turbulent boundary layers develop in the WiRE boundary layer wind tunnel, under unstable, neutral and stable atmospheric-like temperature conditions and varying free stream velocities. The work includes pitot tube and thermocouple measurements, PIV feasibility tests, heat flux measurements, and power curve tests of a miniature wind turbine.

projects.title: Wind tunnel study of wind turbine performance and wind turbine wakes over complex terrain
projects.summary: Wind tunnel experiments will study the performance of wind turbines placed on idealized terrains such as cliffs and isolated hills, in order to optimize turbine placement on the landscape. The study also examines turbine wakes over complex terrain.

projects.title: Wind tunnel study on wind farm design optimization
projects.summary: Scaled-down wind turbine models will be used in a wind tunnel to study how turbulent boundary layer flow interacts with wind farms of different configurations and turbine densities. The goal is to optimize wind farm design by maximizing energy output and minimizing fatigue loads.

projects.title: A multiscale forecasting system for wind energy production
projects.summary: Use online observation data to validate WIRE's multiscale simulation system for forecasting wind and energy output from wind farms over complex terrain, applied as a case study to the JUVENT wind farm in the Jura mountains, Switzerland.

projects.title: Example 4: Wind Energy Optimization
projects.summary: Master student project on optimizing wind energy projects by improving predictions of wind and turbulence around turbines and wind farms. Tasks include developing a virtual wind simulator (large-eddy simulation and simpler analytical models), field measurements with scanning LiDARs, and wind-tunnel experiments on wind farm layouts and turbine siting over complex terrain.

projects.title: Example 2: Wake characteristics of a wind farm sited in a multiscale rough topography
projects.summary: Wind tunnel experiments on a wind farm sited in a multiscale rough topography, comparing power performance and wake characteristics with an ideal flat terrain and benchmarking analytical wake models for prediction in such terrain.

projects.title: Quantum constraint satisfaction problems
projects.summary: Investigate quantum versions of constraint satisfaction problems such as K-SAT, with N quantum bits (spin-1/2) subject to M constraints acting on them.

projects.title: Message passing for Quantum Models
projects.summary: Develop message passing techniques for simple quantum spin models defined on graphs.

projects.title: Universal prediction and alpha-mutual information
projects.summary: Experimentally study the performance of a newly devised class of predictors that estimate data sequences when information about the generating distribution is limited, based on a generalized definition of mutual information.

projects.title: Quantum constraint satisfaction problems (SMILS)
projects.summary: Investigate quantum versions of constraint satisfaction problems such as quantum K-SAT, studying the phase diagram as a function of constraint density and algorithmic methods to construct product-state ground states. The project starts from the basic literature on the topic.

projects.title: Message passing for quantum models (SMILS)
projects.summary: Develop message passing techniques for simple quantum spin models on graphs, using functional integral and/or discrete phase space representations. The work focuses on investigating topological phases with these methods.

projects.title: Universal prediction and alpha-mutual information
projects.summary: Experimental study of Alpha-NML predictors, a class of estimators interpolating between the Krichevsky-Trofimov (KT) and Normalized Maximum Likelihood (NML) estimators for universal prediction under log loss. Possible directions include extending the gamma-function closed forms to longer sequences, deriving closed forms for non-i.i.d. sources such as Markov sources, and assessing average-case performance against KT and NML.

projects.title: NET1: Recovering User Questions from the Web Traffic of AI Search and Crawling APIs
projects.summary: Studies whether network traces produced by AI search and crawling APIs (such as Exa or Firecrawl) leak metadata about the user prompts that trigger them, and whether the original prompt can be recovered from that traffic. The student builds a corpus of questions, runs them through these services under controlled conditions, and records the resulting network activity.

projects.title: SYS1: Empirical Threat Models in Censorship Circumvention
projects.summary: Examines why some censorship circumvention tools achieve large real-world success while others with strong theoretical potential have had no practical impact. The project takes a cryptographic threat-modelling perspective on empirical censorship behaviour and deployed circumvention tools.

projects.title: Human-AI co-orchestration of group collaborative argumentation and ideation
projects.summary: Explores how AI can orchestrate group collaborative argumentation and ideation between human participants. The page lists it as open to semester projects, master's theses and internship projects.

projects.title: Human-AI interactions that preserve and elevate human expertise in AI-augmented work
projects.summary: Investigates human-AI interaction designs that keep and strengthen human expertise in AI-augmented work. The page lists it as open to semester projects, master's theses and internship projects.

projects.title: Designing real-time AI support for collaborative, inquiry-based science learning
projects.summary: Focuses on designing real-time AI support for students engaged in collaborative, inquiry-based science learning. The page lists it as open to semester projects, master's theses and internship projects.

projects.title: Interactive tools to prepare citizens for democratic deliberation and policy co-creation
projects.summary: Aims to create interactive tools that help citizens prepare for democratic deliberation and co-creation of policy. The page lists it as open to semester projects, master's theses and internship projects.

projects.title: Participatory and community-based approaches to AI development
projects.summary: Studies participatory and community-based approaches that involve diverse stakeholders in AI development. The page lists it as open to semester projects, master's theses and internship projects.

projects.title: Worker-centred design of workplace AI systems
projects.summary: Focuses on designing workplace AI systems around the needs and expertise of workers. The page lists it as open to semester projects, master's theses and internship projects.

projects.title: AI agents that foster learners' critical thinking through argumentation
projects.summary: Develops AI agents designed to foster learners' critical thinking through argumentation. The page lists it as open to semester projects, master's theses and internship projects.
